words.definition: to leave someone, especially someone you are responsible for; loose, mania; desert, yield, quit
words.translation: 离弃；放弃；狂热；放任；遗弃

examples.en: How could she abandon her own child?
examples.zh: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子？

words.definition: a short form of a word or expression; abridgement, sigillum
words.translation: 缩略语；[语]缩写；缩写词

examples.en: The abbreviation for Kansas is KS.
examples.zh: 的缩写是。

words.definition: very different from usual in a way that seems strange, worrying, wrong, or dangerous; unnatural, eccentric
words.translation: 反常的；变态的；反常的，不规则的

examples.en: abnormal behaviour
examples.zh: 反常行为

examples.en: an abnormal level of cholesterol
examples.zh: 胆固醇水平异常

examples.en: My parents thought it was abnormal for a boy to be interested in ballet.
examples.zh: 我父母认为一个男孩子对芭蕾舞感兴趣并不正常。

words.definition: to officially end a law, system etc, especially one that has existed for a long time; recall, suppress
words.translation: 废除；废除，废止；取消，革除

examples.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

words.definition: native, original, primitive, indigenous; indigenous population
words.translation: 土著(的)；土生动植物(的)；土著的；[生物]原始的；土著居民；[动]土生生物

examples.en: He remained fascinated by the Aboriginals' tales.
examples.zh: 他一直对澳大利亚土著人的故事很着迷。

words.definition: to deliberately end a  pregnancy  when the baby is still too young to live; miscarry, come to an untimely end; discontinue
words.translation: 取消；流产；堕胎；夭折；发育不全；使流产；使中止

examples.en: The disease causes pregnant animals to abort.
examples.zh: 这种疾病会导致怀孕的动物流产。

words.definition: a medical operation to end a  pregnancy  so that the baby is not born alive; miscarriage, misbirth
words.translation: 流产；(计划)失败；[妇产]流产，小产；流产的胎儿

examples.en: She decided to have an abortion .
examples.zh: 她决定做人工流产。

examples.en: anti-abortion campaigners
examples.zh: 参与反堕胎运动的人

words.definition: teem with, be imbued with
words.translation: 多；富于；充满

examples.en: Rumors of such coordination abound, but as with many rumors, they have no basis in fact.
examples.zh: 关于这类协调的谣传很多；但如同许多其他谣传一样，它们没有事实根据。

examples.en: Finally, offer this closing prayer to the Lord: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
examples.zh: 最后，将结束的祷告告诉主：愿在你拥有信仰的时候希望的上帝用快乐与和平充满你的人生，让你在圣灵的力量下富于希望。

words.definition: an area on the surface of your skin that has been injured by being rubbed against something hard; wear and tear, arrosion
words.translation: 磨损，擦伤处；[口腔]磨损；[机]磨耗；[皮肤]擦伤

examples.en: She was treated for cuts and abrasions.
examples.zh: 她因划伤和擦伤而接受治疗。

words.definition: to reduce the length of (a written work) by condensing or rewriting; cut, pot
words.translation: (书等)删节；删节；缩短；节略

examples.en: Article 33 A book publisher may alter or abridge a work with the permission of the copyright owner.
examples.zh: 第三十三条图书出版者经作者许可，可以对作品修改、删节。

words.definition: sudden and unexpected; sudden, short, angular
words.translation: 突然的，粗暴的；生硬的；突然的；唐突的；陡峭的

examples.en: an abrupt change of plan
examples.zh: 计划的突然改变

words.definition: to take in liquid, gas, or another substance from the surface or space around something; attract, engage, see, read, seize
words.translation: 吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注

examples.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
examples.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

words.definition: based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events; a short written statement containing only the most important ideas in a speech, article etc; brief, summary, resume; deep, nonobjective; extract, brief
words.translation: 抽象的；(书籍、演说等的)摘要；[图情]摘要；抽象；抽象的概念；深奥的；提取；使……抽象化

examples.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
examples.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

examples.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
examples.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

words.definition: completely stupid or unreasonable; ridiculous, preposterous
words.translation: 可笑的，荒谬的；荒谬的；可笑的

examples.en: It seems an absurd idea.
examples.zh: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

words.definition: a large quantity of something; plenty, pregnancy, amplitude, enrichment
words.translation: 丰富；充裕，[地化]丰富

examples.en: This area of Mexico has an abundance of safe beaches and a pleasing climate.
examples.zh: 墨西哥的这个地区有大量的安全沙滩与宜人的气候。

words.definition: the use of something in a way that it should not be used; punishment, vice; strain, maltreat
words.translation: 滥用；恶习；辱骂；虐待；弊端；恶习，陋习

examples.en: A self-monitoring tax system is clearly open to abuse (=  able to be used wrongly  ) .
examples.zh: 自我监督的税收制度明显会被滥用。

words.definition: relating to education, especially at college or university level; theoretical, collegial; undergraduate, don, scholar, college student, university student
words.translation: 学术的；学校的；理论的；学院的；大学生，大学教师；学者

examples.en: He possessed no academic qualifications.
examples.zh: 他没有学历。

examples.en: a program to raise academic standards
examples.zh: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

words.definition: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect; improve, increase speed
words.translation: 加速，变快；加速；促进；增加

examples.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
examples.zh: 加快经济增长速度的措施

words.definition: the way you use to enter a building or reach a place; make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise; opening, admittance
words.translation: 通路；使用；[计]存取；接近；进入；使用权；[电]通路

examples.en: Access is by means of a small door on the right.
examples.zh: 入口是右边的一扇小门。

words.definition: something such as a piece of equipment or a decoration that is not necessary, but that makes a machine, car, room etc more useful or more attractive; attachment, mating parts; deputy, vice, subsidiary, auxiliary
words.translation: 同谋者；附件；配件；[法]从犯；副的；同谋的；[昆]附属的

examples.en: bathroom accessories such as mirrors and towel-rails
examples.zh: 镜子和毛巾架等浴室配件

words.definition: the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe; atmosphere, heaven, sky, high, look; sport, ventilate
words.translation: 空气；[气象]空气，[地物]大气；天空；样子；曲调；使通风，晾干；夸耀

examples.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
examples.zh: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

examples.en: You need to put some air in the tyres.
examples.zh: 你得给轮胎充气了。

words.definition: an occasion when an opinion, idea etc is discussed; perflation, aeration; weathering
words.translation: 通风；讨论；晾干；（开车）兜风；风干；烘热（air的ing形式）

examples.en: give them an airing.
examples.zh: 把室内盆栽植物搬出去透透气。

words.definition: a long passage between rows of seats in a church, plane, theatre etc, or between rows of shelves in a shop; door, exit, channel, route, walkway
words.translation: 通道；[建]通道，走道；侧廊

examples.en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat (=  seat next to the aisle  ) ?
examples.zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger; panic, tocsin; exercise, alert, warn
words.translation: 警报，惊慌；使忧虑；警报，[安全]警告器；惊慌；警告；使惊恐

examples.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
examples.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

examples.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
examples.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

examples.en: a sophisticated alarm system
examples.zh: 精密的警报系统

words.definition: a book that you put photographs, stamps etc in
words.translation: 集邮册；相片册

examples.en: a photograph album
examples.zh: 相册

words.definition: someone who is not a legal citizen of the country they are living or working in; foreign, external; foreigner, uitlander; transfer, negotiate
words.translation: 外侨；外国人的；不相容的；外国的；相异的，性质不同的；外国人，外侨；外星人；让渡，转让

examples.en: illegal aliens entering the country.
examples.zh: 非法入境的外国人

words.definition: to do something that makes someone unfriendly or unwilling to support you; release, convey
words.translation: 离间，使疏远；使疏远，离间；让与

examples.en: The latest tax proposals will alienate many voters.
examples.zh: 最新的纳税提案将失去远许多选民的支持。

words.definition: completely; entire, overall, total; utterly, sheerly; full, entirety, allness
words.translation: 完全地；全部，全体；全部的；全然地；越发；全部

examples.en: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
examples.zh: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

examples.en: a strange woman, dressed all in black
examples.zh: 一袭黑衣的奇怪女子

examples.en: If people want more freedom of choice, then I’m all for it (=  I strongly support it  ) .
examples.zh: 如果民众想要更多选择的自由，我完全支持。

words.definition: easy to notice; transparent, decided, patent
words.translation: 明显的，表面上的；显然的；表面上的

examples.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
examples.zh: 质量的差异显而易见。

examples.en: He left suddenly, for no apparent reason .
examples.zh: 不知什么原因，他突然离开了。

words.definition: an urgent request for something important; attract, clamour for; asking, request, motion, charm
words.translation: 呼吁，上诉；吸引(力)；呼吁，恳求；[法]上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判；呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；诉诸裁判

examples.en: The girl’s family have made a public appeal for help to try and catch her killer.
examples.zh: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

words.definition: a small organ near your  bowel  , which has little or no use; supplement, Appendix Appx
words.translation: 附录；阑尾；[图情]附录；附加物

examples.en: Christine had to go into hospital to have her appendix out (=  have it removed  ) .
examples.zh: 克里丝蒂娜不得不去医院切除阑尾。

words.definition: a desire for food; weakness, habit, hobby
words.translation: 食欲；[生理]食欲；嗜好

examples.en: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
examples.zh: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

examples.en: Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
examples.zh: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

words.definition: to hit your open hands together, to show that you have enjoyed a play, concert, speaker etc; go along with, be favorable to; cheer for, give it up
words.translation: 鼓掌欢迎；赞成；赞同；称赞；向…喝采；喝彩

examples.en: The audience applauded loudly.
examples.zh: 观众掌声雷动。

examples.en: A crowd of 300 supporters warmly applauded her speech.
examples.zh: 300名支持者为她的演讲热烈鼓掌。

words.definition: device, apparatus, installation, unit, tool
words.translation: 用具，设备，装置；器具；器械；[机]装置

examples.en: The device most often used to do this is a load balancer, which is an appliance that accepts requests from the outside world and hands them off to the next available application server.
examples.zh: 进行这一操作最常用的设备是一个负载均衡器，这是一个从外部接收请求并将它们移交给下一个可用应用程序服务器的装置。

examples.en: This provides some of the advantages of an appliance but with the flexibility to distribute as software only, along with the ability to consolidate multiple appliances on the same physical hardware.
examples.zh: 这种组合提供了设备的一些好处，同时又具有仅作为软件分发的灵活性，而且还能够将多个设备合并到相同的物理硬件上。

words.definition: someone who has formally asked, usually in writing, for a job, university place etc; postulant, proposer
words.translation: 请求者，申请者；[专利]申请人，申请者；请求者

examples.en: We have had lots of applicants for these positions.
examples.zh: 对这些职位我们已有了很多申请人。

words.definition: to make a formal request, usually written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something; put in for, enter one's name for; demand, put in for
words.translation: 要求，申请；申请；涂，敷；应用；适用；请求

examples.en: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
examples.zh: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

words.definition: an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose; convention, bond, nomination
words.translation: 职位；约会；[管理]任命；约定；任命的职位

examples.en: All consultations are by appointment only .
examples.zh: 就诊必须预约。

words.definition: a statement or opinion judging the worth, value, or condition of something; evaluation, valuation, estimation, computation, assessment, calculation
words.translation: 估价，评价；鉴定；评价；[经管]估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）；[数]估计

examples.en: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation.
examples.zh: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

words.definition: large enough to be noticed or considered important; palpable, perceptible
words.translation: 可见的；明显的；可感知的；[经]可评估的；相当可观的

examples.en: There’s no appreciable change in the patient’s condition.
examples.zh: 病人的状况没有明显改变。

words.definition: used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done; enjoy, see, grasp; value added, rise in price
words.translation: 欣赏，感激；涨价；欣赏；感激；领会；鉴别；增值

examples.en: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
examples.zh: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

examples.en: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
examples.zh: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

examples.en: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
examples.zh: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

words.definition: anxiety about the future, especially about dealing with something unpleasant or difficult; grasp, understanding, fear, comprehension
words.translation: 理解；忧虑；恐惧；[法]逮捕；忧惧

examples.en: a feeling of apprehension
examples.zh: 担忧的心情

examples.en: I woke before the alarm, filled with apprehension.
examples.zh: 我忧心忡忡，闹钟没响就醒了。

words.definition: freshman, fresh hand
words.translation: 学徒；使当学徒；[劳经]生手

examples.en: The apprentice lingered his work.
examples.zh: 这个徒弟磨洋工。

examples.en: His apprentice always leaves the tools about.
examples.zh: 他的徒弟老是乱放工具。

examples.en: That would be good for my apprentice to have, complementary.
examples.zh: 补充说一下，那会是成为我徒弟的优势。

words.definition: to move towards or nearer to someone or something; a method of doing something or dealing with a problem; method, way, system, mechanism, medium; border, go on for; come near to, draw near
words.translation: 接近，着手处理；接近；方法；途径；着手处理；靠近

examples.en: As I approached the house, I noticed a light on upstairs.
examples.zh: 我走近那幢房子的时候注意到楼上有灯光。

examples.en: She heard footsteps approaching.
examples.zh: 她听到有脚步声走过来。

words.definition: correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose; suitable, proper, adequate, becoming; engage, take up to
words.translation: 合适的；适当的；占用；拨出

examples.en: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
examples.zh: 通告发布的时机很合适。

examples.en: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
examples.zh: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

examples.en: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
examples.zh: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

words.definition: when a plan, decision, or person is officially accepted; confirmation, authorization, validation, ratification
words.translation: 允许，赞同；批准；认可；赞成

examples.en: The president has already given his approval to the plan.
examples.zh: 总统已经批准了这个计划。

examples.en: It is just three months since we received official approval to go ahead with the project.
examples.zh: 三个月前我们刚刚得到正式批准进行这个项目。

examples.en: A company cannot be sold without the approval of the shareholders.
examples.zh: 没有股东的同意不能出售公司。

words.definition: an approximate number, amount, or time is close to the exact number, amount etc, but could be a little bit more or less than it; to be close to a particular number; close to, border on; near, broad, round
words.translation: 近似的，约略的；接近，近似；接近于；[数]近似于；[数]近似的；大概的

examples.en: What is the approximate number of students in each class?
examples.zh: 每个班大致有多少学生？

examples.en: These percentages are only approximate.
examples.zh: 这些百分比仅仅是近似值。

words.definition: exactly right for a particular situation or purpose; sensitive, correct, quick, prone, liable
words.translation: 聪明的；合适的；易于的；恰当的；有…倾向的；灵敏的

examples.en: ‘Love at first sight’ is a very apt description of how he felt when he saw her.
examples.zh: 用“一见钟情”来形容他见到她时的感觉再恰当不过。

words.definition: a test that measures your natural skills or abilities; talent, endowment
words.translation: 才能；能力；天资；自然倾向；适宜

words.definition: someone who is attractive is good looking, especially in a way that makes you sexually interested in them; dramatic, absorbing
words.translation: 有吸引力的，讨人喜欢的；吸引人的；有魅力的；引人注目的

examples.en: an attractive young woman
examples.zh: 妩媚动人的年轻女子

examples.en: Women seem to find him attractive .
examples.zh: 女性似乎觉得他很有吸引力。

words.definition: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation; a quality or feature, especially one that is considered to be good or useful; particularity, idiosyncracy; ascribe to
words.translation: 归因于；属性；象征；标志；特质；归属；把…归于

examples.en: Women tend to attribute their success to external causes such as luck.
examples.zh: 女性往往把她们的成功归因于外因，如运气。

words.definition: a public meeting where land, buildings, paintings etc are sold to the person who offers the most money for them; be on sale; public sale, vendue
words.translation: 拍卖；[贸易]拍卖；竞卖

examples.en: The painting is expected to fetch up to $400,000 at auction.
examples.zh: 这幅画预计在拍卖会上能卖到40万美元。

words.definition: a sound that is audible is loud enough for you to hear it; hearable
words.translation: 听得见的

examples.en: His voice was barely audible (=  could only just be heard  ) above the roar of the crowd.
examples.zh: 人声嘈杂，几乎听不见他的说话声。

words.definition: a group of people who come to watch and listen to someone speaking or performing in public; reader, interview
words.translation: 听众，读者；接见；观众；听众；读者

examples.en: The audience began clapping and cheering.
examples.zh: 观众开始鼓掌欢呼。

examples.en: One member of the audience described the opera as ‘boring’.
examples.zh: 有一名观众说这出歌剧“乏味”。

words.definition: an official examination of a company’s financial records in order to check that they are correct; examine and verify; sit in on
words.translation: 审计；查账；[审计]查帐；（美）旁听

examples.en: the annual audit
examples.zh: 年度审计

words.definition: a short performance by an actor, singer etc that someone watches to judge if they are good enough to act in a play, sing in a concert etc; hearing, ear
words.translation: 试听；试演；面试；听力，[生理]听觉

examples.en: ...an audition for a Broadway musical.
examples.zh: …一部百老汇歌舞剧的试演。

words.definition: a large building used for concerts or public meetings; assembly hall, assembly room
words.translation: 会堂；礼堂；礼堂，会堂；[建]观众席

examples.en: ...a high school auditorium.
examples.zh: …一所中学的礼堂。

words.definition: to increase the value, amount, effectiveness etc of something; improve, gain, accelerate, make, grow in; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot; enhancement, increase, gain, rise, accession
words.translation: 增大，增加；增加；增大

examples.en: Any surplus was sold to augment their income.
examples.zh: 所有多余的东西被售卖一空来增加他们的收入。

words.translation: 国外来的(姑娘)帮助料理家务换取住宿的

words.definition: a painting, document, book etc that is authentic has been proved to be by a particular person; actual, sincere, genuine, true, real
words.translation: 真实的，可靠的；真正的，真实的；可信的

examples.en: an authentic work by Picasso
examples.zh: 毕加索的真迹

words.definition: an authoritative book, account etc is respected because the person who wrote it knows a lot about the subject; magisterial, cathedratic
words.translation: 有权威的；命令的；可靠的；命令式的；当局的

examples.en: the most authoritative work on English surnames
examples.zh: 有关英语姓氏的最权威著作

words.definition: the power you have because of your official position; rod, jurisdiction
words.translation: 威信；当局；权威；权力；[法]权力

examples.en: an agreement between the US and Colombian authorities
examples.zh: 美国和哥伦比亚当局的一份协议

words.definition: failure to pay money that you owe at the right time; fall behind, lag behind; shortage, deficiency, need, drought, short of; walk out on sth., unsatisfy
words.translation: 拖欠，违约；不出庭；[会计]拖欠；不履行；不到场；违约；缺席；缺乏；系统默认值；不参加（比赛等）；对…处以缺席裁判

examples.en: the risk of default by borrowers
examples.zh: 借款人不偿还欠款的风险

words.definition: failure to win or succeed; down, get the best of; failure, loss, losing, reverse, collapse
words.translation: 打败，战胜；击败，战胜；挫败；使…失败；失败；战胜

examples.en: She was a woman who hated to admit defeat.
examples.zh: 她是个不愿认输的女人。

words.definition: a fault or a lack of something that means that something or someone is not perfect; to leave your own country or group in order to go to or join an opposing one; deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault, shortcoming; apostatize, rise up
words.translation: 缺点，欠缺；背叛；逃跑；开小差；缺点，[晶体][材]缺陷；不足之处；变节；叛变

examples.en: All the cars are tested for defects before they leave the factory.
examples.zh: 所有汽车在出厂前都经过品质检验。

examples.en: a genetic defect
examples.zh: 遗传缺陷

words.definition: something that you say or do in order to support someone or something that is being criticized; protection, reply, answer
words.translation: 防卫 防护 防御物 辩护 被告律师；[军]防御；防卫；答辩；防卫设备

examples.en: The land was flat, giving no scope for defence.
examples.zh: 土地非常平坦，无法做防卫之用。

words.definition: the person in a court of law who has been  accused  of doing something illegal; justificatory, vindicative; accused person, indictee
words.translation: 被告；处于被告地位的；辩护的；为自己辩护的；[法]被告

examples.en: We find the defendant not guilty.
examples.zh: 我们裁定被告无罪。

words.definition: to delay something until a later date; delay, to postpone; respite
words.translation: 推迟，延期；推迟；延期；服从；使推迟；使延期

examples.en: The committee deferred their decision .
examples.zh: 委员会延期作出决定。

words.definition: behaviour that shows you refuse to do what someone tells you to do, especially because you do not respect them; resistance, challenge, dare
words.translation: 挑战，挑衅；违抗；蔑视；挑战；反抗

examples.en: ...his courageous defiance of the government.
examples.zh: …他对政府的大胆蔑视。

words.definition: a lack of something that is necessary; defect, shortage, vice, need, fault
words.translation: 缺乏，不足，不足之数；缺陷，缺点；缺乏；不足的数额

examples.en: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
examples.zh: 他们给他做了血检看是否有缺乏维生素的迹象。

words.definition: the difference between the amount of something that you have and the higher amount that you need; red ink
words.translation: 空额，赤字；[财政]赤字；不足额

examples.en: the country’s widening budget deficit
examples.zh: 这个国家日益严重的预算赤字

examples.en: the US’s foreign trade deficit
examples.zh: 美国的对外贸易逆差

words.definition: to make something less pure and good, especially by showing no respect; soil, mud, spot, dirty; narrow, cajon
words.translation: 弄脏，污损；污损，弄脏；染污；狭谷；隘路

examples.en: Hallam’s tomb had been defiled and looted.
examples.zh: 哈勒姆的坟墓遭到了亵渎和洗劫。

words.definition: clearly known, seen, or stated
words.translation: 确切的，明确的

examples.en: It’s impossible for me to give you a definite answer.
examples.zh: 我不可能给你明确的答复。

examples.en: We need to record sufficient data to enable definite conclusions to be reached.
examples.zh: 我们需要记录足够的数据，才能得出明确的结论。

examples.en: He’d shown definite signs of resigning himself to the situation.
examples.zh: 他明显表现出安于这种状况的样子。

words.definition: a definitive agreement, statement etc is one that will not be changed; determinator, qualifier; crucial, critical, final, finishing, decisive
words.translation: 决定的，明确的；最后的；限定词；决定性的；限定的

examples.en: a definitive agreement to buy the company
examples.zh: 收购这家公司的最终协议

words.definition: dong, air escape; reduce, zoom out
words.translation: 使(轮胎)瘪下去 降低重要性；放气；使缩小；紧缩通货；打击；使泄气；缩小；物价下降

words.definition: if someone or something deflects something that is moving, or if it deflects, it turns in a different direction; wind, curve; swing, turn towards
words.translation: 偏斜；使转向；使偏斜；使弯曲；转向

examples.en: He deflected the blow with his forearm.
examples.zh: 他用前臂挡开了打来的一拳。

words.definition: to trick a person or organization in order to get money from them; sell, fox, kid, take in sb, give the shaft
words.translation: 欺骗，欺诈；[法]欺骗

examples.en: He faces charges of theft and conspiracy to defraud (= a secret plan to cheat someone, made by two or more people ) .
examples.zh: 他面临偷窃和合谋诈骗的指控。

words.definition: a deft movement is skilful, and often quick; neat, dexterous
words.translation: 灵巧的，熟练的；灵巧的；机敏的；敏捷熟练的

examples.en: He sketched her with quick, deft strokes.
examples.zh: 他给她画素描，下笔又快又熟练。

examples.en: deft footwork
examples.zh: 敏捷的步法

words.definition: If you defy someone or something that is trying to make you behave in a particular way, you refuse to obey them and behave in that way; spurn at, sneeze at; challenge, dare, war, confrontation
words.translation: 公然反抗，蔑视，拒绝服从；藐视；公然反抗；挑衅；使落空；挑战；对抗

examples.en: This was the first (and last) time that I dared to defy my mother.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次（也是最后一次）胆敢违抗我母亲。

words.definition: someone whose behaviour is considered to be morally unacceptable; go ill, exasperate; go to seed, retrogress; fallen, degraded; lost souls
words.translation: 堕落(的)，颓废(的)；[数][生物]使退化；恶化；[数][生物]退化；堕落；[数][生物]退化的；堕落的；堕落的人

words.definition: lower, bemean; sink in the scale, lower down
words.translation: 降级，堕落，贬黜；贬低；使……丢脸；使……降级；使……降解；降级，降低；退化

examples.en: a movie that degrades women
examples.zh: 贬损女性的影片

words.definition: to change what you are doing so that you are not following an expected plan, idea, or type of behaviour; out of contact, break away; diverge
words.translation: 背离，偏离；脱离；越轨；使偏离

examples.en: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
examples.zh: 你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

words.definition: to plan or invent a new way of doing something; design, engineer, style, project, frame; legacy, bequest
words.translation: 设计，想出；设计；想出；发明；图谋；遗赠给；遗赠

examples.en: She devised a method for quicker communications between offices.
examples.zh: 她想出一种加快办公室之间通信联络的方法。

words.definition: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it; commit oneself to, bend oneself to
words.translation: 把奉献给；致力于；奉献

examples.en: He decided to devote the rest of his life to scientific investigation.
examples.zh: 他决定把余生奉献给科学研究。

examples.en: Considerable resources have been devoted to proving him a liar.
examples.zh: 大量的资源已被用来证明他是个撒谎者。

words.definition: to eat something quickly because you are very hungry; devastate, wrack and ruin
words.translation: 狼吞虎咽地吃；挥霍，耗尽；吞食；毁灭；凝视

examples.en: The boys devoured their pancakes.
examples.zh: 男孩子们狼吞虎咽地把薄煎饼吃了。

words.definition: to find out what illness someone has, or what the cause of a fault is, after doing tests, examinations etc; tell, figure out; judge of, pass upon
words.translation: 诊断(疾病)；诊断；断定；判断

examples.en: How did they diagnose you?
examples.zh: 他们怎么给你的诊断的？

examples.en: What tools do you need to help you diagnose the problem, and where do you get them?
examples.zh: 您需要什么工具来帮助您诊断问题，可以从哪里获得这些工具？

examples.en: Evidently this springs from some defect in their nature, but it is one not altogether easy either to diagnose of to cure.
examples.zh: 这种情形显然源于他们本性上的某种缺陷，但是这种缺陷既不容易诊断也不容易治疗。

words.definition: a simple drawing or plan that shows exactly where something is, what something looks like, or how something works; chart, graph
words.translation: 图解；图表；[数]图解

examples.en: ...a circuit diagram.
examples.zh: …电路图。

words.definition: someone whose job is to treat people’s teeth; dental surgeon
words.translation: 牙医；牙科医生

examples.en: Visit your dentist twice a year for a checkup.
examples.zh: 每年看两次牙医做检查。

words.definition: to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something; negative, disavow; object, refuse
words.translation: 否认, 否定，拒绝一项要求"；否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求；否认；拒绝

examples.en: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
examples.zh: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

words.definition: satisfying, fulfilling
words.translation: 值得弄到手的，吸引人的；令人满意的；值得要的

examples.en: The ability to speak a foreign language is highly desirable .
examples.zh: 能说一门外语是非常理想的。

words.definition: a place that is desolate is empty and looks sad because there are no people there; someone who is desolate feels very sad and lonely; wild, desert; harshen
words.translation: 荒芜的；无人居住的；孤寂的；使荒芜；荒凉的；无人烟的；使荒凉；使孤寂

examples.en: a desolate landscape
examples.zh: 荒凉的景色

words.definition: to damage something very badly or completely; destroy, damage
words.translation: 破坏，蹂躏；毁灭；毁坏

examples.en: The city centre was devastated by the bomb.
examples.zh: 市中心被这枚炸弹摧毁了。

words.definition: badly damaging or destroying something; fell, destructive, fatal; annihilating, rubbling
words.translation: 破坏性的，毁灭性的；毁灭性的；全然的；摧毁（devastate的ing形式）；毁坏

examples.en: It will be a devastating blow for the town if the factory closes.
examples.zh: 如果工厂关闭，对该镇来说将是沉重的打击。

words.definition: the round part of a clock, watch, machine etc that has numbers that show you the time or a measurement; rotating disc, turntable
words.translation: 表面，钟面；拨号盘；打电话；转盘；[仪]刻度盘；钟面

examples.en: The lighted dial of her watch said 1.20.
examples.zh: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1点20分。

examples.en: She looked at the dial to check her speed.
examples.zh: 她看了看仪表盘，以确认自己的速度。

words.definition: a form of a language which is spoken only in one area, with words or grammar that are slightly different from other forms of the same language; patois, provincialism
words.translation: 方言，俚语；方言，土话；同源语；行话；个人用语特征

examples.en: the local dialect
examples.zh: 当地方言

words.definition: a straight line from one side of a circle to the other side, passing through the centre of the circle, or the length of this line
words.translation: 直径

examples.en: ...a tube less than a fifth of the diameter of a human hair.
examples.zh: …一根直径不到头发五分之一的微管。

words.definition: to say words for someone else to write down; require, order, command; instruction, order, bidding, telling, word
words.translation: 听写，命令，支配；命令；口述；使听写；指示

examples.en: Federal funds have to be used as dictated by Washington.
examples.zh: 联邦款项得按照华盛顿规定的途径使用。

words.definition: a way of eating in which you only eat certain foods, in order to lose weight, or to improve your health; eating, food and drink
words.translation: 饮食，规定的饮食，忌食；[食品]饮食；食物；[医]规定饮食

examples.en: Lyn always seems to be on a diet.
examples.zh: 琳恩似乎一直在节食。

examples.en: a salt-free diet
examples.zh: 无盐饮食

examples.en: Not all diets are good for you.
examples.zh: 不是所有的节食方法都适合你。

words.definition: to be different from something in some way; divide
words.translation: 不相同，意见不一致；相异；意见分歧

examples.en: The two systems differ in many respects.
examples.zh: 这两个系统在许多方面不同。

examples.en: Experts have differing views on the subject.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上专家们意见不同。

words.definition: to recognize or express the difference between things or people; to distinguish, tell apart
words.translation: 区别，区分；区分，区别

examples.en: What differentiates these two periods of history?
examples.zh: 这两个历史时期的差别在哪里？

words.definition: to make heat, light, liquid etc spread through something, or to spread like this; spread over a large area; divergent; transmit, spread abroad; spread abroad, to disseminate
words.translation: 散开，扩散；扩散的；冗长的；弥漫的；[植][物]散开的；[物]扩散；传播；漫射；四散

examples.en: Their ideas diffused quickly across Europe.
examples.zh: 他们的观点很快在欧洲传播开来。

words.definition: a part of a company’s profit that is divided among the people with  share s  in the company; bonus, stake
words.translation: 红利，股息；股息；[数]被除数；奖金

examples.en: The first quarter dividend has been increased by nearly 4 percent.
examples.zh: 第一季度的股息增加了近4％。

words.definition: coming from or relating to God or a god; remarkable, extraordinary, wonderful, excellent, famous; predict, prognosticate; soothsay; minister, priest, preacher
words.translation: 神的，极好的；占卜；神圣的；非凡的；天赐的；极好的；预言；用占卜勘探；使用占卜勘探矿；牧师；神学家

examples.en: divine power
examples.zh: 神的力量

examples.en: divine love
examples.zh: 上帝的慈爱

words.definition: feeling unable to stand steadily, for example because you are looking down from a high place or because you are ill; swimming, foolish, stupid; cloud, confuse
words.translation: 使人头晕的，眩晕的；晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的；使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然

examples.en: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy .
examples.zh: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

examples.en: She started to suffer from dizzy spells (= a short period when you feel dizzy ) .
examples.zh: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

words.definition: a place in a port where ships are loaded, unloaded, or repaired; landing, pier; crop, bob
words.translation: 船坞；码头；刑事被告席；引入船坞；[水运]码头；[船]船坞；被告席；尾巴的骨肉部分；使靠码头；剪短

examples.en: A crowd was waiting at the dock to greet them.
examples.zh: 一群人在码头等着迎接他们。

words.definition: a set of beliefs that form an important part of a religion or system of ideas; principle, theory, belief, teaching
words.translation: 教义，教条；主义；学说；教义；信条

examples.en: traditional doctrines of divine power
examples.zh: 神力的传统教义

examples.en: Marxist doctrine
examples.zh: 马克思主义学说

words.definition: to move quickly to avoid someone or something; subterfuge; escape, stay away from; avoid, shun
words.translation: 躲闪，躲开；躲闪；托词；躲避，避开

examples.en: He ran across the courtyard, dodging a storm of bullets.
examples.zh: 他跑过院子，躲避雨点般的子弹。

words.definition: unemployment benefit, unemployment pension
words.translation: 施舍，悲哀；[劳经]失业救济金；赈济物；施舍品

words.definition: an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, especially one that a particular person, organization etc deals with; province, territory, world, industry, kingdom, universe, field
words.translation: 领土，领域，范围；领域；域名；产业；地产

examples.en: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
examples.zh: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

words.definition: a round roof on a building; cupola
words.translation: 圆屋顶；[建]圆屋顶

examples.en: ...the dome of the Capitol.
examples.zh: …国会大厦的穹顶。

words.definition: relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries; a servant who works in a large house; internal, household, home, family; servant
words.translation: 家的，家庭的，本国的；佣人；国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的；国货

examples.en: Unfortunately his domestic life wasn’t very happy.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，他的家庭生活并不幸福。

words.definition: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things; ruling, predominant
words.translation: 支配的，统治的；显性的；[生物]占优势的；[数]支配的，统治的

examples.en: ...a change which would maintain his party's dominant position in Scotland.
examples.zh: …巩固他的政党在苏格兰支配地位的一场变革。

words.definition: to control someone or something or to have more importance than other people or things; possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle; advantage over, prevail over
words.translation: 统治，支配，俯瞰，俯视；控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位；处于支配地位

examples.en: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
examples.zh: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

examples.en: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
examples.zh: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

examples.en: Her loud voice totally dominated the conversation.
examples.zh: 她的大嗓门完全主导着这场谈话。

words.definition: something, especially money, that you give to a person or an organ-ization in order to help them; endowment, offertory
words.translation: 捐款，捐赠；捐款，[经]捐赠物；捐赠

examples.en: There have been generous donations from EU funds.
examples.zh: 欧盟基金给予了慷慨的捐款。

words.definition: to make someone or something certain to fail, die, be destroyed etc; death, sentence, end, award; fate, determine
words.translation: 毁灭，死亡；注定，判定；厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日；注定；使失败

examples.en: The plan was doomed from the start .
examples.zh: 这个计划一开始就注定要失败。

words.definition: not active or not growing at the present time but able to be active later; still, resting
words.translation: 休眠的，暂死的；休眠的；静止的；睡眠状态的；隐匿的

examples.en: a huge dormant volcano
examples.zh: 一座巨大的休眠火山

words.definition: the amount of a medicine or a drug that you should take; to give someone medicine or a drug; dosage, potion; take medicine; physic
words.translation: (药)一剂，一服；给服药；[药][核]剂量；一剂，一服；服药；给药；给…服药

examples.en: I quite like Jamie in small doses (= in limited amounts but not a lot or often ) .
examples.zh: 如果偶尔在一起的话，我还是蛮喜欢杰米的。

words.definition: a small round mark or spot; to mark something by putting a dot on it or above it; dowry, tocher
words.translation: 小点，小圆点；加上小点，散布于，点缀；[数]点，圆点；嫁妆

examples.en: a pattern of dots
examples.zh: 圆点图案

words.definition: not sure that something is true or right; suspicious, questionable
words.translation: 有疑问的；怀疑的；可疑的；令人生疑的；疑心的；不能确定的

examples.en: ‘Everything’s going to be all right, you’ll see.’ Jenny looked doubtful .
examples.zh: “一切都会顺顺当当的，你等着看好了。” 珍妮看起来不大相信的样子。

words.definition: used when saying that something is almost certain to happen or be true; easily, no doubt, probably, clearly, possibly; established, fixed, defined, certain, positive
words.translation: 无疑地；确定地；大概，多半；无疑的；确定的

examples.en: Doubtless there would be lots of rumours.
examples.zh: 无疑会谣言四起。

words.definition: a machine that takes people and goods from one level to another in a building; lift, moving staircase
words.translation: [美]电梯，升降机；电梯；[机]升降机；升降舵；起卸机

examples.en: We’ll have to take the elevator.
examples.zh: 我们只好坐电梯了。

words.definition: to succeed in getting information or a reaction from someone, especially when this is difficult; premise, attract, produce, cause, operate
words.translation: 引出，诱出；抽出，引出；引起

examples.en: When her knock elicited no response, she opened the door and peeped in.
examples.zh: 敲门没有回应，她便推开门往里张望。

words.definition: someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age; qualified, applicable, becoming, shaped, likely; acceptee
words.translation: 合格的，适宜的；合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的；合格者；适任者；有资格者

examples.en: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
examples.zh: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。

words.definition: to completely get rid of something that is unnecessary or unwanted; avoid, exclude
words.translation: 消灭，消除；消除；排除

examples.en: a ruthless dictator who eliminated all his rivals
examples.zh: 铲除所有异己的残酷独裁者

words.definition: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite; essence, flower, regular, prime, distillation
words.translation: 社会精华(的)，高贵者(的)；精英；精华；中坚分子

examples.en: ...a government comprised mainly of the elite.
examples.zh: …主要由精英组成的政府。

words.definition: able to express your ideas and opinions well, especially in a way that influences people; meaningful, affecting, significant, moving, speaking
words.translation: 雄辩的；意味深长的；雄辩的，有口才的；有说服力的；动人的

examples.en: an eloquent appeal for support
examples.zh: 极具说服力的求助呼吁

words.definition: in, at, or to another place; otherwhere
words.translation: 在别处，向别处；在别处；到别处

examples.en: She is becoming famous in Australia and elsewhere.
examples.zh: 她在澳大利亚和其他地方渐渐出名了。

examples.en: Kerala has less crime and alcoholism than elsewhere in India.
examples.zh: 喀拉拉邦的犯罪和酗酒现象少于印度的其他地区。

words.definition: an official order to stop trade with another country; ban, prohibition
words.translation: 禁止贸易；禁令；禁止；封港令

examples.en: Several countries embargoed arms shipments to Yugoslavia.
examples.zh: 好几个国家对南斯拉夫实行武器禁运。

words.definition: to go onto a ship or a plane, or to put or take something onto a ship or plane; wage, occupy in; imbark
words.translation: 上船；从事；开始；从事，着手；上船或飞机；使从事；使上船

examples.en: He's embarking on a new career as a writer.
examples.zh: 他正开始一个当作家的新生涯。

words.definition: to make someone feel ashamed, nervous, or uncomfortable, especially in front of other people; slow, abash
words.translation: 使为难，使尴尬；使局促不安；使困窘；阻碍

examples.en: He didn’t want to embarrass her by asking questions.
examples.zh: 他不想提问让她尴尬。

words.definition: a group of officials who represent their government in a foreign country, or the building they work in; ambassade, chancellery
words.translation: 大使馆；大使馆全体人员

examples.en: the American Embassy in Paris
examples.zh: 美国驻巴黎大使馆

words.definition: to put something firmly and deeply into something else, or to be put into something in this way; rear, bed
words.translation: 把嵌入，使扎根于社会，使深留脑中；栽种；使嵌入，使插入；使深留脑中

examples.en: Feelings of guilt are deeply embedded in her personality.
examples.zh: 负罪感在她的性格里根深蒂固。

words.definition: to be a very good example of an idea or quality; objectify, reify
words.translation: 体现；使具体化；体现，使具体化；具体表达

examples.en: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
examples.zh: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

words.definition: to put your arms around someone and hold them in a friendly or loving way; involve, contain; hug, cuddle; hug
words.translation: 拥抱；利用；包含；信奉，皈依

examples.en: Jack warmly embraced his son.
examples.zh: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

examples.en: Maggie and Laura embraced.
examples.zh: 玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

words.definition: to appear or come out from somewhere; ray, cast off
words.translation: 出现，浮现，暴露；浮现；摆脱；暴露

examples.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
examples.zh: 花儿在春天开放。

words.definition: an unexpected and dangerous situation that must be dealt with immediately; critical situation, bombshell; urgent, instant
words.translation: 紧急情况，突发事件；紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻；紧急的；备用的

examples.en: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
examples.zh: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

examples.en: (= In case of emergency ), press the alarm button.
examples.zh: 遇到紧急情况，请按报警按钮。

examples.en: The plane had to make an emergency landing.
examples.zh: 那架飞机不得不紧急着陆。

words.definition: to leave your own country in order to live in another country; transmigrate; to immigrate, to migrate
words.translation: 移居国外；移居；移居外国；移民

examples.en: He emigrated to Belgium.
examples.zh: 他移民去了比利时。

words.definition: an eminent person is famous, important, and respected; outstanding, excellent, obvious, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 著名的，卓越的；杰出的；有名的；明显的

examples.en: an eminent lawyer
examples.zh: 杰出的律师

words.definition: to send out gas, heat, light, sound etc; deliver, ray
words.translation: 散发；发射；发出，放射；发行；发表

examples.en: The kettle emitted a shrill whistle.
examples.zh: 水壶发出了刺耳的鸣笛声。

words.definition: a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger; mood, will, spirit, affect, feeling
words.translation: 感情；情绪；激动；[心理]情感

examples.en: Her voice was full of emotion.
examples.zh: 她的声音充满了激情。

examples.en: She was good at hiding her emotions.
examples.zh: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

examples.en: Kim received the news without showing any visible sign of emotion.
examples.zh: 金接到消息时丝毫不露声色。

words.definition: to say something in a strong way; stress, highlight
words.translation: 强调，加强的语气；强调，着重

examples.en: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
examples.zh: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

examples.en: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
examples.zh: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

words.definition: based on scientific testing or practical experience, not on ideas
words.translation: 经验主义的

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["empirical evidence"]}
examples.zh: 实验证据

words.definition: the act of paying someone to work for you; usage, utilization, profession, career, use, pursuit
words.translation: 职业；雇用；使用；[劳经]雇用

examples.en: She was offered employment in the sales office.
examples.zh: 她获聘在销售部工作。

words.definition: a short piece of writing giving someone’s ideas about politics, society etc; attempt, prose; sample, have a try
words.translation: 文章，小品文，随笔；散文；试图；随笔；尝试；对…做试验

examples.en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
examples.zh: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

words.definition: the most basic and important quality of something; substance, truth, principle, entity, texture
words.translation: 本质，香精；本质，实质；精华；[化工]香精

examples.en: In essence his message was very simple.
examples.zh: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

words.definition: elementary, fundamental, basic, necessary, primary; element, principle, entity, necessity, requirement, texture
words.translation: 本质(的)，必要(的)；基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的；本质；要素；要点；必需品

examples.en: She packed a few essentials.
examples.zh: 她把几件生活必需品装进箱子。

words.definition: to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time; build, found, constitute, put, station
words.translation: 建立，委任；安置；证实；确立；建立；创办

examples.en: The city of Boerne was established by German settlers in the 1840s.
examples.zh: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

examples.en: Our goal is to establish a new research centre in the North.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是在北方建立一个新的研究中心。

words.definition: law all of someone’s property and money, especially everything that is left after they die; identity, property, treasure, possession, worth
words.translation: 房地产；财产；[经]财产；身份

examples.en: His estate was valued at $150,000.
examples.zh: 他的遗产价值为15万美元。

words.definition: a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone; assess, honor, expect, evaluate, guess; estimation, respect, regard, worship
words.translation: 尊重，珍重；尊敬；认为；考虑；估价；尊重

examples.en: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
examples.zh: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

words.definition: a calculation of the value, size, amount etc of something made using the information that you have, which may not be complete; If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it; evaluate, guess at; computation, appraisal, calculation, assessment, judgment, evaluation, viewpoint; measure, value, score
words.translation: n.；估计，估价；评价，估量；判断，看法；估计，[数]估量；判断，评价

examples.en: We just need an estimate of the number of people who will come.
examples.zh: 我们只需估算一下有多少人会来。

examples.en: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.
examples.zh: 估计一下需要多少步才能到达一个近距目标。

examples.en: I estimate that total cost for treatment will go from $9,000 to $12,500.
examples.zh: 我估计治疗费总额将在9千美元到1.25万美元之间。

words.definition: continuing for ever and having no end; permanent, lasting, everlasting, undying, timeless
words.translation: 永久的，不朽的，不停的；永恒的；不朽的

examples.en: the Christian promise of eternal life
examples.zh: 基督教承诺的永生

examples.en: She’s an eternal optimist (= she always expects that good things will happen ).
examples.zh: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

words.definition: relating to a particular race, nation, or tribe and their customs and traditions; racial, tribal
words.translation: 种族的；人种学的；人种的

examples.en: The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.
examples.zh: 该校教授不同种族的小学生。

examples.en: ethnic Russians in Estonia
examples.zh: 居住在爱沙尼亚的俄罗斯人

examples.en: plans to partition the republic along ethnic lines
examples.zh: 按种族分割该共和国的计划

words.definition: the formal rules for polite behaviour in society or in a particular group; ceremony, manner, protocol
words.translation: 礼仪, 礼节 "；礼节，礼仪；规矩

examples.en: strict rules of professional etiquette
examples.zh: 严格的行规

words.definition: to send people away from a dangerous place to a safe place; withdraw, beat a retreat
words.translation: 撤离，疏散，排清；疏散，撤退；排泄；疏散；撤退

examples.en: Police evacuated the area.
examples.zh: 警方将该地区人员全部疏散。

words.definition: to avoid talking about something, especially because you are trying to hide something; get out of, elude; escape, get out of
words.translation: 回避, 躲避"；逃避；规避；逃脱

examples.en: I could tell that he was trying to evade the issue.
examples.zh: 我看得出他在极力回避这个问题。

examples.en: The minister evaded the question.
examples.zh: 部长回避了那个问题。

words.definition: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is; value, score, rate, prize; to assess, to appraise
words.translation: 估的价，定的值；评价；估价；求…的值

examples.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
examples.zh: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
examples.zh: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

examples.en: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
examples.zh: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

words.definition: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas; vapor; disappear, blank
words.translation: 使蒸发，使脱水，消失；使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失；蒸发，挥发；消失，失踪

examples.en: Most of the water had evaporated.
examples.zh: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

examples.en: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
examples.zh: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

words.definition: used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying; flat and level, with no parts that are higher than other parts; flat, equivalent, equal, level; actually, really, too, effectively, yet; equate with; flatten out
words.translation: 甚至还；平的，双数的；使平坦；[数]偶数的；平坦的；相等的；甚至；即使；还；实际上；使相等；变平；变得可比较；成为相等

examples.en: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
examples.zh: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

examples.en: It was quite difficult to see, even with the light on.
examples.zh: 这很难看得见，即使开着灯也没有用。

examples.en: He became quite successful and even appeared on a television show once.
examples.zh: 他相当成功，甚至还上了一次电视节目。

words.definition: after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened; finally, ultimately, lastly
words.translation: 终于，最后；最后，终于

examples.en: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
examples.zh: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

examples.en: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
examples.zh: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

words.definition: continuing for ever, even after someone has died; eternal, permanent, lasting, timeless
words.translation: 永久的，永恒的；永恒的；接连不断的

examples.en: everlasting fame
examples.zh: 永久的名声

examples.en: a symbol of God’s everlasting love
examples.zh: 上帝永恒之爱的象征

examples.en: a belief in life everlasting
examples.zh: 对永生的信念

words.definition: cast out, expel
words.translation: 驱逐；逐出

examples.en: One cleric resigned over plans to evict the protesters forcibly, arguing that the Church should have been more supportive of their cause.
examples.zh: 一位因为计划强行驱逐示威者而辞职的神职人员辩解说国教会应当给予他们更多的支持。

examples.en: It uses complex network analysis to identify where stealth attacks are taking place and provides the tools organisations need to evict the perpetrators and shore up the network against future threats.
examples.zh: 它使用复杂的网络分析，以确定哪些地方正在发生的隐蔽攻击，并提供必要的工具驱逐攻击者，支持网络抵御未来的威胁。

examples.en: The family saw off attempts by Britain's Royal Navy to evict them and also an attempt in 1978 by a group of German and Dutch businessmen to seize Sealand by force.
examples.zh: 但英国海军却多次试图将贝茨家族从“海国”驱逐出去。 1978年，一群来自德国和荷兰的商人曾试图通过武力占领这块“领土”。

words.definition: to produce a strong feeling or memory in someone; earn, attract, cause, produce, occasion
words.translation: 唤起；引起；引起，唤起；博得

examples.en: The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
examples.zh: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

examples.en: His appearance is bound to evoke sympathy.
examples.zh: 他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。

examples.en: Her speech evoked a hostile response.
examples.zh: 她的讲话引起了敌对的反应。

words.definition: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; unfolding, Monkey to Man
words.translation: 演变，进展，进化；演变；[进化]进化论；进展

examples.en: the theory of evolution
examples.zh: 进化论

words.definition: to make a bad situation worse; anger, aggravate
words.translation: 加重；恶化；使加剧；使恶化；激怒

examples.en: The recession has exacerbated this problem.
examples.zh: 经济衰退使这个问题更加严重。

examples.en: I don’t want to exacerbate the situation.
examples.zh: 我不想使情况变得更糟。

words.definition: to make something seem better, larger, worse etc than it really is; enlarge, broaden; put it on, pile it on
words.translation: 夸大，夸张；使扩大；使增大；夸大；夸张

examples.en: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
examples.zh: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

words.definition: to make someone very annoyed by continuing to do something that upsets them; anger, go ill
words.translation: 激怒，使恼火；恶化；使恼怒；激怒

examples.en: It exasperates me to hear comments like that.
examples.zh: 听到那样的评论令我恼怒。

words.definition: one of several parts of someone’s character, a situation etc; aspect, side, respect
words.translation: 刻面，(问题的)一个方面；面；方面；小平面

examples.en: The issues are complex and multi-faceted.
examples.zh: 这些问题很复杂，涉及诸多方面。

words.definition: promote, boost, further
words.translation: 使便利；促进；帮助；使容易

examples.en: Modern inventions facilitate housework.
examples.zh: 许多现代发明便利了家务劳动。

examples.en: All of these agencies and people either complement or facilitate our work, or express the health needs of populations.
examples.zh: 所有这些机构和人士要么补充或便利我们的工作，要么表达人民的卫生需求。

words.definition: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose; equipment, furniture, establishment, plant, fixture
words.translation: 灵巧，熟练；设备；设施；容易；灵巧

examples.en: What recreational facilities are now available?
examples.zh: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

words.definition: one of several things that influence or cause a situation; element, deputy, agent, basic, essential
words.translation: 因素，要素；因素；[经]要素；[物]因数；代理人

examples.en: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
examples.zh: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

words.definition: a department or group of related departments within a university; ability, capacity, competence, department, power
words.translation: 才能；(大学的)系科；学院全体教员；科，系；能力；全体教员

examples.en: the Engineering Faculty
examples.zh: 工程学院

words.definition: to gradually disappear; peter, color fading; discolor; stupid, literal-minded
words.translation: (使)褪色，逐渐消失；褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失；使褪色；平淡的；乏味的

examples.en: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
examples.zh: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

examples.en: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
examples.zh: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

words.definition: Fahrenheit is also a noun; Farenheit thermometer, Fah
words.translation: 华氏温度计；华氏温标

examples.en: He was asked for the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit.
examples.zh: 有人问他华氏温标下水的沸点。

words.definition: difficult to see, hear, smell etc; to suddenly become unconscious for a short time; fuzzy, weak, dark, vague; pass out, flake out; asphyxy, swound
words.translation: 微弱的，不清楚的；昏晕；模糊的；头晕的；[医]虚弱的；衰弱的；昏倒；变得微弱；变得没气力；[中医]昏厥，昏倒

examples.en: She gave a faint smile.
examples.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

examples.en: a very faint noise
examples.zh: 很微弱的声响

examples.en: the faint light of dawn
examples.zh: 微弱的晨光

words.definition: a strong feeling of trust or confidence in someone or something; belief, confidence, trust, credit, loyalty
words.translation: 信任，信仰；信仰；信念；信任；忠实

examples.en: People have lost faith in the government.
examples.zh: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

words.definition: a copy of a valuable object, painting etc that is intended to deceive people; to make something seem real in order to deceive people
words.translation: 假货，骗子；伪造

examples.en: The painting was judged a fake.
examples.zh: 这幅画被鉴定为赝品。

examples.en: Jones can spot a fake from 20 feet away.
examples.zh: 琼斯在20英尺开外就能认出假货。

words.definition: to move or drop down from a higher position to a lower position; become, come, lower; reduction, decline, autumn; floor, cut sth down; autumn
words.translation: 落下，降落，倒坍，垂下；落下；变成；来临；减弱；[气象]下降；秋天；瀑布；砍倒；击倒；秋天的

examples.en: The tree was about to fall.
examples.zh: 那棵树快要倒下了。

examples.en: The book fell from his hands.
examples.zh: 书从他手上跌落。

examples.en: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
examples.zh: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

words.definition: a false idea or belief, especially one that a lot of people believe is true; idola, paralogism
words.translation: 谬论；谬论，谬误

examples.en: It’s a common fallacy that a neutered dog will become fat and lazy.
examples.zh: 说阉割过的狗会变得又胖又懒，这是普遍的谬见。

words.definition: able to make mistakes or be wrong; unreliable, irresponsible
words.translation: 易犯错误的，错误难免的；易犯错误的；不可靠的

examples.en: Humans are fallible.
examples.zh: 人孰无过。

examples.en: These surveys are often a rather fallible guide to public opinion.
examples.zh: 这些调查往往会对舆论产生误导。

words.definition: to shine suddenly and brightly for a short time, or to make something shine in this way; reflect, mirror; stroboflash, coruscation; reflect, flare light; shot, coruscant
words.translation: 闪光，闪现；简讯，浮华；使闪光；反射；一瞬间；闪光的，火速的

examples.en: Lightning flashed overhead.
examples.zh: 头顶上电光闪闪。

examples.en: Red warning lights flashed on and off (= shone for a short time and then stopped shining ) .
examples.zh: 红色警告灯一闪一闪。

words.definition: a  hip flask; lagena, winebottle
words.translation: 细颈瓶，扁形酒瓶；[分化]烧瓶；长颈瓶，细颈瓶；酒瓶，携带瓶

examples.en: He took out a metal flask from a canvas bag.
examples.zh: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。

words.definition: please, glad, satisfy
words.translation: 阿谀，使高兴；(肖像)等胜过(真人真物)；奉承；谄媚；使高兴

examples.en: That dress really flatters your figure.
examples.zh: 那件连衣裙很显你的身材。

words.definition: to show your money, success, beauty etc so that other people notice it – used to show disapproval; show off, fly over; flow, stream, dance; display, showing off

examples.zh: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

examples.zh: 拖动火车的蒸汽机车

examples.zh: 我用力拽上了门。

words.translation: 安全处所，避难所；港口；避难所，安息所

examples.zh: …百瑞高湖，一个适合各种鸟类的淡水栖息地。

examples.en: That pile of rubbish is a fire hazard (= something that is likely to cause a fire ).
examples.zh: 那堆垃圾是火灾隐患。

words.definition: dangerous, especially to people’s health or safety; risky, jeopardous
words.translation: 冒险的；有危险的；碰运气的

examples.en: the disposal of hazardous waste
examples.zh: 有害废弃物的处理

words.definition: a mixture of loud noises, especially the noise of a lot of people talking at the same time; combustion, turmoil
words.translation: 吵闹，喧哗；喧哗；骚动

examples.zh: 市场的嘈杂声

words.definition: if a group of people huddle together, they stay very close to each other, especially because they are cold or frightened; a group of people or things that are close together, but not arranged in any particular order, pattern, or system; gather up, cower; chaos, disorder, confusion, congestion, involvement
words.translation: 挤作一团，乱堆；一堆，一团；蜷缩；挤作一团；拥挤；混乱；杂乱一团

examples.zh: 我们紧紧挤在一起取暖。

examples.zh: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

examples.zh: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

words.definition: to make a low continuous sound; groaning, zoom; uh-uh, um
words.translation: 嗡嗡叫，嘈杂声；嗡嗡声；哼声；杂声；哼；嗯

examples.zh: 机器在车间里嗡嗡作响。

examples.zh: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

examples.en: crimes against humanity
examples.zh: 反人类罪

words.definition: not considering yourself or your ideas to be as important as other people’s
words.translation: 谦卑的，恭顺的，简陋的；使卑下，贬抑

examples.zh: 一个谦卑的男人

words.definition: boring and ordinary, and having no variety or interest; flat, blank, boring, monotonous; monotonousness, prosiness

examples.zh: ...她整天做着单调乏味的工作但收入颇丰的律师丈夫。

words.definition: the amount of water contained in the air; wet, moisture capacity

examples.zh: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

words.translation: 使羞辱，使丢脸；羞辱；使…丢脸；耻辱

examples.en: Her boss humiliated her in front of all her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

words.definition: to throw something with a lot of force, especially because you are angry; let drop
words.translation: 猛掷，猛投；丢下；用力投掷；愤慨地说出

examples.en: Demonstrators were hurling bricks through the windows.
examples.zh: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

examples.en: He hurled a chair across the set, smashing lamps and vases.
examples.zh: 他抓起一把椅子扔向片场的那头，把灯和花瓶都砸得粉碎。

words.definition: a storm that has very strong fast winds and that moves over water; cyclone, storms
words.translation: 飓风；飓风，[气象]暴风

examples.en: The hurricane devastated a large section of the coast.
examples.zh: 飓风毁坏了沿海地区的大部分。

examples.en: The hurricane demage was assessed at three million dollars.
examples.zh: 飓风损害赔偿金的金额被确定为三百万美元。

examples.en: The building can accommodate all of the offshore workers and protect them from hurricane damage.
examples.zh: 这个建筑能容纳所有的海上工人并且保护他们不受飓风的伤害。

words.definition: Hydrogen is a colourless gas that is the lightest and commonest element in the universe
words.translation: 氢气

examples.zh: 水含有氢和氧。

examples.en: Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
examples.zh: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

examples.en: The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
examples.zh: 从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

words.definition: the practice of keeping yourself and the things around you clean in order to prevent diseases; health

examples.zh: 食品卫生培训课程

examples.zh: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

examples.zh: 珍妮特歇斯底里起来，开始尖叫。

examples.zh: 演播室里的每个人都爆发出一阵狂笑。

examples.zh: 沃尔特·迪斯尼坚持他的理想。

words.definition: exactly the same, or very similar; self, same
words.translation: 同一的，完全相似的；[数]同一的；完全相同的

examples.en: four identical houses
examples.zh: 四幢一模一样的房子

words.definition: to recognize and correctly name someone or something; confirm, recognize, ascertain; cotton, square
words.translation: 认出，认为与一致；确定；[计]识别；使参与；把…看成一样；认同；一致

examples.zh: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

examples.en: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
examples.zh: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

examples.zh: 作为一种身份证明方式的指纹提取

examples.zh: 警探提醒说这些人可能会造成严重伤害。

examples.zh: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

examples.zh: 很多鱼都有绝妙的方法来保护它们产的卵不被捕食者吃掉。

examples.zh: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

examples.zh: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

examples.zh: 很多野生动物栖居在这片森林里。

examples.zh: 有人居住的岛屿

examples.zh: 有600万居民的城市

examples.zh: 每笔生意本身都有风险。

examples.zh: 不幸福的家庭生活可能会阻碍儿童的学习。

examples.zh: 5,000英镑的初始投资

examples.zh: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

words.definition: institute, start in; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, fresh

examples.zh: 他们决定向该报提起法律诉讼。

words.translation: 发端，创始，主动性；主动权；首创精神；主动的；自发的；起始的

examples.zh: 我希望我的儿子能表现得再主动一些。

examples.zh: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

examples.zh: 卡洛斯中尉没有服从命令，而是自作主张。

words.translation: 注射；注入，灌入；注入

examples.zh: 他的儿子被注射了强效的药。

examples.zh: 东南部最大的内陆水域

examples.zh: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

examples.zh: 法庭判他无罪，他被释放了。

examples.zh: 她过去一直认为格雷格在关于女人方面是一个不可救药的无知者。

words.translation: 创新，改革；创新，革新；新方法

examples.zh: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

examples.zh: 很多人对技术革新的速度感到不知所措。

words.translation: 数不清的；无数的，数不清的

examples.zh: 她在多个委员会担任委员。

words.translation: 打听，询问；询问；查究；问明；询价

examples.zh: “你为什么这么做？”男孩问道。

examples.zh: 托比本想问更多的问题。

words.translation: 愚蠢的; 疯狂的；疯狂的；精神病的；极愚蠢的

examples.zh: 那是疯狂的冒险之举。

examples.zh: 整个主意在我看来荒谬至极。

examples.zh: 他从衣袋里掏出一把小钥匙，然后缓缓地将其插入锁孔里。

examples.zh: 他开第二枪时，枪卡壳了。

examples.zh: 一条绳子卡住了船的推进器。
