words.definition: something that is put inside an envelope with a letter; attachment, attached sheet
words.translation: 围栏；附件；[建]围墙；围场

examples.en: the enclosure of arable land for pasture
examples.zh: 将耕地圈起来用作牧场

words.definition: to experience something, especially problems or opposition; confront, bring up against; fell in with, lit on; bring up against, run into
words.translation: 遭遇，意外地遇到；遭遇，邂逅；遇到；遭遇，偶然碰见；遭遇；偶然相遇

examples.en: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
examples.zh: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

words.definition: a book or cd, or a set of these, containing facts about many different subjects, or containing detailed facts about one subject; cyclopaedia
words.translation: 百科全书

examples.en: the Encyclopedia of Music
examples.zh: 音乐百科全书

words.definition: a situation in which something is finished or no longer exists; completion, death, target, goal, object; drop, determine, pass; conclude, bring to a close
words.translation: 末端，尽头，结束；结束；目标；尽头；末端；死亡；结束，终止；终结

examples.en: At last it seemed the war might be coming to an end.
examples.zh: 终于战争似乎即将结束。

examples.en: The spacecraft is nearing the end of its useful life.
examples.zh: 该航天器的使用寿命快要终结。

examples.en: Well, I hope that’s the end of the matter.
examples.zh: 好啦，我希望事情就到此为止。

words.definition: effort, pain, struggle, trial, try; apply oneself, struggle, labor, strain, try one's best; apply oneself, try one's best
words.translation: 努力，力图；努力；尽力（等于endeavour）

examples.en: She improved visibly from day to day, until Martin wondered if he was doing right, for he knew that all her compliance and endeavor was for his sake.
examples.zh: 她一天比一天进步了，直到马丁怀疑起自己的做法是否得体。 因为他明白她的这一切迁就和努力都是为了他。

examples.en: The energy, the faith, the devotion which we bring to this endeavor will light our country and all who serve it -- and the glow from that fire can truly light the world.
examples.zh: 我们在这场努力中所献出的精力、信念与虔诚、将照亮我们的国家以及所有为国家服务的人，而从这一火焰所聚出的光辉必能照明全世界。

examples.en: We cannot succeed in this endeavor alone, but we can lead it.
examples.zh: 我们不可能独自完成这项努力，但我们可以发挥带头作用。

words.definition: to express formal support or approval for someone or something; ink, allow, back, sign
words.translation: 背书，签署(姓名)，赞同；背书；认可；签署；赞同；在背面签名

examples.en: I can endorse their opinion wholeheartedly.
examples.zh: 我可以全心全意地支持他们的观点。

words.definition: to give a college, hospital etc a large sum of money that provides it with an income; gift, put
words.translation: 捐款，资助；赋予；捐赠；天生具有

examples.en: The ambassador has endowed a $1 million public-service fellowships programme.
examples.zh: 大使资助了一个100万美元的公共服务奖学金项目。

words.definition: the ability to continue doing something difficult or painful over a long period of time; staying power, patience with
words.translation: 忍耐力，忍耐；忍耐力；忍耐；持久；耐久

examples.en: She was pushed beyond her powers of endurance.
examples.zh: 她被逼得忍无可忍。

examples.en: The marathon is a test of endurance.
examples.zh: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的考验。

words.definition: having or needing a lot of energy or determination; active, positive, male, live, vigorous
words.translation: 精力充沛的；精力旺盛的；积极的；有力的

examples.en: an energetic man
examples.zh: 精力旺盛的男子

examples.en: an energetic drive to get more customers
examples.zh: 争取更多客户的十足干劲

words.definition: to make people obey a rule or law; perform, actualize
words.translation: 强迫服从；实施；加强；实施，执行；强迫，强制

examples.en: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
examples.zh: 停车限制将会严格执行。

words.definition: to attract someone’s attention and keep them interested; attract, absorb, draw, appropriate, budget; comply, wage
words.translation: 雇用；从事；订婚；吸引；啮合；吸引，占用；使参加；雇佣；使订婚；预定；答应，保证；交战

examples.en: She engaged the clutch and the car moved.
examples.zh: 她踩下离合器，汽车便开动了。

words.definition: an agreement between two people to marry, or the period of time they are engaged; date, word, contract
words.translation: 订婚；约会，交战；婚约；约会；交战；诺言

examples.en: Their engagement was announced in the paper.
examples.zh: 他们订婚的消息在报上公布了。

examples.en: Tony was stunned when Lisa suddenly broke off their engagement (= finished it ).
examples.zh: 托尼对莉萨突然解除他俩的婚约感到震惊。

words.definition: to be impossible to forget; brand, heart, grave
words.translation: 刻上；铭记；雕刻

examples.en: Your wedding ring can be engraved with a personal inscription at no extra cost.
examples.zh: 你的结婚戒指可以刻上个人题字不另收费。

words.definition: if something engrosses you, it interests you so much that you do not notice anything else; absorb, attract, draw, engage
words.translation: 占用；吸引；使全神贯注；用大字体书写；正式写成（决议等）；独占

examples.en: The scene was stunning, and for a time engrossed all our attention.
examples.zh: 景色非常美丽，一时间把我们都完全吸引住了。

words.definition: to improve something; raise, cement, boost, muscle, gain
words.translation: 提高(强度、力量、数量等)，增加(进)；提高；加强；增加

examples.en: Good lighting will enhance any room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

examples.en: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
examples.zh: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

words.definition: to explain something to someone; suggest, channel, wise
words.translation: 启发，开导；启发，启蒙；教导，开导；照耀

examples.en: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
examples.zh: 少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。

words.definition: if a scientist or archaeologist excavates an area of land, they dig carefully to find ancient objects, bones etc; to dig, tap into
words.translation: 挖掘，挖出；挖掘；开凿

examples.en: Schliemann excavated the ancient city of Troy.
examples.zh: 谢里曼发掘出特洛伊古城。

words.definition: to be more than a particular number or amount; better than, overcome, top, cap, outdo
words.translation: 比大，超出；超过；胜过

examples.en: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
examples.zh: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

examples.en: His performance exceeded our expectations.
examples.zh: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

words.definition: extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 非常, 极端地"；非常；极其；极度地；极端

words.definition: to do something very well, or much better than most people; overcome, cap
words.translation: 杰出，胜过，优于；优于，胜过；擅长

examples.en: You have excelled yourself with the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 你新办的这次展览特别成功。

words.definition: unusually good; novel, exquisite
words.translation: 异常的，优越的；异常的，例外的

examples.en: an exceptional student
examples.zh: 出类拔萃的学生

examples.en: exceptional bravery
examples.zh: 非凡的勇气

words.definition: a short piece taken from a book, poem, piece of music etc; extract, citing; reference, extract, cite; reference, quote
words.translation: 摘录，节录；摘录，引用；引用，摘录

examples.en: ...an excerpt from Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker.
examples.zh: …柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子》选段。

words.definition: more than a particular amount; Excess is used to refer to additional amounts of money that need to be paid for services and activities that were not originally planned or taken into account; immoderation, exorbitance; additional, added, attached, extra, plus
words.translation: 超越；超过；暴行；额外的，附加的；超过，超额；过度，过量；无节制；额外的，过量的；附加的

examples.en: The car reached speeds in excess of 100 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 这辆汽车的时速超过了100英里。

examples.en: Make sure that you don't have to pay expensive excess charges.
examples.zh: 确保你不需要支付昂贵的额外费用。

words.definition: the act of giving someone something and receiving something else from them; communication, conversion; turn, truck; trade, traffic
words.translation: 交换；兑换；[通信][计]交换；交流；交易所；[金融]兑换；交易

examples.en: Four of my cassettes for your Madonna CD is a fair exchange.
examples.zh: 我用四盒磁带换你的麦当娜激光唱片很公平。

words.definition: to say something suddenly and loudly because you are surprised, angry, or excited; bay, shout
words.translation: 呼叫，惊叫；呼喊，惊叫；大声叫嚷

examples.en: ‘No!’ she exclaimed in shock.
examples.zh: “不！”她惊呼道。

words.definition: to deliberately not include something; preclude, rule out
words.translation: 把某人排除在外，排除(可能性等)；排除；排斥；拒绝接纳；逐出

examples.en: a special diet that excludes dairy products
examples.zh: 不包含奶制品的特别食谱

examples.en: The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly attained.
examples.zh: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

words.definition: exclusive places, organizations, clothes etc are so expensive that not many people can afford to use or buy them; particular, antiforeign; scoop
words.translation: 孤傲的；不愿吸收新会员的；索价高昂的；独有的；排外的；专一的；独家新闻；独家经营的项目；排外者

examples.en: Bel Air is an exclusive suburb of Los Angeles.
examples.zh: 贝莱尔是洛杉矶郊外一处高级住宅区。

examples.en: an exclusive girls’ school
examples.zh: 贵族女子学校

words.definition: Exclusively is used to refer to situations or activities that involve only the thing or things mentioned, and nothing else; solely
words.translation: 专门地，排除其他地；唯一地；专有地；排外地

examples.en: ...an exclusively male domain.
examples.zh: …一个由男性独占的领域。

words.definition: the solid waste material that you get rid of through your bowels; faeces, night soil
words.translation: 排泄物，粪便；粪便，[生理]排泄物

examples.en: The cage smelled of excrement.
examples.zh: 这个笼子闻起来有粪便味。

words.definition: a short journey arranged so that a group of people can visit a place, especially while they are on holiday; skewing, short trip
words.translation: 远足，短途旅行；偏移；远足；短程旅行；离题；游览圆

examples.en: a shopping excursion
examples.zh: 购物游

words.definition: to kill someone, especially legally as a punishment; perform, implement, enforce
words.translation: 实行，贯彻，实施；处死；演奏；实行；执行

examples.en: 13 people were summarily executed (= killed without any trial or legal process ) by the guerrillas.
examples.zh: 有13人被游击队员就地处决。

words.definition: when someone is killed, especially as a legal punishment; enforcement, completion, achievement, performance, implementing
words.translation: 演奏技巧；死刑；[计]执行，实行；完成

examples.en: a public execution
examples.zh: 当众处死

examples.en: The two men face execution (= They will be killed as a punishment ).
examples.zh: 两名男子面临处决。

examples.en: Torture and summary execution (= execution without a trial or any legal process ) are common.
examples.zh: 严刑拷打和不经审判就地处决相当普遍。

words.definition: relating to the job of managing a business or organization and making decisions; the part of a government that makes sure decisions and laws work well; administrative, front-office; manager, gerente
words.translation: 执行的，行政的；行政部门，行政人员；[计]行政的；经营的；执行的，经营管理的；经理；执行委员会；[计]执行者；经理主管人员

examples.en: a commission with executive powers
examples.zh: 有执行权的委员会

words.definition: to give an example of something; example of, instantiate
words.translation: 举例说明，作为的例证；例证；例示

examples.en: Problems are exemplified in the report.
examples.zh: 问题都在报告中作了举例说明。

words.definition: discharge, forgive
words.translation: 免除，被豁免的；免除；豁免

examples.en: So we have the current argument over how much of the derivative market will be exempt from regulation.
examples.zh: 所以我们就看到了当前有关衍生产品市场到底有多大份额可以得到规则的豁免的辩论。

examples.en: All the new rules do is exempt the user from legal liability - something Apple does not appear to be pursuing anyway.
examples.zh: 新法规做到的仅仅是免除了用户的法律责任 - 看起来苹果本来也不打算追究这种责任。

examples.en: So empirical approaches to literature, the simple observation of data from which one can generalize -they exempt these from the general charge against literary theory.
examples.zh: 文学的经验主义研究方法，对我们所概括的事物的简单数据观察,对文学理论的普遍控诉中,他们免除了这些。

words.definition: handle, to put to use
words.translation: 发挥，行使，尽力；运用，发挥；施以影响

examples.en: He has exerted himself tirelessly on behalf of the charity.
examples.zh: 他为这个慈善组织奋斗不懈。

words.definition: a pipe on a car or machine that waste gases pass through; issue, drain out; air out; air discharge, flue gas
words.translation: 排气；抽空，汲光；排出；耗尽；使精疲力尽；彻底探讨；废气；排气装置

examples.en: exhaust fumes
examples.zh: 排出的废气

words.definition: to make someone feel very excited and happy; glad, please, satisfy
words.translation: 使振奋，使高兴；使高兴，使振奋；使愉快

words.definition: to try very hard to persuade someone to do something; sound advice, advise; give advice, advise to
words.translation: 劝告；忠告；劝诫

examples.en: Kennedy exhorted his listeners to turn away from violence.
examples.zh: 肯尼迪劝告他的听众要远离暴力。

words.definition: to speak in a voice that sounds weak and uncertain, and keeps stopping; mouch; hesitancy, vacillation
words.translation: 蹒跚；声音发抖；支吾；蹒跚地走；踌躇；颤抖

examples.en: Laurie’s voice faltered as she tried to thank him.
examples.zh: 劳丽想谢谢他，却说得结结巴巴的。

examples.en: ‘I can’t,’ she faltered.
examples.zh: “我做不到。”她支支吾吾地说道。

words.definition: the state of being known about by a lot of people because of your achievements; tradition, celebrity, tale
words.translation: 名声，名誉；名声，名望；传闻，传说

examples.en: He claims he is not really interested in fame.
examples.zh: 他称自己对出名真的没有兴趣。

words.definition: someone or something that is familiar is well-known to you and easy to recognize; conventional, near, close; frequenter, regular customer
words.translation: 熟悉的，通晓的；亲密的，常见的；熟悉的；常见的；亲近的；常客；密友

examples.en: a familiar tune
examples.zh: 熟悉的曲调

examples.en: It was a relief to be back in familiar surroundings .
examples.zh: 回到熟悉的环境里让人松了一口气。

examples.en: Beggars on the street are becoming a familiar sight .
examples.zh: 街上出现乞丐的情况逐渐变得屡见不鲜。

words.definition: a situation in which a large number of people have little or no food for a long time and many people die; hunger, fames
words.translation: 饥荒；饥饿，奇缺

examples.en: the great potato famine in Ireland
examples.zh: 爱尔兰严重的土豆荒

examples.en: A million people are facing famine .
examples.zh: 一百万人正面临饥荒。

words.definition: someone who has extreme political or religious ideas and is often dangerous; bigot; crazy, wild, enthusiastic
words.translation: 狂热的，狂热者；狂热入迷者；盲信者；盲信；狂热的；盲信的

examples.en: fanatics who represent a real danger to democracy
examples.zh: 对民主构成很大威胁的狂热分子

examples.en: a religious fanatic
examples.zh: 宗教狂热分子

words.definition: fancy food is of a high quality; interest, like, fantasy; expensive, rich, ideal, picked, dear; enjoy, vision, image; have vision of, to imagine
words.translation: 颜色鲜艳的;奇特的n&v想象力,设想,爱好；幻想；想像力；爱好；想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的；想象；喜爱；设想；自负

examples.en: Harry took me to a fancy restaurant for our anniversary.
examples.zh: 哈里带我去了一家豪华餐厅，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

words.definition: extremely good, attractive, enjoyable etc; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great; weirdo, geezer
words.translation: 奇异的；荒谬的，极好的；空想的；极好的；不可思议的；古怪的人

examples.en: You look fantastic!
examples.zh: 你看上去棒极了！

examples.en: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
examples.zh: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

words.definition: an exciting and unusual experience or situation you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen; fancy, illusion; visional; imagine, picture, think of; stargaze
words.translation: 幻想，怪念头；[心理]幻想；白日梦；幻觉；虚幻的；空想；想像；耽于幻想；奏幻想曲（等于phantasy）

examples.en: I used to have fantasies about living in Paris with an artist.
examples.zh: 我过去常幻想着在巴黎与一位艺术家同住。

examples.en: sexual fantasies
examples.zh: 性幻想

examples.en: Young children sometimes can’t distinguish between fantasy and reality.
examples.zh: 小孩子有时不能区分幻想与现实。

words.definition: a passenger in a taxi; round, advance; passenger, food, fee, charge, diet
words.translation: 车(船)费；经营；进展；遭遇；过活；票价；费用；旅客；食物

examples.en: He could barely afford the fare.
examples.zh: 他几乎付不起车费。

words.definition: the action of saying goodbye; adieux, leave-taking; tara; valedictory
words.translation: 再见；临别的，告别的；告别，辞别；再会；别了！（常含有永别或不容易再见面的意思）；再会！；告别的

examples.en: Mourners gathered to bid farewell to the victims of the plane tragedy.
examples.zh: 哀悼者来向空难受害者告别。

examples.en: a farewell speech
examples.zh: 告别演说

words.definition: if someone or something fascinates you, you are attracted to them and think they are extremely interesting; enthrall, beguile; be carried away
words.translation: 使神魂颠倒，迷住；使着迷，使神魂颠倒；入迷

examples.en: The idea of travelling through time fascinates me.
examples.zh: 穿越时光的想法深深吸引着我。

words.definition: extremely interesting; attractive, killing, taking, absorbing, engaging; captivating
words.translation: 迷人的；吸引人的；使人神魂颠倒的；使…着迷；使…陶醉（fascinate的ing形式）

examples.en: a fascinating book
examples.zh: 一本引人入胜的书

examples.en: That sounds absolutely fascinating .
examples.zh: 那听起来极具吸引力。

words.definition: very careful about small details in your appearance, work etc; particular, demanding
words.translation: 难讨好的，爱挑剔的；挑剔的；苛求的，难取悦的；（微生物等）需要复杂营养地

examples.en: people who are fastidious about personal hygiene
examples.zh: 十分讲究个人卫生的人

words.definition: resulting in someone’s death; important, significant, great, fell, kill
words.translation: 致命的，命运的，注定的；[生物][医]致命的；重大的；毁灭性的；命中注定的

examples.en: potentially fatal diseases
examples.zh: 潜在致命的疾病

examples.en: If it is not treated correctly, the condition can prove fatal (= be fatal ) .
examples.zh: 如果治疗不当，这种病可能会致命。

words.definition: very great tiredness; tiredness, weariness; wear down; tire
words.translation: 疲劳，(金属)疲劳，杂役；[生理][心理][力]疲劳，疲乏；杂役；[生理][心理][力]使疲劳；使心智衰弱；[生理][心理][力]疲劳

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["metal fatigue"]}
examples.zh: 金属疲劳

words.definition: very silly or stupid; imbecilic, mullet-headed
words.translation: 愚昧的；蠢的；愚笨的；昏庸的；发呆的；自满的

examples.en: fatuous questions
examples.zh: 愚昧的问题

words.definition: if something bad that has happened is your fault, you should be blamed for it, because you made a mistake or failed to do something; error, deficiency, defect, mistake, trouble; mistake, err in; carp at, trip up
words.translation: 缺点；毛病，过错；(地质)断层；故障；[地质]断层；错误；毛病；（网球等）发球失误；弄错；产生断层；（通常用于疑问句或否定句）挑剔

examples.en: I’m really sorry - it’s all my fault.
examples.zh: 我真的很抱歉——都是我的错。

examples.en: I didn’t sleep well that night, but it was my own fault .
examples.zh: 那天晚上我没有睡好，但这是我自己的问题。

words.definition: If you favour someone, you treat them better or in a kinder way than you treat other people; acceptance, preference, good, mercy; enjoy, agree, aid, uphold
words.translation: 好感，赞成，偏爱；偏爱；赞同；善行；赞成；喜爱；有助于

examples.en: The company has no rules about favouring U.S. citizens during layoffs.
examples.zh: 该公司没有在裁员期间偏袒美国公民的规定。

words.definition: used to say how something is done or happens; within, inside; modern, fashionable, tony

words.translation: 用力举起；说出；掷扔；举，拉，扔；举起；使起伏；投掷；恶心；发出（叹息等）；起伏；喘息；呕吐；一阵呕吐

examples.en: Michael’s shoulders heaved with silent laughter.
examples.zh: 迈克尔憋着不笑出声来，双肩直抖。

examples.en: The sea heaved up and down beneath the boat.
examples.zh: 船的下面大海波涛汹涌。

words.definition: flushing; crazy, wild, enthusiastic
words.translation: 闹哄哄的，兴奋的；脸红；患肺结核；兴奋的，狂热的；脸上发红；肺病的

examples.en: I’ve had a pretty hectic day.
examples.zh: 我忙乱了一整天。

words.definition: a row of small bushes or trees growing close together, usually dividing one field or garden from another; bar, obstacle, dam, let, stop
words.translation: 围树篱；障碍；躲闪；推诿；[建]树篱

words.definition: if something heightens a feeling, effect etc, or if a feeling etc heightens, it becomes stronger or increases; enhance, raise, cement, muscle; strengthen, breeze up
words.translation: 加高，提高；增大；提高；增高；加强；使更显著；升高；变强

examples.en: There are fears that the march will heighten racial tension.
examples.zh: 有人担心这次游行会加深种族间的紧张局势。

examples.en: Increased levels of fat in the diet could heighten the risk of cancer.
examples.zh: 饮食中脂肪摄入量的提升会增加患癌症的风险。

words.definition: the person who has the legal right to receive the property or title of another person when they die; heritor, haeres
words.translation: 继承人；[法]继承人；后嗣；嗣子

examples.en: Jonson was his political heir as leader of the party.
examples.zh: 琼森是他的政治接班人，他将担任该党派的领袖。

words.definition: a type of aircraft with large metal blades on top which turn around very quickly to make it fly; copter, whirlybird, verticraft
words.translation: 直升飞机；[航]直升飞机

examples.en: You can helicopter to the island.
examples.zh: 你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。

examples.en: The helicopter is staying over our heads.
examples.zh: 那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。

examples.en: They were succoured from the fire by the rescue helicopter.
examples.zh: 他们被援救的直升机从大火中解救了出来。

words.definition: the place where the souls of bad people are believed to be punished after death, especially in the Christian and Muslim religions; Sam Hill, sheol; rocket, ball it up; d*amn, Gadsbodikins
words.translation: 地狱；阴间；苦境；究竟（作加强语气词）；训斥；黑暗势力；过放荡生活；飞驰；该死；见鬼（表示惊奇、烦恼、厌恶、恼怒、失望等）

examples.en: War is hell.
examples.zh: 战争是人间地狱。

words.definition: a half of the Earth, especially one of the halves above and below the  equator; semisphere
words.translation: 半球，(地球的)半球；[天]半球

examples.en: the Northern hemisphere
examples.zh: 北半球

words.definition: for this reason; therefore, accordingly, consequently, thus, as a result of
words.translation: 从此地，从此时，因此；因此；今后

examples.en: The cost of transport is a major expense for an industry. Hence factory location is an important consideration.
examples.zh: 运输成本是企业的一大支出，因此工厂选址是重要的考虑因素。

words.definition: forwards, hereafter
words.translation: 同义于 henceforward今后；今后；自此以后

examples.en: multiple sclerosis (henceforth referred to as MS)
examples.zh: 多发性硬化（以下称为MS）

words.definition: a small plant that is used to improve the taste of food, or to make medicine; bouquet garni, vanilla
words.translation: 草本植物;药草；香草，[植]药草

examples.en: Sprinkle the dish with chopped fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 在菜肴上撒些切碎的新鲜香草。

words.definition: a group of animals of one kind that live and feed together; If you herd animals, you make them move along as a group; drove, menagerie; grass, feed, range
words.translation: 兽群，牧口群，牧人；把赶到一起；兽群，畜群；放牧人；放牧；使成群

examples.en: You have to be an individual; it’s no use running with the herd.
examples.zh: 你必须特立独行，随大溜没有用处。

examples.en: Stefano used a motorcycle to herd the sheep.
examples.zh: 斯蒂芬诺骑一辆摩托车驱赶羊群。

words.definition: lazy; stopped, lazy; sit around, lie about; moon, dream away
words.translation: 闲着的，空闲的；懒的；无根据的；虚度；闲置的；懒惰的；停顿的；无所事事；[机]空转；[机]使空转

examples.en: Go and wake up that idle brother of yours.
examples.zh: 去把你那懒哥哥叫起来。

words.definition: to start burning, or to make something start burning; heat, light; burn, light the fire
words.translation: 点燃，使燃烧；点燃；使燃烧；使激动；点火；燃烧

examples.en: The petrol tank suddenly ignited.
examples.zh: 油箱突然着火了。

examples.en: The candle ignited the plastic.
examples.zh: 蜡烛烧着了塑料。

words.definition: lack of knowledge or information about something; darkness, unwisdom
words.translation: 无知，愚昧；不知，不懂

examples.en: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
examples.zh: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

words.definition: someone who has not learned to read or write; letterless, unlettered; unschooled, analphabetic
words.translation: 文盲(的)；文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的；文盲

examples.en: ...a subclass of illiterates.
examples.zh: …文盲阶层。

words.definition: to make a light shine on something, or to fill a place with light; say, lamp, elucidate, clarify; light up, to shine
words.translation: 照亮；用灯装饰；阐明；阐明，说明；使灿烂

examples.en: A single candle illuminated his face.
examples.zh: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

examples.en: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
examples.zh: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

words.definition: an idea or opinion that is wrong, especially about yourself; hallucination, fantasm
words.translation: 幻象，错觉；幻觉，[心理]错觉；错误的观念或信仰

examples.en: She was under no illusion that he loved her.
examples.zh: 她不再幻想他爱她了。

examples.en: It is an illusion that the Arctic is dark in winter.
examples.zh: 认为北极冬天一片黑暗是错误的。

examples.en: She had no illusions about her physical attractiveness.
examples.zh: 她对自己外表的吸引力不抱幻想。

words.definition: to make the meaning of something clearer by giving examples; clarify, elucidate; give an example, cite an example
words.translation: 举例或以图表说明，配以插图；阐明，举例说明；图解；举例

examples.en: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
examples.zh: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

examples.en: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
examples.zh: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

words.definition: containing new and interesting ideas; fictitious, figmentary
words.translation: 想象的，有想象力的；虚构的；富于想像的；有创造力的

examples.en: an imaginative use of computer technology
examples.zh: 计算机技术的妙用

examples.en: children’s imaginative play
examples.zh: 儿童富有想象力的游戏

examples.en: an imaginative solution to the litter problem
examples.zh: 解决乱扔垃圾的问题的有创意的方法

words.definition: to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves etc, especially in order to make people laugh; simulate, model after
words.translation: 模仿，模拟，看似；模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制

examples.en: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
examples.zh: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

words.definition: when you copy someone else’s actions; simulation, mimicry; artificial, synthetic
words.translation: 模仿，仿造，仿制品，人造；模仿，仿造；仿制品；人造的，仿制的

examples.en: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.
examples.zh: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。

words.definition: extremely large; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
words.translation: 广大的，巨大的；巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的

examples.en: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
examples.zh: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

examples.en: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
examples.zh: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

words.definition: let sb in for, entrap
words.translation: 沉浸，沉浸于；沉浸；使陷入

examples.en: He left school at 16 and immersed himself in the Labour Party.
examples.zh: 他16岁离开学校投身工党。

words.definition: someone who enters another country to live there permanently; emigratory; migration, transplantation
words.translation: 移民，侨民；移民的；迁入的

examples.en: an illegal immigrant
examples.zh: 非法移民

examples.en: a new wave of immigrants from the Middle East
examples.zh: 来自中东的一股新兴的移民浪潮

words.definition: an event that is imminent, especially an unpleasant one, will happen very soon; upcoming, forthcoming
words.translation: 迫近的，紧迫的；即将来临的；迫近的

examples.en: A new trade agreement is imminent.
examples.zh: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

words.definition: not affected by something that happens or is done; exonerative
words.translation: 免除的；安全的，不受影响的；[免疫]免疫的；免于……的，免除的

examples.en: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re immune for life.
examples.zh: 我们一旦得过这种病，就获得了终身免疫力。

words.definition: the force of one object hitting another; affect, influence, reach, work on, strike; charge at; effect, impression, influence, infection, affection
words.translation: 碰撞，撞击，撞击力；影响；[力]撞击；冲突；压紧；[力]冲击；产生影响；效果；[物]碰撞；[力]冲击力

examples.en: The force of the impact knocked the breath out of her.
examples.zh: 撞击力使她喘不过气来。

words.definition: to damage something or make it not as good as it should be; hurt, break, blast
words.translation: 损害，削弱；损害；削弱；减少

examples.en: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
examples.zh: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

words.definition: to give a particular quality to something; afford, allow, deal, reveal, extend
words.translation: 告知，透露，给予；给予（尤指抽象事物），传授；告知，透露

examples.en: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
examples.zh: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

words.definition: to make it difficult for someone or something to move forward or make progress; dispute, let, stem, slow
words.translation: 妨碍；阻碍；阻止

examples.en: Storms at sea impeded our progress.
examples.zh: 海上风暴阻碍了我们的航程。

words.definition: extremely important and needing to be done or dealt with immediately; necessary, urgent, essential, emergency, instant; necessity, instruction, need, request, order
words.translation: 紧急的，必要的，强制的，祈使语气；必要的，势在必行的；命令的；紧急的；需要；命令；祈使语气；规则

examples.en: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
examples.zh: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

words.definition: relating to an empire or to the person who rules it; august, sovereign
words.translation: 帝国的，皇帝的；[纸]帝国的；皇帝的；至高无上的；威严的

examples.en: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century
examples.zh: 19世纪英帝国的扩张

words.definition: an influence that makes something happen or makes it happen more quickly; momentum, promotion, acceleration
words.translation: 动力，原动力，推动，激励；动力；促进；冲力

examples.en: The discovery gave fresh impetus to the research.
examples.zh: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

words.definition: a tool, especially one used for outdoor physical work; to take action or make changes that you have officially decided should happen; accomplish, perform, come true, fulfill, enforce; instrument, facilities, vehicle, tool, engine
words.translation: 工具，器具；贯彻，履行；实施，执行；实现，使生效；[机]工具，器具；手段

words.definition: the ability to understand and realize what people or situations are really like; perception, penetration
words.translation: 洞察，洞悉，见识；洞察力；洞悉

examples.en: a woman of great insight
examples.zh: 一位极有眼光的妇女

words.definition: food or drink that is insipid does not have much taste; dull, bored
words.translation: 无味的，枯燥乏味的；单调的；清淡的；无趣的

examples.en: an insipid pasta dish
examples.zh: 一盘没有味道的意大利面食

words.definition: rude and not showing any respect; robust, gross, rough, country, bush
words.translation: 蛮横的，粗鲁的；无礼的；傲慢的；粗野的；无耻的

examples.en: an insolent tone of voice
examples.zh: 傲慢的语气

examples.en: You insolent child!
examples.zh: 你这个没礼貌的孩子！

words.definition: not having enough money to pay what you owe; bankrupt; broke, bankrupt
words.translation: 无偿债能力的；[经]破产者；无力偿还者；[经]破产的；无力偿还的

examples.en: The company was later declared insolvent (= officially said to be insolvent ).
examples.zh: 公司随后被宣布破产。

words.definition: an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed; examination, checking, monitoring
words.translation: 检查；审视，检阅；视察，检查

examples.en: An inspection was carried out at the school.
examples.zh: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

words.definition: a good idea about what you should do, write, say etc, especially one which you get suddenly; stimulation, afflatus
words.translation: 灵感，鼓舞人心的人或事，好主意；灵感；鼓舞；[生理]吸气；妙计

examples.en: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
examples.zh: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

examples.en: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
examples.zh: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

examples.en: He draws inspiration from ordinary scenes.
examples.zh: 他从日常生活中得到灵感。

words.definition: to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something; stimulate, lift, wake, spirit, effect
words.translation: 激励，鼓励，灌注以创造力；激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感

examples.en: We need someone who can inspire the team.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

examples.en: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
examples.zh: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

words.definition: heartening, stimulatory; prompting
words.translation: 令人振奋的；鼓舞人心的；灌输的；启发灵感的；鼓舞；激发；使感悟（inspire的ing形式）

examples.en: inspiring music
examples.zh: 激励人心的音乐

words.definition: to put a piece of equipment somewhere and connect it so that it is ready to be used; fit, constitute, fix, place, name
words.translation: 任命；安装，安置；安装；安顿

examples.en: They’ve installed the new computer network at last.
examples.zh: 他们终于安装了新电脑网络。

examples.en: Security cameras have been installed in the city centre.
examples.zh: 在市中心已安装了一些监控摄像机。

words.definition: one of a series of regular payments that you make until you have paid all the money you owe; payment by installment, installment payment
words.translation: 分期连载，分期支付的款子；分期付款；装设；就职

examples.en: the second instalment of a loan
examples.zh: 一项贷款的第二期还款

examples.en: They’re letting me pay for the washing machine by monthly instalments.
examples.zh: 他们允许我以每月分期付款的方式买下这台洗衣机。

words.definition: momentary, flashy
words.translation: 瞬间，霎时；瞬间的；即时的；猝发的

examples.en: So, the second method is almost always combined with the first, by checking the fields in instantaneous and then doing a batch validation before the form is submitted.
examples.zh: 所以，第二种方法几乎总是和第一种方法结合在一起，先对域进行瞬时检查，然后在表单被提交之前执行批处理确认。

words.definition: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or a natural ability to know something, which is not learned; intuition, natural ability; abrim
words.translation: 本能；[生物]本能，直觉；[心理]天性；充满着的

examples.en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

words.definition: a small tool used in work such as science or medicine; facilities, vehicle, engine, tool, implement
words.translation: 仪器；器具；乐器；[仪]仪器；[机]工具；手段；器械

examples.en: surgical instruments
examples.zh: 外科(手术)器械

words.definition: instrumental music is for instruments, not for voices; helpful, useful, assistant
words.translation: 起作用的，有助于，乐器的；乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的

examples.en: He was instrumental in developing links with European organizations.
examples.zh: 他在建立与欧洲各组织之间的联系中起了重要作用。

words.definition: to cover or protect something with a material that stops electricity, sound, heat etc from getting in or out; segregant, quarantine
words.translation: 使绝缘，使绝热，隔离；隔离，使孤立；使绝缘，使隔热

examples.en: an insulated attic
examples.zh: 隔热[隔音]的阁楼

words.definition: to offend someone by saying or doing something they think is rude; hurt, abuse; despite, contumely
words.translation: 侮辱，凌辱；侮辱的言词或行为；侮辱；辱骂；损害；凌辱；无礼

examples.en: Nobody insults my family and gets away with it!
examples.zh: 谁也别想侮辱了我的家人之后就这么算了！

examples.en: I hope Andy won’t be insulted if I don’t come.
examples.zh: 如果我不来，希望安迪不要介意。

words.definition: an arrangement with a company in which you pay them money, especially regularly, and they pay the costs if something bad happens, for example if you become ill or your car is damaged; assurance, safety, premium, compensation
words.translation: 保险；[保险]保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金

examples.en: Your father took out insurance to cover the mortgage.
examples.zh: 你父亲购买了抵押借款保险。

words.definition: to buy insurance so that you will receive money if something bad happens to you, your family, your possessions etc; undertake, assure; to ensure, snake stare
words.translation: 给…保险；确保，保证；确保；投保

examples.en: Have you insured the contents of your home?
examples.zh: 你给家庭财产投保了吗？

words.definition: not broken, damaged, or spoiled; whole, complete, integrated, full
words.translation: 未受损的，完整的；完整的；原封不动的；未受损伤的

examples.en: Only the medieval tower had remained intact.
examples.zh: 只有这座中世纪塔楼保存完好。

examples.en: His reputation survived intact.
examples.zh: 他的声望丝毫未受影响。

words.definition: forming a necessary part of something; whole, complete, full, intact; proportion, part, portion, percent, fraction
words.translation: 构成整体所必需的，完整的；[数]积分的；完整的，整体的；[数]积分；部分；完整

examples.en: Vegetables are an integral part of our diet.
examples.zh: 蔬菜是我们膳食中不可缺少的一部分。

words.definition: to end the practice of separating people of different races in schools, colleges etc; become one flesh; complete, absolute, full, total, round; gleichschaltung
words.translation: 使一体化，取消种族隔离；求积分；取消隔离；成为一体；整合的；完全的；一体化；集成体

examples.en: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life.
examples.zh: 他没有成功融入到意大利的生活方式中去。

words.definition: the quality of being honest and strong about what you believe to be right; truth, honesty, full, righteousness, completeness
words.translation: 诚实，正直；[数]完整；正直；诚实；廉正

examples.en: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity.
examples.zh: 我一直把他当作一个正直诚实的人。

words.definition: the ability to understand things and to think intelligently; brain, understanding, mind, mentality, head
words.translation: 智力，才智；智力，理解力；知识分子；思维逻辑领悟力；智力高的人

examples.en: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect?
examples.zh: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

words.definition: the part of a nut or seed inside the shell, or the part inside the stone of some fruits; quick, main, heart, essential, nucleus
words.translation: 果核，果仁，核心；核心，要点；[计]内核；[植]仁；[粮食]麦粒，谷粒；精髓

examples.en: The kernel of that message was that peace must not be a source of advantage or disadvantage for anyone.
examples.zh: 那一信息的核心是和平绝不应该成为对任何人有利或不利的根源。

words.definition: to take someone somewhere illegally by force, often in order to get money for returning them; spirit, abduct
words.translation: 诱拐；绑架；拐骗

examples.en: Police appealed for wit­nesses after a woman was kidnapped at gunpoint.
examples.zh: 一名妇女遭到持枪绑架，警方呼吁目击者挺身而出。

words.definition: one of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine; personality, individuality
words.translation: 肾，腰子；[解剖]肾脏；腰子；个性

examples.en: a kidney transplant
examples.zh: 肾脏移植

words.definition: your family; relative, family; congeneric, akin
words.translation: 家族、亲属；亲戚；家族；同族；同类的；有亲属关系的；性质类似的

examples.en: We’ll have to notify the next of kin of his death.
examples.zh: 我们得把他去世的消息通知他的直系亲属。

words.definition: if you kindle a fire, or if it kindles, it starts to burn; lamp, emblaze; lamp, brighten up
words.translation: 点燃，引起，激发；点燃；激起；照亮；发亮；着火；激动起来

examples.en: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

words.definition: a set of tools, equipment etc that you use for a particular purpose or activity; toolbox, tool chest; prepare, provide; equip with, fit out
words.translation: (士兵)所有装备，成套工具；发给装备；工具箱；[机]成套工具；装备

examples.en: Sally keeps her make-up kit in her bag.
examples.zh: 萨莉把化妆包放在手提包里。

examples.en: a bike repair kit
examples.zh: 一套自行车修理工具

examples.en: a shaving kit
examples.zh: 一套剃须用具

words.definition: to make clothing out of wool, using two knitting needles; couple, bond, become one, combine; become one, couple, link
words.translation: 编织；紧密结合；[纺]编织；结合；皱眉

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to knit.
examples.zh: 我祖母教过我编织。

examples.en: She’s knitting a sweater.
examples.zh: 她在织毛衣。

words.definition: a round handle or thing that you turn to open a door, turn on a television etc; handle, node; summon up, belly
words.translation: 圆形把手，旋纽，圆形突出物；把手；瘤；球形突出物；鼓起

examples.en: He thought the door was locked, but he turned the knob and the door opened.
examples.zh: 他本以为门是锁住的，但是转了一下把手门就开了。

examples.en: a brass door knob
examples.zh: 黄铜门把手

examples.en: I adjusted the volume knob and sat down.
examples.zh: 我调节好音量旋钮，坐了下来。

words.definition: in the same way; equally, too, similarly, also, same
words.translation: 同样地；也

examples.en: Nanny put on a shawl and told the girls to do likewise.
examples.zh: 南妮披上披肩，并叫女孩们也这样做。

examples.en: The clams were delicious. Likewise, the eggplant was excellent.
examples.zh: 蛤蜊味道鲜美，茄子也同样美味。

words.definition: an arm or leg; extremitas, offshoot
words.translation: 肢；翼；翅膀；大树枝；肢，臂；分支；枝干

examples.en: She would be able to stretch out her cramped limbs and rest for a few hours.
examples.zh: 她将可以伸开蜷缩的四肢，休息几个小时。

words.definition: not firm or strong; to walk slowly and with difficulty because one leg is hurt or injured; weak, soft, tender, ductile; hirple, hilch; claudication, hirple
words.translation: 柔软的，软弱的；跛行，蹒跚；柔软的，无力的；软弱的；跛行，一拐一拐地走；缓慢费力地前进；跛行

examples.en: a limp handshake
examples.zh: 无力的握手

examples.en: His body suddenly went limp.
examples.zh: 他突然身子一软。

words.definition: a long thin mark on a piece of paper, the ground, or another surface; to form rows along the sides of something; vector, row, range, thread, rank; fall in, queue
words.translation: 线；皱纹；外形；行列；用线标示，排列；路线，航线；排；绳；排队；站成一排

examples.en: Draw a straight line across the top of the page.
examples.zh: 在这一页的上方画一条直线。

examples.en: Sign your name on the dotted line (= line made up of a series of dots ).
examples.zh: 在虚线上签名。

examples.en: The edges of the pitch are marked by white lines.
examples.zh: 球场的四边画着白线。

words.definition: aloud, outward; outer, outside, external; putout; towards, unto, at, on, to; emerge, come forth; expel, dispel
words.translation: of；line；不一致；出现；在外；出局；出声地；不流行地；外面的；出局的；下台的；向；离去；出来；暴露；使熄灭；驱逐

words.definition: consisting of lines, or in the form of a straight line; longitudinal, thready
words.translation: 线的，直线的，长度的；[数]线的，线型的；直线的，线状的；长度的

examples.en: a linear diagram
examples.zh: 线形图

words.definition: cloth made from the flax plant, used to make high quality clothes, home decorations etc; flax; flaxen
words.translation: 亚麻布，衬衣裤；亚麻布，亚麻线；[纺]亚麻制品；亚麻的；[纺]亚麻布制的

examples.en: a linen jacket
examples.zh: 亚麻布夹克

words.definition: A liner is a large ship in which people travel long distances, especially on holiday; pad, airliner
words.translation: 班机，班轮；[水运]班轮，[航]班机；[机][铁路]衬垫；画线者

examples.en: ...luxury ocean liners.
examples.zh: …豪华远洋客轮。

words.definition: to stay somewhere a little longer, especially because you do not want to leave; hang about, wander about; spend, while away
words.translation: 逗留，徘徊；徘徊；苟延残喘；磨蹭；消磨；缓慢度过

examples.en: I spent a week at Kandersteg and could happily have lingered on.
examples.zh: 我在坎德施泰格逗留了一个星期，本来还可以开开心心地多待几天。

words.definition: a strong alcoholic drink such as whisky; solution, fluid; wine, knock over a drink; intoxicate
words.translation: 酒；酒类；酒，含酒精饮料；[化学]溶液；[物]液体；烈酒；喝酒，灌酒；使喝醉

words.definition: the state of being able to read and write
words.translation: 识字，读写能力

examples.en: a new adult literacy campaign
examples.zh: 新一轮成人识字[扫盲]运动

words.definition: You can use literally to emphasize an exaggeration. Some careful speakers of English think that this use is incorrect.; verbatim
words.translation: 照字义地，逐字地；照字面地；逐字地

examples.zh: 我们必须控制住经济，否则它真地就会把我们困住。

words.definition: books, plays, poems etc that people think are important and good; writing, letter
words.translation: 文学，文学作品，文献，著作；[语]文学；[图情]文献；文艺；著作

examples.en: He has read many of the major works of literature.
examples.zh: 他读过许多重要的文学作品。

examples.en: Italian literature
examples.zh: 意大利文学

words.definition: a group of baby animals that a mother gives birth to at the same time; if things litter an area, there are a lot of them in that place, scattered in an untidy way; refuse, garbage, junk, rubbish, trash; give birth
words.translation: 杂乱物；一胎生下的小动物；使杂乱,乱丢；"；垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱；产仔；乱扔废弃物

examples.en: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
examples.zh: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

words.definition: if you live at a particular time, you are alive then; not dead or artificial; telling, vivid, vigorous, energetic; spend, suffer, experience, undergo, last; exist, belong, room, harbor, dwell
words.translation: 活，生活；有生命的，实况的；活的；生动的；实况转播的；精力充沛的；经历；度过；活；居住；生存

examples.zh: 没有阳光，植物就无法生存。

words.definition: to produce something, for example by putting the different parts of it together; earn, acquire, prepare, provide, expect; proceed, progress, increase; formation, manufacture, constitution, fabric, machining
words.translation: 做；使得；进行；布置，准备，整理；制造；认为；获得；形成；安排；引起；构成；开始；前进；增大；被制造；构造；[心理]性情

examples.zh: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

examples.en: A family of mice had made their nest in the roof.
examples.zh: 一窝老鼠在屋顶上安了家。

examples.en: She made her own wedding dress.
examples.zh: 她的婚纱是自己做的。

words.definition: the process of making something; development, growth, formation, advance, progress; fabricating
words.translation: 制成；发展；制造；形成；制作（make的现在分词）

examples.en: people involved in decision making at the highest level
examples.zh: 最高层级决策参与者

words.definition: the desire to harm someone because you hate them; spite, malevolence
words.translation: 恶意，怨恨；恶意；怨恨；预谋

examples.en: James bore her no malice (= did not feel any malice towards her ) .
examples.zh: 詹姆斯对她并无恶意。

words.definition: a malignant disease is one such as  cancer  , which can develop in an uncontrolled way and is likely to cause someone’s death; harmful, evil
words.translation: 恶意的；恶毒的；(疾病)恶性的；[医]恶性的；有害的；有恶意的

examples.zh: 她的乳房长了个恶性肿瘤。

words.definition: a large area where there are a lot of shops, usually a covered area where cars are not allowed; shopping arcade
words.translation: 大型购物中心；购物商场；[建]林荫路；铁圈球场

examples.en: Let’s meet at the mall and go see a movie.
examples.zh: 我们在购物中心碰头，然后去看电影吧。

examples.en: a huge new shopping mall
examples.zh: 一家新开的大型购物中心

words.definition: something that is malleable is easy to press or pull into a new shape; plastic, mouldable
words.translation: (金属)可锻的;有延展性的;(性格)可训练的；[材]可锻的；可塑的；有延展性的；易适应的

examples.en: malleable steel
examples.zh: 展性钢

words.definition: when someone becomes ill or weak because they have not eaten enough good food; dystrophy, nutritional deficiency
words.translation: 营养不良；营养失调，[医]营养不良

examples.zh: 营养不良的难民

words.definition: to treat a person or animal cruelly; abuse, rough, strain
words.translation: 虐待；滥用；粗暴对待

examples.zh: 人质说他们挨了饿，但没有受到虐待。

words.definition: the chemical processes by which food is changed into energy in your body
words.translation: 新陈代谢

examples.en: This drug speeds up your metabolism.
examples.zh: 这种药物会加快你的新陈代谢。

words.definition: a metallic noise sounds like pieces of metal hitting each other; metal bearing
words.translation: 金属的；金属的，含金属的

examples.en: The key turned in the lock with a loud metallic click.
examples.zh: 钥匙在锁里转动发出金属撞击的咔嗒声。

examples.en: The pans made a metallic clatter as they crashed to the floor.
examples.zh: 那些锅哐啷一声摔到地上。

words.definition: a way of describing something by referring to it as something different and suggesting that it has similar qualities to that thing; parabole
words.translation: 隐喻，暗喻；暗喻，隐喻；比喻说法

examples.en: She uses some wonderful images and metaphors in her writing.
examples.zh: 她在作品中用了一些绝妙的比喻和暗喻。

examples.en: a very creative use of metaphor
examples.zh: 隐喻的独到运用

words.definition: from a  meteor; atmospheric, freeair
words.translation: 流星的，转瞬即逝的，突然的；大气的；流星的；疾速的

examples.en: meteoric iron
examples.zh: 陨铁

words.definition: the scientific study of weather conditions; aerography, meteorological optics
words.translation: 气象学；气象状态，[气象]气象学

examples.en: This is a book about meteorology.
examples.zh: 这本书是讲气象的。

examples.en: It plays an increasingly important part in meteorology for cloud, precipitation, hail and thunderstorm detection as well as the navigation of aircraft and ships.
examples.zh: 它在对云层、降水、冰雹和雷暴的气象探测以及在船舰和飞机的导航中，起着日益重要的作用。

examples.zh: 所有的这些都是根据某些假设,和气象状态，地质情况，还有，水文请跨国,在加上土地的等高线,在这个特定的核能电站的周围。

words.definition: If you describe someone as meticulous, you mean that they do things very carefully and with great attention to detail; punctilious, wary of

examples.zh: 他对任何事情都很小心谨慎。

words.definition: using or connected with the  metric system  of weights and measures
words.translation: 十进制的，公制的

examples.en: a metric tonne
examples.zh: 一公吨

examples.en: The parts all come in metric sizes now.
examples.zh: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

words.definition: relating or belonging to a very large city; suzerain; archbishop

examples.zh: 南澳大利亚的一个都市区

words.definition: an extremely small living thing which you can only see if you use a  microscope  . Some microbes can cause diseases.; bacterium, organism
words.translation: 微生物；细菌，[微]微生物

examples.zh: …包括引起结核病和麻风病的微生物在内的一类细菌。

examples.zh: 基切尔说这个城市曾经是60年代所有美国文化的一个缩影。

words.definition: a type of film on which pictures and writing can be made very small, so that large amounts can be stored easily
words.translation: 微缩胶片

examples.zh: 操作台的抽屉里塞满了参考书、缩微胶片和各种书目卡片。

examples.zh: 肖克罗斯说土星5号蓝图保存在马歇尔太空飞行中心的缩微胶片上。

examples.zh: 像这个伏特加酒瓶，还有这罐面霜，都是用来传送缩微胶卷的。

words.translation: 力量，强权，势力；力量；威力；势力；可能；也许

examples.zh: 挑战英国法律制度权威的两个人

examples.en: He swung the axe again with all his might .
examples.zh: 他用尽全力再一次抡起斧头。

words.definition: very strong and powerful, or very big and impressive; powerful, male, influential, vigorous, energetic; greatly, quite, badly, too, extremely, far, highly; big guns
words.translation: 强大的，强有力的，巨大的，浩大的；有力的；强有力的；有势力的；很；极；非常；有势力的人

examples.zh: 浩荡的密西西比河

examples.en: a mighty army
examples.zh: 强大的军队

words.definition: if birds or animals migrate, they travel regularly from one part of the world to another; to move, to shift; transplant
words.translation: 迁移；移居；移动；随季节而移居；移往；使移居；使移植

examples.zh: 人们移居到雅加达这样的城市找工作。

words.definition: a white or grey substance that grows on walls or other surfaces in wet, slightly warm conditions; mould; mold; mould, go moldy

examples.zh: 该房间有股霉味。

words.translation: 好斗的；好战的；富有战斗性的人；好斗者

examples.en: militant political activists
examples.zh: 激进的政治活动家

examples.en: a militant animal rights group
examples.zh: 激进的动物权利保护团体

examples.zh: 马丁•路德•金遇刺后，黑人领袖变得更为激进了。

words.definition: a period of 1,000 years; chiliad, Golden Age
words.translation: 一千年，千禧年；太平盛世；千年期，千禧年；一千年，千年纪念；太平盛世，黄金时代

examples.en: people who have inhabited this land for millennia
examples.zh: 在这片土地上已经居住了数千年的人们

words.definition: simulate, pattern, imitate; aper, imitator; affected, simulate, assumed
words.translation: 假装的，模仿的，草拟的；模仿，摹拟；效颦者，模仿者；仿制品；小丑；模仿的，模拟的；假装的

words.definition: your thoughts or your ability to think, feel, and imagine things; opinion, intelligence, energy, memory, spirit; devote one's attention to, concentrate upon; take care of, take notice
words.translation: 想法；理智，精神；意见；[心理]智力；记忆力；介意；专心于；照料；注意

examples.en: It is impossible to understand the complex nature of the human mind .
examples.zh: 要想了解人类思维复杂的特性是不可能的。

examples.en: Mind and body are closely related.
examples.zh: 思想和肉体紧密相连。

examples.en: Meditation involves focusing the mind on a single object or word.
examples.zh: 冥想需要把思想集中在一个物体或单词上。

words.definition: to feel very sad and to miss someone after they have died; grieve over, grieve for
words.translation: 哀悼；忧伤；服丧

examples.zh: 成百上千人聚集在一起悼念遇刺的总统。

words.definition: hair that grows on a man’s upper lip; antenna, taz
words.translation: (嘴唇上面的)胡子；小胡子；髭；触须

examples.zh: 他剃去了小胡子。

words.translation: 黏液的，似黏液的；[生理]黏液的；分泌黏液的

examples.zh: 有人把我桌上的文件全都弄乱了。

examples.zh: 政府似乎迷失了方向，分不清轻重缓急。

words.translation: 多边的；多国参加的；[数]多边的；多国的，多国参加的

examples.en: The amount of information available has multiplied.
examples.zh: 可获得的信息大大增加了。

examples.en: Smoking multiplies the risk of heart attacks and other health problems.
examples.zh: 吸烟大大增加了患心脏病和其他疾病的危险性。

words.definition: a very large number of people or things; majority, mass
words.translation: 大批，大群；众多；群众；多数

examples.zh: 我以前从未见过这么多的星星。

examples.zh: 种种可能的解释

words.definition: concered with ordinary daily life rather than religious matters; ordinary, lay, universal, international, stock
words.translation: 世间的；世俗的；世俗的，平凡的；世界的，宇宙的

examples.zh: 刚开始，这工作非常乏味。

words.translation: 市的，市政的；[建][经]市政的，市的；地方自治的

examples.zh: 城市垃圾场

examples.zh: 市级选举

examples.zh: 风在林间低语。

words.translation: 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；强健的

examples.zh: 她动作敏捷，身体强壮，身材苗条，肌肉结实。

examples.en: He’s very muscular.

words.definition: a change in the  genetic  structure of an animal or plant that makes it different from others of the same kind; variation, shift, diversification, turn

examples.zh: 她能听见这老妇人低声说要考虑考虑。

words.translation: 相互的，共有的，共同的；共同的；相互的，彼此的

examples.zh: 我不喜欢德夫，他好像也不喜欢我。

examples.zh: 两个男人互相吹捧，盛赞对方让自己受益匪浅。

words.definition: a very large number of things; thousand, countless, million, infinite, innumerable; million, innumerability
words.translation: 极大数量；无数的；种种的；无数，极大数量；无数的人或物

examples.zh: 古典神话中的人物

words.definition: a native ability is one that you have naturally from birth; crude, inherent; indigen, local product

examples.zh: 她天生的机智风趣

words.translation: 裸体的；无遮蔽的；[生物]裸体的；无装饰的；无证据的；直率的

examples.zh: 孩子们光着身子跑过院子。

examples.zh: 裸体男子的照片

examples.zh: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

words.translation: 养育，培育，教养；养育；鼓励；培植；教养；营养物

examples.zh: 轰鸣的桨击中了船上碗柜上的粗糙键盘。

examples.zh: 那些打理得非常整洁的花园是杂乱扩张的开罗市区中的一片绿洲。

words.definition: a formal and very serious promise; pledge, asseveration
words.translation: 誓言，誓约；诅咒，咒骂

examples.zh: 总统宣誓就职。

examples.zh: 她不能违背誓言。

examples.zh: 雇主有责任对所有员工一视同仁。

examples.zh: 她照例给他端来一杯茶。

examples.zh: 他对传统的教育观念提出了质疑。

examples.zh: 这些会议声称旨在收集金融策略方面的信息。

words.translation: 夸耀，卖弄；卖弄；虚饰；虚有其表

examples.zh: 她的生活方式毫不张扬。

examples.zh: 吸烟或以其他方式糟蹋自己身体的人

examples.zh: 共和党人可能在11月罢免他。

examples.zh: 吸烟者常常觉得自己遭到社会排斥。

examples.zh: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

examples.zh: 说到反应速度，小公司会胜过大公司。

examples.zh: 这项法案将全面禁用几种枪支。

examples.zh: 把民主党人描述成愤怒的死硬派的媒体宣传

words.definition: the action of separating a country into two or more independent countries; division, segmentation; segment, deleave
words.translation: 分开，分割；[计]划分，分开；[数]分割；[建]隔墙；隔离物；分隔；区分

examples.en: ...fighting which followed the partition of India.
examples.zh: …印度分裂后的争斗。

words.definition: to come up to a particular place, person, or object and go past them; mechanism, protection, approach, transit; determine, drop, finish, vary, transit; clear, track, hand, transfer
words.translation: 穿过；经过；及格；途径；护照；传递；变化；终止；通过

examples.en: The crowd parted to let the truck pass.
examples.zh: 人群分开让卡车通过。

examples.en: He gave me a smile as he passed.
examples.zh: 他经过时对我微笑了一下。

examples.en: We passed a group of students outside the theatre.
examples.zh: 我们在戏院外从一群学生身旁经过。

words.definition: a very strong feeling of sexual love; flame, love, fire, warmth
words.translation: 激情；热情；酷爱；盛怒

examples.en: His eyes were burning with passion.
examples.zh: 他的眼中欲火燃烧。

words.definition: someone who is passive tends to accept things that happen to them or things that people say to them, without taking any action; driven, negative
words.translation: 被动的；被动的，消极的；被动语态的

examples.en: Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
examples.zh: 凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。

examples.en: their passive acceptance of their fate
examples.zh: 他们对命运的消极接受

words.definition: a small official document that you get from your government, that proves who you are, and which you need in order to leave your country and enter other countries; protection, instrument, shift, road, tool
words.translation: 护照，保障，手段；[法]护照，通行证；手段

examples.en: I have an Irish passport.
examples.zh: 我持爱尔兰护照。

examples.en: They need to check that your passport is in order.
examples.zh: 他们要检查一下你的护照是否有效。

words.definition: something that you do because you think it is enjoyable or interesting; entertainment, recreation, pleasure, sport, occupation
words.translation: 消遣，娱乐；娱乐，消遣

examples.en: Reading was her favourite pastime.
examples.zh: 阅读是她最喜爱的消遣方式。

words.definition: a chemical substance used to kill insects and small animals that destroy crops; insecticide, insect repellent, insect killer, insect spray, anabasin
words.translation: 杀虫剂，农药；[农药]杀虫剂

examples.en: This pesticide is diluted with water and applied directly to the fields.
examples.zh: 这种杀虫剂用水稀释后直接施用在田里。

words.definition: to annoy someone, especially by asking them many times to do something; pursue, eat, burden, trouble
words.translation: 烦扰，纠缠；纠缠，烦扰；使烦恼

examples.en: She’d been pestered by reporters for days.
examples.zh: 几天来她一直受到记者们的纠缠。

words.definition: one of the coloured parts of a flower that are shaped like leaves
words.translation: 花瓣

examples.en: rose petals
examples.zh: 玫瑰花瓣

examples.en: The flower has seven petals.
examples.zh: 这种花有七片花瓣。

words.definition: a written request signed by a lot of people, asking someone in authority to do something or change something; imprecation; demand, apply for; apply for, pray for
words.translation: 祈求，请求；请愿，请求书；请愿；[法][专利]请愿书；祈求；诉状；[专利]请求；恳求

examples.en: Local residents have drawn up a petition to protest the hospital closure.
examples.zh: 当地居民已草拟了一份请愿书，抗议关闭医院。

examples.en: {"GEO":["AmE"],"GLOSS":["an attempt to get a lot of people to sign a petition"],"COLLOINEXA":["petition drive"]}
examples.zh: 发动民众签名的〕请愿运动

words.definition: oil that is obtained from below the surface of the Earth and is used to make petrol,  paraffin  , and various chemical substances; fossil oil, geoline
words.translation: 石油；[油气]石油

examples.en: petroleum-based products
examples.zh: 石油产品

words.definition: a petty problem, detail etc is small and unimportant; cheap, trivial
words.translation: 小的；次要的；琐碎的；小气的；小规模的

examples.en: petty squabbles
examples.zh: 小口角

examples.en: petty restrictions
examples.zh: 小限制

words.definition: relating to the production of drugs and medicines; drugs, medication
words.translation: 制药的；药物的；药物

examples.en: the pharmaceutical industry
examples.zh: 制药业

examples.en: pharmaceutical products
examples.zh: 药物

words.definition: a shop or a part of a shop where medicines are prepared and sold; dispensary, officina
words.translation: 制药，配药；药房；药店；[药]配药学，药剂学；制药业；一批备用药品

examples.en: an all-night pharmacy
examples.zh: 通宵药店

words.definition: one of the stages of a process of development or change; stage, age, grade
words.translation: 阶段；月的盈亏；方面;相位vt按计划进行；[物]相；[天]位相

examples.en: a new drug that is in the experimental phase
examples.zh: 处于试验阶段的一种新药

examples.en: It’s just a phase he’s going through .
examples.zh: 这只是他要经历的一个阶段。

words.definition: very great or impressive; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding
words.translation: 非凡的，出众的，庞大的；现象的；显著的；异常的；能知觉的

examples.en: the phenomenal success of computer games in recent years
examples.zh: 近年来电脑游戏的惊人成功

examples.en: He has learned a phenomenal amount in the last two years.
examples.zh: 过去的两年中他学到了许多东西。

examples.en: The results have been phenomenal.
examples.zh: 成果是非凡的。

words.definition: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand; wonder, miracle
words.translation: 现象；非凡的人；奇迹(pl-na)；[物]现象；奇迹；杰出的人才

examples.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
examples.zh: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

words.definition: a strong unreasonable fear of something; terror, ghastfulness
words.translation: (病态的)恐惧，憎恶；[内科]恐怖，憎恶；恐惧症

examples.en: Some children suffer from school phobia .
examples.zh: 有些儿童对上学有恐惧症。

words.definition: relating to the sounds of human speech; etic
words.translation: 语音的；语音的，语音学的；音形一致的；发音有细微区别的

examples.en: a phonetic alphabet
examples.zh: 音标

words.definition: a doctor; medical doctor, medico
words.translation: 医生；[医]医师；[内科]内科医师

examples.en: ...your family physician.
examples.zh: …你的家庭医生。

words.translation: 生理学的

examples.en: If so, this would add to a growing list of physiological and biological markers of sexual orientation.
examples.zh: 如果是这样，这可能会给生理和生物学上的性取向标记增加一长串名单。

examples.en: Almost anything that we like to do - eat, shop, gamble, have sex - contain the potential for psychological and physiological dependence.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢做的几乎任何事——吃饭，购物，赌博，性爱——都可能引起心理和生理的依赖。

examples.en: How do you respond to skeptics who say there must be some biological or physiological basis for that kind of experience, which you say in the book is medically inexplicable?
examples.zh: 对那些无神论者关于濒死体验应该有些生物学的或生理学的基础的说法你如何回应，你在书中说这种体验是医学上无法解释的？

words.definition: the size and appearance of someone’s body; figure, build
words.translation: 体格，体魄；体格，体形

examples.en: She didn’t have the physique to be a dancer.
examples.zh: 她没有当舞蹈演员的体形。

examples.en: He had good health and a strong physique.
examples.zh: 他身体健康，体格健壮。

words.definition: if you can have your pick or take your pick of different things, you can choose which one you want; to choose a person or thing, for example because they are the best or most suitable; select, choose from; dig, handpick; chose, selection, choice
words.translation: 镐；挑选；选择；采；采摘；挖；拾取；掘；精选；[农机]鹤嘴锄

examples.en: Have a look at the menu and take your pick .
examples.zh: 看看菜单再作选择吧。

examples.en: He knew he could take his pick of any of the girls in the office.
examples.zh: 他知道自己可以挑办公室里任何一个姑娘。

examples.en: Sarah could have her pick of any university in the country.
examples.zh: 萨拉可以选择国内任何一所大学。

words.definition: an entrance covered by a roof outside the front door of a house or church; passage, corridor
words.translation: 门廊，走廊；门廊；走廊

examples.en: He was standing on the porch, waving as we drove away.
examples.zh: 我们开车离开的时候，他站在走廊上向我们挥手。

words.definition: one of the small holes in your skin that liquid, especially  sweat  , can pass through, or a similar hole in the surface of a plant; If you pore over or through information, you look at it and study it very carefully; consider, stare at; stomates, stigmata
words.translation: 毛孔；钻研；细想；凝视；熟读；[陶瓷]气孔；小孔

examples.en: The size of your pores is determined by the amount of oil they produce.
examples.zh: 毛孔的大小取决于毛孔分泌油脂的多少。

examples.en: We spent hours poring over travel brochures.
examples.zh: 我们花了几个小时仔细研究旅游宣传册。

words.definition: allowing liquid, air etc to pass slowly through many very small holes; leachy, stomatal
words.translation: 多孔的，能渗透的；多孔渗水的；能渗透的；[生物]有气孔的

examples.en: porous material
examples.zh: 渗透性材料

words.definition: a place where ships can be loaded and unloaded; haven, bunder
words.translation: 港口，舱门，舱口；(船、飞机)左舷；[水运]港口，口岸；（计算机的）[电子][计]端口；[航][船]左舷；舱门

examples.en: Britain’s largest port
examples.zh: 英国最大的港口城市

words.definition: able to be carried or moved easily; luggable, hand-held
words.translation: 手提式的，便携式的；手提的，便携式的；轻便的

examples.en: a portable radio
examples.zh: 便携式收音机

words.definition: a large flat case used especially for carrying pictures, documents etc; folder, briefcase
words.translation: 公事包；文件夹；大臣及部长职位；[管理]公文包；证券投资组合；部长职务

examples.en: the foreign affairs portfolio
examples.zh: 外交部长职责

words.definition: a part of something larger, especially a part that is different from the other parts; part, proportion, fate, percent, lot; part, to allocate
words.translation: 一部分，一份，一客；部分；一份；命运；分配；给…嫁妆

examples.en: Do you have any children’s portions?
examples.zh: 你们有儿童餐吗？

words.definition: to describe or represent something or someone; represent, play, trace, figure
words.translation: 描绘；描述；扮演

examples.en: His most famous painting portrayed the death of Nelson.
examples.zh: 他最著名的画作描绘的是纳尔逊之死。

examples.en: Religion was portrayed in a negative way.
examples.zh: 对宗教的描写是负面的。

words.definition: to sit or stand in a particular position in order to be photographed or painted, or to make someone do this; take shape, shape into; attitude, posture; posture
words.translation: 摆姿势；提出；姿势；造成，形成；装模作样；提出…讨论；姿势，姿态；佯装；矫揉造作

examples.en: In her book she poses the question ‘How much do we need to be happy?’
examples.zh: 她在书里提出了这样一个问题﹕“我们要拥有多少才能快乐？”

words.definition: if you take positive action, you do something definite in order to try and achieve something; active, established, practical, actual, fixed, effective, sincere
words.translation: 确定的；确信的，实际的；正的；阳性的；[电]积极的；[摄][物][数]正的，[化学][医]阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的

examples.en: We need to take positive steps to improve the situation of families in poverty.
examples.zh: 我们需要采取积极措施来改善贫困家庭的状况。

examples.en: Positive action was required.
examples.zh: 要求采取积极行动。

examples.en: It’s a relief to know that something positive is being done.
examples.zh: 知道正在采取积极的措施让人宽心。

words.definition: if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere; estate, property, treasure, worth
words.translation: 所有，拥有；财产；拥有；领地；自制；着迷

examples.en: That information is not in our possession.
examples.zh: 那则信息不归我们所有。

examples.en: How did the painting come into your possession (= how did you get it ) ?
examples.zh: 这幅画是怎么到你手上的？

examples.en: The finance company now has possession of the house.
examples.zh: 这家金融公司目前拥有这所房子。

words.definition: the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post; taxe, franking
words.translation: 邮费，邮资；[邮]邮资，邮费

examples.en: How much is the postage for a postcard?
examples.zh: 寄一张明信片的邮资是多少？

words.definition: a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration; advertisement, bill, publicity
words.translation: 招贴画，广告；广告画；海报，广告；[印刷]招贴

examples.en: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
examples.zh: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

examples.en: a poster campaign for the election
examples.zh: 选举的海报宣传

words.definition: all the people in the future who will be alive after you are dead; child, seed, progeny
words.translation: 后裔，子孙，后代；子孙，后裔；后代

examples.en: A photographer recorded the scene on video for posterity.
examples.zh: 一位摄影师为子孙后代摄下了这个场面。

words.definition: relating to studies done at a university after completing a first degree; someone who is studying at a university to get a  master’s degree  or a  phd; graduate student, advanced student
words.translation: 大学毕业后的，研究院的；研究生；研究生，研究所学生

examples.en: postgraduate degrees
examples.zh: 研究生学位

words.definition: happening, printed etc after someone’s death
words.translation: 遗腹的；父亡后出生的；死后的；身后的

examples.en: a posthumous collection of his articles
examples.zh: 他身后出版的文集

words.definition: A postmortem is a medical examination of a dead person's body in order to find out how they died; autopsy, necroscopy
words.translation: ，验尸，尸体解剖；事后的，死后的；验尸；检视；尸体检查

examples.en: A postmortem was carried out to establish the cause of death.
examples.zh: 进行了尸检以确定死因。

words.definition: to change the date or time of a planned event or action to a later one; adjourn; stave off, time delay
words.translation: 推迟；延缓；使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面；延缓，延迟；延缓发作

examples.en: The match had to be postponed until next week.
examples.zh: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

examples.en: His trial has been postponed indefinitely (= no one knows when it will happen ) .
examples.zh: 对他的审判被无限期推迟了。

words.definition: a message written at the end of a letter after you have signed your name
words.translation: 信件中附笔，附言

words.definition: the way you position your body when sitting or standing; behavior, status; pose
words.translation: 姿势，姿态；态度；姿势；情形；摆姿势

examples.en: her upright posture
examples.zh: 她笔挺的姿势

words.definition: having a very powerful effect or influence on your body or mind; valid, available, effective, virtual, telling
words.translation: 有力的，有效的；有效的；强有力的，有权势的；有说服力的

examples.en: potent drugs
examples.zh: 强效药物

examples.en: a potent symbol of oppression
examples.zh: 压迫的有力象征

examples.en: Advertising is a potent force in showing smoking as a socially acceptable habit.
examples.zh: 广告的力量很大，把吸烟说成为社会所接受的习惯。

words.definition: likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future; the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect; possibility, probability, feasibility, maybe, chance; feasible, possible, underlying, latent
words.translation: 潜在的;；可能的；潜能；潜力；可能性；[电]电势；潜在的；势的

examples.en: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
examples.zh: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

words.definition: A potion is a drink that contains medicine, poison, or something that is supposed to have magic powers; dose, potus
words.translation: (药等的)一服；一剂；一服；饮剂

examples.en: ...a magic potion that will make Siegfried forget Brunnhilde and fall in love with Gutrune.
examples.zh: …一种会使齐格弗里德忘掉布伦希德尔德而爱上古特鲁内娜的魔剂。

words.definition: money that you gain by selling things or doing business, after your costs have been paid; behalf, margin, benefit, gain, sake; advantage, gain; benefit, be good for
words.translation: 利益；利润；[会计]利润；获利；有益；有益于

examples.en: The shop’s daily profit is usually around $500.
examples.zh: 这家商店每天的利润一般在500美元左右。

examples.en: She sold the business and bought a farm with the profits.
examples.zh: 她卖了公司，用所得利润买下了一座农场。

examples.en: They sold their house at a healthy profit .
examples.zh: 他们卖掉房子，赚了一大笔钱。

words.definition: having a strong influence or effect; encyclopedic, cyclopaedic
words.translation: 深的，极深的；渊博的；深奥的；深厚的；意义深远的

examples.en: a profound sense of guilt
examples.zh: 强烈的内疚感

words.definition: produced or existing in large quantities; abundant, numerous, full, generous, plenty
words.translation: 极其丰富的；很多的；大量的；丰富的；慷慨的；浪费的

examples.en: He made profuse apologies .
examples.zh: 他不住地道歉。

examples.en: Profuse sweating is one of the symptoms of heat exhaustion.
examples.zh: 大量出汗是中暑虚脱的症状之一。

words.definition: to say that an action is illegal or not allowed; stem, block, dispute, bar, discourage
words.translation: 禁止；阻止，禁止

examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
examples.zh: 厂区严禁吸烟。

words.definition: a carefully planned piece of work to get information about something, to build something, to improve something etc; If you project a film or picture onto a screen or wall, you make it appear there; design, engineer; design, schedule, engineer, style, frame; engineering, career, enterprise, plan, scheme
words.translation: 方案，计划；设计；投影；抛；计划；表达；投射；发射；放映；工程；事业

examples.en: The project aims to provide an analysis of children’s emotions.
examples.zh: 该计划旨在对儿童情绪作出分析。

examples.en: a three-year research project
examples.zh: 一项为期三年的研究计划

examples.en: The scheme will now be extended after a successful pilot project (= a small trial to test if an idea will be successful ) .
examples.zh: 试行成功后，该方案现在将得到推广。

words.definition: a prolific artist, writer etc produces many works of art, books etc; abundant, productive, full, luxurious
words.translation: 多产的，丰富的；多产的；丰富的

examples.en: Handel’s prolific output of opera
examples.zh: 韩德尔丰富的歌剧作品

words.definition: the introduction to a play, a long poem etc; opening remarks, introductory remarks
words.translation: 序言；开端；开场白

examples.en: The prologue to the novel is written in the form of a newspaper account.
examples.zh: 该小说的前言是以新闻报道的形式写的。

words.definition: to deliberately make something such as a feeling or an activity last longer; drag on, drag out
words.translation: 延长，拖延；延长；拖延

examples.en: I was trying to think of some way to prolong the conversation.
examples.zh: 我在想方设法拖长这次谈话。

words.definition: important; obvious, excellent, remarkable, brilliant, marked
words.translation: 突出的，显要的，著名的；突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的

examples.en: a prominent Russian scientist
examples.zh: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

examples.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
examples.zh: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

words.definition: If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it; wish, hope, pleasure; pledge, vouchsafe
words.translation: 诺言；指望；前途；许诺，允诺；希望；允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望

examples.en: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday.
examples.zh: 邮局已承诺在星期五恢复该地区第一类邮件的递送。

examples.en: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
examples.zh: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

examples.en: Promise me you will not waste your time.
examples.zh: 向我承诺你不会浪费你的时间。

words.definition: showing signs of being successful or good in the future; likely, hopeful; undertaking
words.translation: 有希望的；有出息的；有希望的，有前途的；许诺，答应（promise的现在分词形式）

examples.en: a promising career in law
examples.zh: 很有前途的法律职业

examples.en: a promising young actor
examples.zh: 大有前途的年轻演员

examples.en: a promising start
examples.zh: 良好的开端

words.definition: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread; facilitate, boost, prefer, upgrade, further
words.translation: 开放；促进，宣传；促进；提升；推销；发扬

examples.en: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
examples.zh: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

words.definition: done quickly, immediately, or at the right time; to make someone decide to do something; rapid, fast, fly, forward, ready; facilitate, boost, further; cue, noting; punctually

words.definition: likely to do something or suffer from something, especially something bad or harmful; liable, apt
words.translation: 俯伏的；有倾向；[昆]俯卧的；有…倾向的，易于…的

examples.zh: 他的视线移向了趴在地上的尸体。

words.definition: information which is false or which emphasizes just one part of a situation, used by a government or political group to make people agree with them; advertisement, publicity, dissemination

examples.zh: 政府的宣传机器

words.definition: to spread an idea, belief etc to many people; breed, transmit; breed, increase
words.translation: 繁殖；增殖；传播，宣传；传播；传送；宣传

examples.en: The group launched a website to propagate its ideas .
examples.zh: 这个团体建了一个网站来宣扬他们的主张。

words.definition: to move, drive, or push something forward; stimulate, power
words.translation: 推进；驱使；激励；驱策

examples.zh: 由小马达驱动的小船

examples.zh: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

words.definition: the thing or things that someone owns; performance, nature, ownership, estate, capability
words.translation: 财产；房产；性质；性质，性能；[经]财产；[法]所有权

examples.en: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
examples.zh: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

examples.en: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
examples.zh: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

words.definition: a statement that something will happen in the future, especially one made by someone with religious or magic powers; prediction, message
words.translation: 预言，预言能力；预言；预言书；预言能力

examples.en: She had the gift of prophecy.
examples.zh: 她有预言的天赋。

words.definition: The proportion of one kind of person or thing in a group is the number of people or things of that kind compared to the total number of people or things in the group; ratio, area, equilibrium, scale, part; apportion
words.translation: 比率，比例；大小，容积；[数]比例；部分；面积；均衡；使成比例；使均衡；分摊

examples.en: The proportion of women in the profession had risen to 17.3%.
examples.zh: 从事那个职业的女性比例已经增长到17.3%。

words.definition: to suggest something as a plan or course of action; schedule, design, map, think, purpose; aim, offer
words.translation: 提议；求婚；建议；打算，计划；打算

examples.en: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
examples.zh: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

examples.en: the proposed budget cuts
examples.zh: 所提出的预算削减

words.definition: A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true; sentence, theme, subject, offer
words.translation: 陈述，主张；报价；[数]命题；提议；主题；议题

examples.en: The proposition that democracies do not fight each other is based on a tiny historical sample.
examples.zh: 民主国家间互不交战的观点是基于一个微不足道的历史实例。

words.definition: fitness, ceremony, relevance
words.translation: 正当行为；正当；适当；礼节；得体

words.definition: to leave a job, school etc, especially without finishing it completely; yield, desert, split, get out; split, get out; leaving, Gone away
words.translation: 离开；停止；放弃；使…解除；[劳经]辞职；[计]退出

examples.en: He quit his job after an argument with a colleague.
examples.zh: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

examples.en: I quit school at 16.
examples.zh: 我十六岁辍学。

examples.en: She has decided to quit show business.
examples.zh: 她已决定退出娱乐圈。

words.definition: to shake slightly because you are cold, or because you feel very afraid, angry, excited etc; shock, flesh-creep; quake, judder; thrill
words.translation: 颤动，抖动；颤抖；箭袋；震动；振动；使…颤动；抖动

examples.en: The child was quivering in her arms.
examples.zh: 那孩子在她怀里发抖。

examples.en: Her mouth quivered slightly as she turned away.
examples.zh: 她嘴唇微微哆嗦着，转过头去。

words.definition: an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period; norm, allowance
words.translation: 配额，限额(进口及移民人数)；配额；[经管]定额；[经]限额

examples.en: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
examples.zh: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

examples.en: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
examples.zh: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

words.translation: 吵闹声；球拍；吵闹，喧闹

examples.zh: 这台旧机器以前噪音大得吓人。

words.translation: 雷达

examples.en: The coastline can now be monitored by radar.
examples.zh: 现在能用雷达监测海岸线了。

examples.en: We could see the plane quite clearly on the radar screen.
examples.zh: 我们在雷达屏幕上可清晰地看到飞机。

words.definition: if something radiates light or heat, or if light or heat radiates from something, the light or heat is sent out in all directions; release, send, broadcast, beam, project; shine on, light emission; spokewise
words.translation: 发射，放射；[物]辐射；传播；流露；发射；广播；发光；从中心向各方伸展；[物]辐射状的，有射线的

examples.en: The log fire radiated a warm cosy glow.
examples.zh: 燃烧的原木发出温暖舒适的红光。

words.definition: thorough, organic, fundamental, ultimate, complete; elements, basis, foundation, base, bed
words.translation: 根本的，基本的，政治激进的；激进的；根本的；彻底的；基础；激进分子；[物化]原子团；[数]根数

words.definition: the distance from the centre to the edge of a circle, or a line drawn from the centre to the edge; semidiameter
words.translation: 半径；以半径度量的面积；[数]半径，半径范围；[解剖]桡骨；辐射光线；有效航程

examples.en: The shock of the explosion was felt over a radius of forty miles.
examples.zh: 爆炸引起的剧烈震动在方圆40英里内都能感觉得到。

words.definition: a flat floating structure, usually made of pieces of wood tied together, used as a boat; lots of, wealth, ocean, body, billion
words.translation: 木排，木筏；筏；救生艇；（美）大量

examples.en: ...a river trip on bamboo rafts through dense rainforest.
examples.zh: …一次乘着竹筏穿过茂密雨林的河上旅行。

words.definition: a strong feeling of uncontrollable anger; anger, wrath; obtain, anger
words.translation: 狂怒；愤怒；狂暴，肆虐；情绪激动；大怒，发怒；流行，风行

examples.zh: 卡罗尔气得呜呜哭，被送往医院。

examples.zh: 里琴斯17岁那年一怒之下捅了一名少年。

examples.zh: 一群群破衣烂衫的孩子在岩石间玩耍。

words.definition: a short attack on a place by soldiers, planes, or ships, intended to cause damage but not take control; robbery, assault; hit, descend on

examples.zh: 轰炸

examples.zh: 空袭警报

words.definition: a bar that is fastened along or around something, especially to stop you from going somewhere or from falling; pen, rider; rate, beef about

examples.zh: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

words.definition: a large public meeting, especially one that is held outdoors to support a political idea, protest etc; league, restore; assemble, fall in; assembly, feedback, meet, gathering, congregation

examples.zh: 大约有1,000人参加了海德公园的集会。

examples.zh: 我们决定举行集会来对政府施压。

examples.zh: 支持加薪要求的大型集会

examples.zh: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。

examples.zh: 餐厅里，球队的照片排列在墙上。

examples.zh: 绑匪索取25万美元的赎金。

examples.zh: 政府拒绝交付赎金。

examples.zh: 他得到了赎金。

words.translation: 非常地，难得

examples.zh: 双方人数对比是一对四。

examples.zh: 在数据库快照中，注意清单 3 中的计数器并监控这些计数器之间的比例。

examples.zh: 父母需要充分了解情况，这样才可以作出合理的决定。

examples.zh: 我相信这一切都有合理的解释。

examples.zh: 不可能和他进行理性的谈话。

words.translation: 提醒；使想起

examples.zh: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

examples.zh: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

words.translation: 汇款(海外)，汇款额

examples.zh: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。

examples.zh: 在目前的这座教堂下面还有残余的古罗马地板。

words.translation: 懊悔，悔恨；懊悔；同情

examples.zh: 整个审判过程中，他没有表示出一丝悔意。

examples.zh: …伦敦美术馆里文艺复兴时期的杰作。

examples.zh: 为有困难的人提供援助的义务

examples.zh: 一张3,200美元服务费的账单

words.translation: 约会；集会，聚会之地点；约会地点；集结地；[军][航]会合

examples.zh: 秘密约会的计划

words.translation: 修理，恢复；革新；修理；恢复活力

words.translation: 有名望的，声誉鹊起的；著名的；有声望的

examples.zh: 这个地区以其罗马式教堂闻名。

words.translation: 击退；使厌恶；抵制；使不愉快

examples.zh: 这气味让他反感。

words.translation: 遣返；返回

examples.zh: 战后，战俘被遣返。

words.translation: 悔悟，后悔；后悔；忏悔；对…感到后悔；[植]匍匐生根的；[动]爬行的

examples.zh: 他说，那些不肯悔悟的人将受到惩罚。

words.translation: 全部剧目，全部节目

examples.zh: 婴幼儿的行为能力

words.translation: 重复；背诵；副本

examples.zh: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

words.translation: 代表；声称；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送；提出异议

examples.zh: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

words.translation: 责备，指责；责备；耻辱；申斥

examples.zh: “你不需要我。”她语气平静，没有丝毫责备。

examples.zh: 禽类是由爬虫类进化而来，所以，第一只禽鸟肯定是从爬虫类孵化的蛋里出来的。

examples.zh: 不论皮肤多么干燥，你永远不会变成美洲鳄或任何其他一种皮肤粗糙的爬行动物。

examples.zh: 这种身长只有10厘米小型爬行动物，可以在沙子中以最快每秒15厘米的速度游动。

examples.zh: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

words.translation: 要求；请求；[计]请求；需要；要求，[计]请求

examples.zh: 欲知详情，请拨打我们的免费电话。

words.translation: 援救；营救；解救

examples.zh: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

examples.zh: 他和皮特有一个惊人的相似之处。

words.translation: 类似，像

examples.zh: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

examples.zh: 他长大了，很像他父亲。

words.translation: 传闻；谣传；谣言

examples.zh: 美国政府官员对一场政变的传闻将信将疑。

examples.zh: 乡村环境

examples.zh: 乡村公共汽车路线

examples.zh: 车上有大片锈斑。

words.translation: 残忍的，无情的；无情的，残忍的

examples.zh: 无情的独裁者
