examples.zh: 巨款

examples.en: The team made an enormous effort.
examples.zh: 该队付出了巨大的努力。

words.definition: question, probe, examine, query; question, query, inquire of
words.translation: 询问，打听；询问；调查；问候（等于inquire）；打听

examples.en: I am writing to confirm /enquire/inform you…
examples.zh: 我写信是要确认/询问/通知你…

examples.en: I recently e-mailed one website to enquire why my goods had not yet arrived.
examples.zh: 我最近给一个网站发邮件去询问为什么我订购的商品还没有到达。

examples.en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
examples.zh: 你们无论进那一城，那一村，要打听那里谁是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的时候。

words.definition: question, quaere
words.translation: 询问，打听；[计]询问，[贸易]询盘

words.definition: to improve the quality of something, especially by adding things to it; fertilize
words.translation: 使丰富，加料于，增进；使充实；使肥沃；使富足

examples.en: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.
examples.zh: 施上肥料使土壤肥沃。

examples.en: Education can greatly enrich your life.
examples.zh: 教育可以大大充实生活。

words.definition: register, book in; participate in, take part in, go through
words.translation: 招收，入伍，入学；登记；使加入；把...记入名册；使入伍；参加；注册；记入名册

examples.en: The school will enroll new students in August.
examples.zh: 这所学校将于八月份招收新生.

words.definition: the process of arranging to join a school, university, course etc; registration, entry
words.translation: 登记，入学；登记，注册；入学

examples.en: Enrolment will take place in September.
examples.zh: 注册将于9月进行。

words.definition: An ensemble is a group of musicians, actors, or dancers who regularly perform together; en bloc, entireness; meanwhile, together
words.translation: 全体；演唱组；总效果；全套服装；全套家具；合奏组；同时

examples.en: ...an ensemble of young musicians.
examples.zh: …一个由年轻音乐家组成的乐团。

words.definition: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it; follow on, succeed to; ambition, pursue / pursuit
words.translation: 跟着发生；结果是；跟着发生，接着发生；继起；追求

examples.en: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
examples.zh: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

words.definition: to involve something as a necessary part or result; charge, inflict on
words.translation: 使必需；必需，使承担；限定继承

examples.en: A new computer system entails a lot of re-training.
examples.zh: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

examples.en: Some foreign travel is entailed in the job.
examples.zh: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

words.definition: to make something become twisted and caught in a rope, net etc; cloud, intertangle
words.translation: 缠住，套住；使纠缠；卷入；使混乱

examples.en: The blade of the oar had entangled itself with the strap of her bag.
examples.zh: 桨叶和她包的带子紧紧缠在了一起。

words.definition: a company, organization, or business; career, cause, undertaking, project, push
words.translation: 艰巨的事业；事业心，企业；[经]企业；事业；进取心；事业心

examples.en: commercial enterprises such as banks and food manufacturers
examples.zh: 银行和食品制造厂等商业企业

words.definition: things such as films, television, performances etc that are intended to amuse or interest people; recreation, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 娱乐，招待，表演；娱乐；消遣；款待

examples.en: The town provides a wide choice of entertainment.
examples.zh: 该镇提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

examples.en: There will be live entertainment (= performed then, not recorded ) throughout the day.
examples.zh: 现场表演将持续一整天。

examples.en: The dolphins give good entertainment value (= a lot of amusement and interest ).
examples.zh: 海豚具有很高的娱乐价值。

words.definition: passion, flame, fire, warmth
words.translation: 娱乐，招待，表演；热心，热忱，热情

words.definition: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something; intense, warm, crazy, eager, tropical
words.translation: 热情的，热心的；热情的；热心的；狂热的

examples.en: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
examples.zh: 改革的热心支持者

words.definition: If the title of something such as a book, film, or painting is, for example, "Sunrise," you can say that it is entitled "Sunrise."
words.translation: 给(书)题名；给予权利

examples.en: ...a performance entitled "United States."
examples.zh: …一场名为“合众国”的演出。

words.definition: something that exists as a single and complete unit; presence, existence, essence, principle, texture
words.translation: 实体；存在；本质

examples.en: The mind exists as a separate entity.
examples.zh: 思想作为一个独立的实体存在。

examples.en: Good design brings a house and garden together as a single entity.
examples.zh: 优秀的设计能把一所房子和花园合为一体。

words.definition: to ask someone, in a very emotional way, to do something for you; pray for, appeal for; pray for, cry on
words.translation: 恳求，央求；恳求；请求；乞求

examples.en: He entreated them to delay their departure.
examples.zh: 他恳求他们晚些再走。

words.definition: someone who starts a new business or arranges business deals in order to make money, often in a way that involves financial risks; contractor, enterpriser
words.translation: [法]企业家, 演出承包人 "；企业家；承包人；主办者

words.definition: the act of going into something; threshold, registration, access, portal
words.translation: 进入，入口；条目，词条；进入；入口；条目；登记；报关手续；对土地的侵占

examples.en: There was no sign of a forced entry.
examples.zh: 没有强行闯入的迹象。

examples.en: How did the thieves gain entry (= get in )?
examples.zh: 窃贼是怎样进入的？

words.definition: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities; context, circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 环境；[环境]环境，外界

examples.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
examples.zh: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

examples.en: legislation to protect the environment
examples.zh: 保护环境的法规

examples.en: the effects of acid rain on the environment
examples.zh: 酸雨对环境的影响

words.definition: to think that something is likely to happen in the future; imagine, picture, think of
words.translation: 想象；期望；设想；正视，面对；想像

examples.en: The scheme cost a lot more than we had originally envisaged.
examples.zh: 该计划的花费大大超出了我们最初所预想的数额。

words.definition: to wish that you had someone else’s possessions, abilities etc; jealousy, green-eyed monster; green eyed, be jealous
words.translation: 忌妒，妒忌的对象；羡慕；嫉妒，妒忌

examples.en: I really envy you and Ian, you seem so happy together.
examples.zh: 我真是羡慕你和伊恩，你俩在一起看起来多幸福。

examples.en: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.
examples.zh: 她的生活方式会令大多数人感到羡慕。

words.definition: a chemical substance that is produced in a plant or animal, and helps chemical changes to take place in the plant or animal; zyme
words.translation: 酶；[生化]酶

examples.en: It is believed that it inhibits an enzyme that promotes cell proliferation in tumours.
examples.zh: 据信它能抑制一种能在肿瘤中促进细胞增殖的酶的生成。

examples.en: This enzyme accumulates in the larvae to a level where it becomes toxic and kills them.
examples.zh: 这种酶在幼虫体内积累到一定浓度，就会变得有毒并杀死它们。

examples.en: Apparently, though, CYP2E1 affects how sensitive the brain is to alcohol, perhaps because it —unlike the enzyme in the liver —generates free radicals, tiny molecules that can damage cells.
examples.zh: 虽然表面上是这样，CYP2E1却影响着大脑对酒精的敏感度，或许因为它—不像在肝脏中的酶—产生了自由基，能损害细胞的微小分子。

words.definition: someone who has been forced to live in exile; transportation, banishment; transport, banish
words.translation: 流放，离乡背井；流放，充军；放逐，被放逐者；流犯；放逐，流放；使背井离乡

examples.en: political exiles
examples.zh: 政治流亡者

words.definition: an exorbitant price, amount of money etc is much higher than it should be; excessive, ultra, tall
words.translation: 要价过高的，过分的；（要价等）过高的；（性格等）过分的；不在法律范围之内的

examples.en: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
examples.zh: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

words.definition: something that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country – use this to show approval; outside, extraneous
words.translation: 外国种的；奇异的；[物]异国的；[语]外来的；异国情调的

examples.en: exotic birds
examples.zh: 外国的奇异鸟类

examples.en: exotic places
examples.zh: 有异国风情的地方

words.definition: to become larger in size, number, or amount, or to make something become larger; dwell on, enlarge on; grow, go way
words.translation: 使扩大，展开，膨胀；扩张；使膨胀；详述；发展；张开，展开

examples.en: Water expands as it freezes.
examples.zh: 水结冰时会膨胀。

examples.en: Sydney’s population expanded rapidly in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 20世纪60年代，悉尼的人口迅速增加。

examples.en: exercises that expand the chest muscles
examples.zh: 扩展胸肌的运动

words.definition: helping you to deal with a problem quickly and effectively although sometimes in a way that is not morally right; a quick and effective way of dealing with a problem; convenient, favorable, beneficial, advantageous; quick fix, makeshift
words.translation: 有用的，有利的；紧急的办法，权宜之计；权宜的；方便的；有利的；权宜之计；应急手段

examples.en: This solution is politically expedient but may well cause long-term problems.
examples.zh: 这种解决方法是政治上的权宜之计，但会引起长远的问题。

words.definition: a long and carefully organized journey, especially to a dangerous or unfamiliar place, or the people that make this journey; velocity, speed
words.translation: 远征，探险(队)，考察(队)；远征；探险队；迅速

examples.en: an expedition to the North Pole
examples.zh: 北极探险

examples.en: another Qomolangma expedition
examples.zh: 又一次珠穆朗玛峰探险

words.definition: to officially force someone to leave a school or organization; remove, oust
words.translation: 驱逐，开除；排出；驱逐；开除

examples.en: More than five-thousand high school students have been expelled for cheating.
examples.zh: 五千多名中学生因考试作弊而被开除。

words.definition: To expend something, especially energy, time, or money, means to use it or spend it; invested, cost, spend, waste, consume
words.translation: 消费，用尽；花费；消耗；用光；耗尽

examples.en: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.
examples.zh: 孩子们耗能多，可能比成人需要更多高能量的食物。

words.definition: the total amount of money that a government, organization, or person spends during a particular period of time; spending, payout
words.translation: 支出，花费，消费量；[会计]支出，花费；经费，消费额

examples.en: huge cuts in public expenditure
examples.zh: 大幅度削减公共开支

examples.en: government expenditure on education
examples.zh: 政府的教育开支

examples.en: {"GLOSS":["spending by a company on buildings, machinery, equipment etc"],"COLLOINEXA":["capital expenditure"]}
examples.zh: 〔公司的〕资本开支

words.definition: special skills or knowledge in a particular subject, that you learn by experience or training; special knowledge, professional knowledge
words.translation: 专门知识，专门技能；专门知识；专门技术；专家的意见

examples.en: She was not an accountant and didn't have the expertise to verify all of the financial details.
examples.zh: 她不是会计，不具有核查所有这些财政细目的专业知识。

words.definition: if an official document expires, it can no longer be legally used; die, drop, determine, finish, pass; breathe out, exsufflate
words.translation: 满期，到期；期满；终止；死亡；呼气；呼出（空气）

examples.en: My passport expires next week.
examples.zh: 我的护照下周就到期了。

examples.en: players whose contracts expire this summer
examples.zh: 合约于今年夏天到期的运动员

words.definition: expressed in a way that is very clear and direct; precise, decided, distinct, specific, express
words.translation: 清楚的，明确的；明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的

examples.en: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
examples.zh: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

examples.en: explicit knowledge of grammar
examples.zh: 清楚易懂的语法知识

examples.en: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
examples.zh: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

words.definition: to burst, or to make something burst, into small pieces, usually with a loud noise and in a way that causes damage; blow apart, burst up; shoot, spring, blast
words.translation: (使)爆炸，爆发；爆炸，爆发；激增；使爆炸；爆炸；推翻

examples.en: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
examples.zh: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

examples.en: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
examples.zh: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

words.definition: a brave and exciting adventure that someone has had; to treat someone unfairly by asking them to do things for you, but giving them very little in return – used to show disapproval; develop, mine; merit, feat
words.translation: 英雄行为，辉煌功绩；开拓，开采，剥削；开发，开拓；剥削；开采；勋绩；功绩

examples.zh: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

words.translation: 勘察，考查；探索；探测；探险

examples.en: Venice is a wonderful city to explore.
examples.zh: 威尼斯是一个美妙的城市，值得好好探究一番。

words.definition: volatile, fulminic; blasting agent, detonator
words.translation: 爆炸(的)，爆发性(的)；[力]爆炸的；爆炸性的；爆发性的；[化工]炸药；[力]爆炸物

examples.en: ...one-hundred-and-fifty pounds of Semtex explosive.
examples.zh: …150磅的塞姆汀塑料炸药。

words.definition: to sell goods to another country; the business of selling and sending goods to other countries; output, exit; output, bulk out
words.translation: 输出，出口；出口，出口企业，出口品；输出，[贸易]出口；出口商品

examples.en: Italian food has been exported all over the world.
examples.zh: 意大利食品已传遍世界。

words.definition: to show the truth about someone or something, especially when it is bad; reveal, prove, make clear, disclose

examples.en: The film exposes the utter horror of war.
examples.zh: 这部电影揭示了战争的极端恐怖。

examples.en: The report exposes the weaknesses of modern medical practice.
examples.zh: 报道揭露了现代医疗的不足之处。

words.definition: a clear and detailed explanation; expansion, exhibition, fair
words.translation: 阐述，讲解；展览会；博览会；阐述

examples.en: Aristotle was valued because of his clear exposition of rational thought.
examples.zh: 亚里士多德因其对理性思维的清晰阐述而被重视。

words.definition: the act of forcing someone to leave a place; ouster, exclusion
words.translation: 驱逐; 开除；驱逐；开除

examples.en: The headmaster threatened the boys with expulsion.
examples.zh: 校长警告这几名男生说要开除他们。

words.definition: extremely beautiful and very delicately made; elegant, severe, novel, sophisticated, pretty
words.translation: 优美的，精巧的；精致的；细腻的；优美的，高雅的；异常的；剧烈的

examples.en: the most exquisite craftsmanship
examples.zh: 最精美的工艺

words.definition: to continue for a particular distance or over a particular area; afford, allow, deal, deliver, finger; reach, spread, range, enlarge, push
words.translation: 伸出，延长；给予；扩大；延伸；推广；伸出；使竭尽全力；对…估价；伸展；使疏开

examples.en: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

words.definition: degree, boundary, region, length, spectrum, territory, area
words.translation: 广度，长度，程度；程度；范围；[计量]长度

words.definition: a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work; possible, working, potential, viable
words.translation: 可行的，可信的；可行的；可能的；可实行的

examples.en: a feasible solution
examples.zh: 可行的解决方法

words.definition: A feast is a large and special meal; enjoy, guest; festival, holiday; banquet
words.translation: 筵席，宴请，使享受；享受；款待，宴请；筵席，宴会；节日；参加宴会

examples.en: Lunch was a feast of meat and vegetables, cheese, yoghurt and fruit, with unlimited wine.
examples.zh: 午餐是一场盛宴，有肉、蔬菜、奶酪、酸奶和水果，以及不限量的葡萄酒。

examples.en: The fruit was often served at wedding feasts.
examples.zh: 婚宴上常有水果供应。

words.definition: something that is an impressive achievement, because it needs a lot of skill, strength etc to do; merit, exploit; becoming, shaped, applicable, likely, possible
words.translation: 技艺，功绩，武艺；功绩，壮举；技艺表演；合适的；灵巧的

examples.en: A racing car is an extraordinary feat of engineering.
examples.zh: 赛车是工程学的一项非凡业绩。

words.definition: a part of something that you notice because it seems important, interesting, or typical; person, characteristic; star
words.translation: 脸一部分，面貌，特征，特写，故事片；特色，特征；容貌；特写或专题节目；特写；以…为特色；由…主演

examples.en: Air bags are a standard feature in most new cars.
examples.zh: 气囊是大多数新车的标准配置。

examples.en: Striped tails are a common feature of many animals.
examples.zh: 尾巴上有条纹是许多动物的共同特征。

examples.en: The hotel’s only redeeming features (= things that make it acceptable ) were that it was cheap and near the city centre.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆仅有的可取之处就是价格低廉并且靠近市中心。

words.definition: a group of organizations, clubs, or people that have joined together to form a single group; alliance, combined with, union, unity, combination, association
words.translation: 联邦, 联盟, 同盟 "；联合；联邦；联盟；联邦政府

examples.en: the National Federation of Women’s Institutes
examples.zh: 〔英国及英联邦国家〕妇女协会全国联合会

words.definition: an amount of money that you pay to do something or that you pay to a professional person for their work; charge, cost, tip
words.translation: 费，报名费，会费；[会计]费用；[劳经]酬金；小费

examples.en: You can use the gym and pool for a fee of £35 a month.
examples.zh: 月付35英镑，即可使用健身房和游泳池。

words.definition: extremely weak; weak, small, thin
words.translation: 虚弱的，无力的；微弱的，无力的；虚弱的；薄弱的

examples.en: His voice sounded feeble and far away.
examples.zh: 他的声音听上去既无力又遥远。

examples.en: She was too feeble to leave her room.
examples.zh: 她身体虚弱，无法走出自己的房间。

words.definition: If you get feedback on your work or progress, someone tells you how well or badly you are doing, and how you could improve. If you get good feedback you have worked or performed well.; production, outcome, information
words.translation: 反应，用户反应；[电子][自]反馈；成果，资料；回复

examples.en: Continue to ask for feedback on your work.
examples.zh: 继续征求对你工作的反馈。

words.definition: to give you a particular physical feeling, especially when you touch or hold something; expect, count, guess, find, make; fish for, poke about; consciousness, sense perception
words.translation: 感觉，摸，感知；同情；感觉；认为；触摸；试探；觉得；摸索

examples.en: It’s nice fabric - it feels like velvet.
examples.zh: 面料不错——摸上去像丝绒。

words.definition: a group of people who share an interest or belief, especially Christians who have religious ceremonies together; friendship, scholarship
words.translation: 交情；团体；奖学金；友谊；研究员职位

examples.en: ...the National Schizophrenia Fellowship.
examples.zh: …全国精神分裂协会。

words.definition: an animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs; delicate, feminine; she, jenny
words.translation: 女性(的)，[语]阴性(的)；女性的；[生物]雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的；女人；[植][动]雌性动物

examples.en: Hay fever affects males more than females.
examples.zh: 男性感染花粉热多于女性。

words.definition: maintain, support, secure, preserve, sustain; nurse, attend on
words.translation: 抵挡；谋生；保护；挡开；供养；照料；力争

examples.en: She raised her arm up to fend branches from her eyes.
examples.zh: 她抬起胳膊将树枝从她眼前挡开。

examples.en: Protection of the vital oil fields remained a unifying goal, and the United States viewed a more capable Saudi military, one able to fend off regional and domestic threats, as key to attaining it.
examples.zh: 保护重要石油地区的安全是两国统一的目标，而美军认为一个能够抵御地区和国内威胁的更加强大的沙特军队，是实现这一目标的关键。

words.definition: violent, dangerous, and frightening; tremendous, cruel, brutal, incredible, spectacular
words.translation: 凶猛的，凶残的；残忍的；惊人的

examples.en: a ferocious, hungry lion
examples.zh: 一头凶猛的饿狮

examples.en: a ferocious battle

examples.zh: 他们乘船又一次渡过了冈比亚河。

words.definition: fertile land or soil is able to produce good crops; rich, viable; pregnancy, enrichment

examples.zh: 800英亩的肥沃耕地

examples.zh: 这一争端可以追溯到积累了好几个世纪的仇怨。

examples.zh: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

words.definition: If you fetch something or someone, you go and get them from the place where they are; absorb, attract, engage, draw, strike; take; taking, procurement, scheme, fraud
words.translation: (去)取，拿来；(货物)售的(价钱)；取来；接来；到达；吸引；拿；取物；卖得；取得；诡计

examples.zh: 西尔维娅从浴室拿来一条毛巾。

examples.zh: 给我拿杯水来。

words.definition: to make someone feel physically or mentally stronger; enhance, cement, muscle, build up
words.translation: 设防于；增强；加强；（酒）的酒精含量

examples.zh: 该镇设有重防。

examples.zh: 理事会成员们一致认为那是一个用于讨论的重要论坛。

examples.zh: 早期爬行动物的化石

examples.zh: 海绵动物留下了漫长的化石记录。

words.definition: to take someone else’s child into your family for a period of time but without becoming their legal parent; cultivate, rear, raise, plant, mother

examples.zh: 那对夫妇想收养他们代养的一个黑人小孩。

words.definition: a foul smell or taste is very unpleasant; evil, ill, black, ugly, dirty; soil, mud, spot, dirty; break rules, rot away; illegality; wrong, unlawfully

examples.zh: 他醒过来，嘴里一股臭味。

examples.en: a pile of foul-smelling garbage
examples.zh: 一堆臭烘烘的垃圾

examples.zh: 他放下手中一大杯难喝的咖啡。

words.definition: a structure from which water is pushed up into the air, used for example as decoration in a garden or park; principle, well

examples.zh: 他是亚洲事务的信息源。

words.definition: a part of a whole number in mathematics, such as ½ or ¾; score, marks, proportion, part, portion

examples.zh: 90岁以上的妇女中至少有1/3遭受过髋骨骨折。

words.definition: easily broken or damaged; delicate, crumbly

examples.en: fragile bones
examples.zh: 脆弱的骨头

words.definition: a small piece of something that has broken off or that comes from something larger; to break something, or be broken into a lot of small separate parts – used to show disapproval; debris, chip

words.definition: someone who is frail is weak and thin because they are old or ill; weak, tender, slight; girl-o, chicklet
words.translation: 脆弱的；虚弱的；灯心草篓；少妇；少女

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["frail elderly people"]}
examples.zh: 年老体衰者

examples.zh: 她虚弱的身体

words.definition: a set of ideas, rules, or beliefs from which something is developed, or on which decisions are based; configuration, mechanics, texture, structure

examples.zh: 我们必须在现行的法律框架下行事。

words.definition: If you are frantic, you are behaving in a wild and uncontrolled way because you are frightened or worried; crazy, possessed, mad

examples.zh: 一只鸟被关了起来，到现在它都非常狂躁。

words.definition: the crime of deceiving people in order to gain something such as money or goods; scheme, sharp, deception
words.translation: 诈骗，骗子；欺骗；骗子；诡计

examples.zh: 选举欺诈

examples.zh: 她被判犯有诈骗罪。

words.definition: If a situation or action is fraught with problems or risks, it is filled with them; worried, afraid, packed
words.translation: 充满的；伴随的；担心的，忧虑的；充满…的

examples.en: The earliest operations employing this technique were fraught with dangers.
examples.zh: 最早采用这一技术的手术充满了危险。

words.definition: someone who is considered to be very strange because of the way they look, behave, or think; put, odd; abnormal, fantastic, funny, bizarre
words.translation: 怪诞的思想、行动或事件；畸形的；怪人，怪事；畸形人；反复无常；奇异的，反常的

examples.en: These glasses make me look like a freak.
examples.zh: 我戴这副眼镜看上去像个怪人。

examples.en: Women who studied engineering used to be considered freaks.
examples.zh: 学工程的女性过去常被视为怪物。

words.definition: goods that are carried by ship, train, or aircraft, and the system of moving these goods; to send goods by air, sea, or train; ship, transit, forward; charges, carriage
words.translation: 运货，货物；运输；运送；装货；使充满；货运；[交]运费；[水运]船货

examples.zh: 货运公司

examples.zh: 你的个人物品我们将以空运方式运送，家具将以海运方式运送。

examples.zh: 别担心——一切都会好的。

examples.zh: 我想要啤酒变凉，因此我把它放在冰箱里一小时。

examples.zh: 它可以是任何玩意儿：从你冰箱后面那些变质的牛奶到沥青和羽毛。

words.translation: 缘饰，毛边，边缘，刘海；装上缘饰；边缘；穗；刘海；边缘的；附加的

examples.zh: 一头棕色直发、留着刘海的高个子女孩

words.translation: 苍白的；可怕的；令人不快的；惨白的；惊人的；极坏的

examples.en: a ghastly accident
examples.zh: 可怕的事故

examples.zh: 如果你再咯咯地笑个不停，就给我离开屋子。

examples.zh: 不要去管各个细节，只要理解主要意思就行了。

examples.zh: 在休斯敦地区，任何一天医院的床位都有一半是空的。

examples.zh: 一个贪婪自私的社会

examples.zh: 我们生活当中的每一个变化都有让人伤心的一面。

examples.zh: 人们在所爱之人去世后会有一段悲伤期。

examples.zh: 那孩子死死抓住她的胳膊。

words.translation: 露齿而笑，咧嘴一笑

examples.zh: 他走进房间，脸上带着亲切的微笑。

examples.zh: 磨刀剪的石头

examples.zh: 紧紧握住麦克风不要让它动。

examples.zh: 她觉得手腕像是卡在铁钳里被牢牢地抓住了。

examples.zh: 抓住绳索别松手，不然你会掉下去。

examples.zh: 如果他们颁发毅力金牌，卡伦应该站在领奖台上。

words.translation: 呻吟，呻吟着表示;承受重压发出的声音

examples.zh: 他用左手摸索到门把手，转动把手，把门拉开。

examples.zh: 该公司去年税前收入为1680万美元。

examples.zh: 所以，我从不吝惜我的爱。

words.translation: 埋怨，咕哝，发牢骚；抱怨；嘟囔；怨言；喃喃地说出

examples.zh: “这真无聊。”凯瑟琳抱怨道。

examples.en: computer hardware that quickly became obsolete
examples.zh: 很快就变得过时的电脑硬件

examples.en: Will computers render (= make ) books obsolete?
examples.zh: 计算机会把书籍淘汰掉吗？

words.definition: something that makes it difficult to achieve some­thing; interference, let, bar, disturbance, dam
words.translation: 障碍；障碍，干扰；妨害物

examples.en: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
examples.zh: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

examples.en: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
examples.zh: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

examples.en: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
examples.zh: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

words.definition: determined not to change your ideas, behaviour, opinions etc, even when other people think you are being unreasonable; resistant, stubborn
words.translation: 顽固的，倔强的，不易屈服的，较难治愈的；顽固的；倔强的；难以控制的

examples.en: He was the most obstinate man I’ve ever met.
examples.zh: 他是我遇到过的最固执的人。

examples.en: Don’t be so obstinate!
examples.zh: 别这么固执！

examples.en: an obstinate refusal to obey
examples.zh: 固执地拒绝服从

words.definition: to block a road, passage etc; let, violate; plug up, block up
words.translation: 阻塞，堵塞；妨碍；阻塞；遮断；设障碍

examples.en: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
examples.zh: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

examples.en: The column obstructed our view of the stage.
examples.zh: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

words.definition: easy to notice or understand; distinct, visible, prominent, marked, evident
words.translation: 明显的，清楚的；明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的

examples.en: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
examples.zh: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

words.definition: a suitable or favourable time; to cause something; opportunity, chance, opening, sake, reason; attract, cause, produce, operate, induce
words.translation: 的时刻；机会；需要；引起，导致；时机，机会；场合；理由；引起，惹起

examples.en: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago in New Orleans.
examples.zh: 我经常深情地想起一些年前在新奥尔良所发生的一幕。

words.definition: to live or stay in a place; bag, exercise
words.translation: 居住；占；占据，占领；使忙碌

examples.en: He occupies the house without paying any rent.
examples.zh: 他住在这幢房子里，没有付一分钱房租。

examples.en: The building was purchased and occupied by its new owners last year.
examples.zh: 这幢房屋去年被新业主买下入住了。

words.definition: to happen; happen, exist, proceed, figure, offer
words.translation: 发生；想起，想到；存在；出现

examples.en: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
examples.zh: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

examples.en: The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
examples.zh: 爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

words.definition: something that happens; emergence, going on, event, discovery, appearance, circumstance, scene
words.translation: 发生；出现；事件；发现

examples.en: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
examples.zh: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

words.definition: different from what is normal or expected, especially in a way that you disapprove of or cannot understand; remaining, extraordinary, temporary, surplus, residual; put, wack
words.translation: 古怪的，奇数的；单独的；零头的；临时的；[数]奇数的；古怪的；剩余的；零散的；[数]奇数；怪人；奇特的事物

examples.en: It was an odd thing to say.
examples.zh: 这话说得很奇怪。

examples.en: an odd way to behave
examples.zh: 古怪的行为

examples.en: They’re an odd couple.
examples.zh: 他们是古怪的一对。

words.definition: how likely it is that something will or will not happen; distinction, differential, contrast
words.translation: 可能，机会；几率；胜算；不平等；差别

examples.en: (= it is likely ) that he will commit the same crime again.
examples.zh: 他可能还会犯同样的罪行。

examples.en: (= how likely is it ) that they will mess up?
examples.zh: 他们失败的可能性有多大？

examples.en: a new company that has beaten the odds and succeeded (= it was not likely to succeed, but it did )
examples.zh: 战胜逆境而取得成功的一家新公司

words.definition: used with a present participle to form the  continuous 4  tenses of verbs; at
words.translation: at；odds；with；有争执；在，存在；是

examples.en: Don’t disturb me while I’m working.
examples.zh: 我工作的时候不要打扰我。

examples.en: Gemma was reading.
examples.zh: 吉玛正在看书。

examples.en: They’ve been asking a lot of questions.
examples.zh: 他们已经问了许多问题。

words.definition: smell, wind, fame
words.translation: 气味，香气；臭气；气味；名声

examples.en: The researchers demonstrate that it is possible to generate odor in a compact device that can fit on the back of a TV with potentially thousands of odors.
examples.zh: 研究员表示，将一个可以散发上千种气味的小型设备安装在电视背后，从而实现电视(根据情景)生成气味是可能的。

words.definition: a long journey with a lot of adventures or difficulties
words.translation: 长途冒险旅行；一连串的冒险

examples.en: a spiritual odyssey
examples.zh: 一次精神上的艰难历程

words.definition: an illegal action or a crime; crime, attempt, attack, violation, guilt
words.translation: 犯罪，犯规；冒犯；犯罪；违反；过错；攻击

examples.en: His solicitor said he committed the offence because he was heavily in debt.
examples.zh: 他的律师说他犯罪是因为欠下巨债。

words.definition: give offense, gross out; vary, be in breach of
words.translation: 犯罪；冒犯；攻击；使…不愉快；违反；进攻；引起不舒服

words.definition: a statement saying that you are willing to do something for someone or give them something; afford, undertake, try, tender, lend; proposal, intention, meaning, will, bid; occur, figure, come out
words.translation: 违犯；伤害的感情；提供；提议；出价；试图；意图；出现；献祭；求婚

examples.en: The offer of talks with Moscow marks a significant change from the previous Western position.
examples.zh: 与莫斯科会谈的提议标志着先前西方立场的一个重大转变。

words.definition: a way of expressing or getting rid of strong feelings; exit, market, way out
words.translation: 河流等出口，出路；发泄(感情等)的方法；出口，排放孔；[电]电源插座；[贸易]销路；发泄的方法；批发商店

examples.en: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
examples.zh: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的途径。

words.definition: the main ideas or facts about something, without the details; profile, program, brief, contour; summarize, sum up
words.translation: 外形，轮廓；大纲，纲要；轮廓；大纲；概要；略图；概述；略述；描画…轮廓

examples.en: a research proposal outline
examples.zh: 研究计划梗概

words.definition: far from the centre of a city, town etc or from a main building; unrelated, irrespective
words.translation: 远离中心的，偏僻的；边远的；无关的

examples.en: one of the outlying suburbs
examples.zh: 边远郊区之一

words.definition: the amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, factory etc; export, crop, harvest, yield; export, bulk out
words.translation: 产量；产出；[计]输出，输出量；[经]产量；出产；[计]输出

examples.en: Output is up 30% on last year.
examples.zh: 产量比去年提高了30%。

words.definition: very shocking and extremely unfair or offensive; bearish, abhorrent
words.translation: 残暴的，蛮横的；粗暴的；可恶的；令人吃惊的

examples.en: outrageous prices
examples.zh: 骇人的价格

examples.en: an outrageous attack on his policies
examples.zh: 对他政策的蛮横攻击

words.definition: overall, heartily; thorough, full, complete, absolute, total
words.translation: 断然的；明白无误的；全部地；立刻地；率直地；一直向前；痛快地；完全的，彻底的；直率的；总共的

examples.en: an outright refusal
examples.zh: 断然拒绝

words.definition: at or from the beginning of an event or process; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, origin
words.translation: 开始，开端；开始；开端

examples.en: It was clear from the outset that there were going to be problems.
examples.zh: 从一开始就很清楚会有问题出现的。

examples.en: It’s better to get something in writing right at the outset.
examples.zh: 最好一开始就有个书面的东西。

words.definition: the parts of a town or city that are furthest from the centre; suburban district, banlieue
words.translation: (尤指城市)郊区；市郊，郊区

examples.en: Hours later we reached the outskirts of New York.
examples.zh: 数小时后我们到达了纽约市的外围地带。

words.definition: expressing your opinions honestly and directly, even when doing this might annoy some people; honest, transparent, open
words.translation: 直言的，坦率的；坦率的，直言不讳的

examples.en: an outspoken critic of the education reforms
examples.zh: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

words.definition: to do something better than someone else or be more successful; better than, overcome, top, cap, outdo
words.translation: 胜过，超过；超过；胜过；比…跑得快

examples.en: We outstripped all our competitors in sales last year.
examples.zh: 去年我们的销售额超过了所有竞争对手。

words.definition: to be more important or valuable than something else; come before, take precedence over
words.translation: 比更重，比更重要；比…重（在重量上）；比…重要；比…有价值

examples.en: The benefits of the scheme outweigh the disadvantages.
examples.zh: 这项计划利大于弊。

words.definition: a shape like a circle, but wider in one direction than the other; elliptical, ovate; ellipse, elliptical shape
words.translation: 卵形(的)，椭圆形(的)；椭圆的；[数]卵形的；椭圆形；[数]卵形

examples.en: Using 2 spoons, form the cheese into small balls or ovals.
examples.zh: 用两把勺把干酪挤成小圆球状或椭圆球状。

words.definition: if a group of people give someone an ovation, they clap to show approval
words.translation: 热烈欢迎，欢呼

examples.en: The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
examples.zh: 总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。

examples.en: Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
examples.zh: 歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

words.definition: considering or including everything; a loose-fitting piece of clothing like a coat, that is worn over clothes to protect them; entire, all, corporate, total, universal; outright; jeans, jea
words.translation: 包括一切的，全部的；罩衫，工装裤；全部的；全体的；一切在内的；全部地；总的说来；工装裤；罩衫

examples.en: The overall cost of the exhibition was £400,000.
examples.zh: 展览会的全部费用是40万英镑。

examples.en: The overall result is an increase in population.
examples.zh: 总的结果是人口增加。

examples.en: An overall winner and a runner-up were chosen.
examples.zh: 总冠军和第二名被选了出来。

words.definition: to successfully control a feeling or problem that prevents you from achieving something; exceed, cap, surmount; rise above, get over sth
words.translation: 克服；压倒；胜过；得胜

examples.en: He struggled to overcome his shyness.
examples.zh: 他努力克服自己的羞怯。

examples.en: Her financial problems could no longer be overcome.
examples.zh: 她的经济困难再也无法解决。

words.definition: not done, paid, returned etc by the time expected; past-due, expired
words.translation: 过期未付的；过期的；迟到的；未兑的

examples.en: an overdue gas bill
examples.zh: 逾期未付的煤气账单

examples.en: The library books are overdue.
examples.zh: 图书馆的书过期未还。

examples.en: The baby was a week overdue (= it was expected to be born a week ago ).
examples.zh: 宝宝超过预产期有一周了。

words.definition: if a river, lake, or container overflows, it is so full that the liquid or material inside flows over its edges; spill over, flow over; filled with, fresh, flood, flow, fullness; spill
words.translation: 泛滥，溢出；[计]溢出；泛滥；充溢；充满，洋溢；超值；溢值；[计]使溢出；使泛滥；使充溢

examples.en: The drains flooded and water overflowed down the main street.
examples.zh: 下水道被淹，水溢到了大街上。

examples.en: The river had overflowed its banks.
examples.zh: 河水漫堤了。

words.definition: to repair or change the necessary parts in a machine, system etc that is not working correctly; major repair; permanent repair
words.translation: 彻底检修；赶上；分解检查，大修；追上并超过；彻底检修，详细检查

examples.en: A mechanic is coming to overhaul the engine.
examples.zh: 一名机修工要来彻底检修引擎。

words.definition: to accidentally hear what other people are saying, when they do not know that you have heard; happen to hear, listen in on
words.translation: 无意中听到，偷听到；无意中听到；偷听

examples.en: I overheard part of their conversation.
examples.zh: 我碰巧听到了他们谈话的部分内容。

examples.en: I couldn’t help overhearing your argument.
examples.zh: 我无意中听到了你们的争吵。

words.definition: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.; repeat, segistration
words.translation: 与…互搭，与重叠，与部分相同；重叠；重复

examples.en: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
examples.zh: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

examples.en: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
examples.zh: 把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

words.definition: to not notice something, or not see how important it is; forget, examine, survey, review, inspect; inobservancy, negligence
words.translation: 俯视；忽略；宽恕；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上；忽视；眺望

examples.en: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
examples.zh: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

examples.en: Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
examples.zh: 谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

words.definition: land or a field that is covered with grass and is used for cattle, sheep etc to feed on; grass, field, lawn, meadow; grass, feed, range
words.translation: 牧场；放牧；草地；[畜牧]牧场；牧草；[畜牧]放牧；吃草

examples.en: large areas of rough upland pasture
examples.zh: 大片起伏的山地牧场

examples.en: the lush pastures of the southern counties
examples.zh: 南部各郡茂盛的牧场

words.definition: a small area of something that is different from the area around it; to repair a hole in something by putting a piece of something else over it; spot, chip, debris; decide, settle
words.translation: 补钉；眼罩；斑点；小块土地；补缀；碎片；修补；解决；掩饰

examples.en: Look out for icy patches on the road.
examples.zh: 小心路上结冰的地方。

examples.en: a cat with a white patch on its chest
examples.zh: 胸部有一块白斑的猫

examples.en: He combs his hair over his bald patch .
examples.zh: 他把头发梳过来盖住秃掉的地方。

words.definition: protected by a patent; a special document that gives you the right to make or sell a new  invention  or product that no one else is allowed to copy; to obtain a special document giving you the right to make or sell a new  invention  or product; apparent, novel, transparent, decided; license, permit
words.translation: 明显的；获得专利的；专利；取得专利；[专利]专利的；新奇的；显然的；[专利]专利权；执照；专利品

examples.en: a patent lock
examples.zh: 专利锁

words.definition: patriline, fatherhood
words.translation: 父系，父系后裔；父权；父系；父系后裔

examples.en: The paternity of the child is in dispute.
examples.zh: 这个孩子的生父是谁尚有疑问。

words.definition: making you feel pity or sympathy; poor, sad, melting, stupid
words.translation: 可怜的，悲惨的；不适当的；可怜的，悲哀的；感伤的；乏味的

examples.en: The child looked a pathetic sight.
examples.zh: 那个孩子看上去很可怜。

words.definition: the quality that a person, situation, film, or play has that makes you feel pity and sadness; smart, feeling, hurt, compassion, sympathy
words.translation: 引起怜悯的因素；悲怅；痛苦；同情；哀婉动人的词句

examples.en: the pathos of the woman trying to keep her lover
examples.zh: 那个女人试图留住爱侣的哀婉之情

words.definition: courtyard, gazebo
words.translation: 天井；露台

words.definition: Patriotism is love for your country and loyalty toward it
words.translation: 爱国主义，民族主义

examples.en: He was a country boy who had joined the army out of a sense of patriotism and adventure.
examples.zh: 他是个乡下小伙子，出于爱国心和冒险精神参了军。

words.definition: to go around the different parts of an area or building at regular times to check that there is no trouble or danger
words.translation: 巡逻，巡查

examples.en: Armed guards patrolled the grounds.
examples.zh: 武装卫兵巡逻场地。

examples.en: an area patrolled by special police units
examples.zh: 由特警部队巡逻的地区

words.definition: someone who supports the activities of an organization, for example by giving money; guardian, backer
words.translation: 赞助人；资助人；老顾客，主顾；保护人；主顾

examples.en: a wealthy patron
examples.zh: 富有的赞助人

words.definition: to cover a path, road, area etc with a hard level surface such as blocks of stone or  concrete; schedule, budget, settle, place in
words.translation: 铺(路等)；铺设；安排；作铺设之用

examples.en: a paved courtyard
examples.zh: 地面铺砌过的院子

words.definition: a hard level surface or path at the side of a road for people to walk on; sidewalk, footpath
words.translation: [英]人行道；人行道

examples.en: A small group of journalists waited on the pavement outside her house.
examples.zh: 有一小群记者守候在她家外面的人行道上。

examples.en: a pavement cafe
examples.zh: 路边咖啡馆

words.definition: money that you are given for doing your job; to give someone money for the job they do; replace, foot, tender; shell out, repay; payment, salary, wage
words.translation: 工资；支付；有利；给予；支付，付；偿还，补偿；[会计]付款；偿还；[劳经]工资，薪水

examples.en: Staff have been working without pay for the last month.
examples.zh: 上个月员工们干活没拿到工资。

examples.en: The tax is deducted from your pay every week.
examples.zh: 这项税收每星期从你薪水中扣。

examples.en: He was suspended on full pay until the hearing.
examples.zh: 聆讯之前他停职留薪。

words.definition: If something is peculiar to a particular thing, person, or situation, it belongs or relates only to that thing, person, or situation; specific, distinct, unique, strange, individual; franchise, special privilege
words.translation: 特殊的；独特的；奇怪的；罕见的；特权；特有财产

examples.en: Punks, soldiers, hippies, and Sumo wrestlers all have distinct hair styles, peculiar to their group.
examples.zh: 朋克摇滚歌手、士兵、嬉皮士和相扑手都留着他们那个群体特有的独特发型。

words.definition: one of the two parts of a bicycle that you push round with your feet to make the bicycle go forward; ride bike; footplate, treadboard; ride
words.translation: 脚噔，踏板；踩踏板；骑车；踏板；脚蹬子；骑（自行车）；踩……的踏板

examples.en: She put her foot down on the accelerator pedal.
examples.zh: 她踩下了油门踏板。

words.definition: someone who is walking, especially along a street or other place used by cars; literal-minded; passerby, walker
words.translation: 行人(的)；徒步的；缺乏想像力的；行人；步行者

examples.en: Ingrid was a walker, even in Los Angeles, where a pedestrian is a rare sight.
examples.zh: 英格丽德是个步行者，即使在行人少见的洛杉矶也是如此。

words.definition: to remove the skin from fruit or vegetables; flake off, shell off; fur, tegument
words.translation: 剥皮；皮；剥，剥落；削；[植]皮

examples.en: Peel and dice the potatoes.
examples.zh: 把马铃薯去皮并切成丁。

words.definition: if you have a picnic, you take food and eat it outdoors, especially in the country; junket
words.translation: 野餐

examples.en: We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们决定在湖边野餐。

examples.en: a picnic table
examples.zh: 野餐桌

examples.en: There is free parking for visitors, as well as a restaurant and picnic area (= a special area with tables where people can have a picnic ) .
examples.zh: 除了餐厅和野餐区，我们还为游客提供免费停车位。

words.definition: a picturesque place is pretty and interesting in an old-fashioned way; unique, distinct, individual, telling, live
words.translation: 似画的，生动的；独特的；生动的；别致的；图画般的

examples.en: a quiet fishing village with a picturesque harbour
examples.zh: 拥有一座美丽港口的宁静渔村

words.definition: gradual, bitty; block, mass, slip; comminute, pulverize
words.translation: 零碎地，零碎的；零碎的；逐渐的；片；块；粉碎

examples.en: If you have tests, perhaps you could adopt more of the other practices in a piecemeal fashion, but why would you want to?
examples.zh: 如果您有了一些测试，您或许能够进一步零零碎碎地采用更多其它的测试，但您为什么要这样做呢？

examples.en: Our current old, piecemeal energy transmission capability is barely up to today’s need let alone tomorrow’s and I see no signs of private capital stepping in to do the job.
examples.zh: 我们目前旧的，零碎的能源传输能力已不能满足今天的需求，也不足以留给明天，我也没看到私有生产者做这个工作的迹象。

words.definition: a structure that is built over and into the water so that boats can stop next to it or people can walk along it; landing, quay
words.translation: 桥墩；码头；码头，直码头；窗间壁

examples.en: a yacht moored at a pier
examples.zh: 停在码头的一艘游艇

examples.en: strolling along Brighton Pier
examples.zh: 在布赖顿码头散步

words.definition: to make a small hole in or through something, using an object with a sharp point; cut through, transpierce; come into, go into, get into, enter into
words.translation: 刺穿，戳人；（喻）寒冷刺骨；感动；刺穿；洞察；响彻；深深地打动；进入；透入

examples.en: Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
examples.zh: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。

examples.en: Rose underwent emergency surgery after a bullet pierced her lung.
examples.zh: 罗丝被子弹射穿肺部，接受了紧急手术。

words.definition: when you behave in a way that shows respect for your religion; godliness, religiosity
words.translation: 虔诚；孝敬；虔诚的行为或语言

examples.en: an act of Christian piety
examples.zh: 表达基督徒虔诚的行为

words.definition: a natural substance that makes skin, hair, plants etc a particular colour; paint, coloring matter; colorize, stain
words.translation: 颜料，色素；[生物][物][生化]色素；[颜料]颜料；给…着色

examples.en: Melanin is the dark brown pigment of the hair, skin and eyes.
examples.zh: 黑色素是头发、皮肤以及眼睛中的深棕色色素。

examples.en: The artist Sandy Lee uses natural pigments in her work.
examples.zh: 画家桑迪·李在她的作品中使用天然颜料。

words.definition: a religious person who travels a long way to a holy place; palmer, rover; range, roam about
words.translation: 香客，朝圣者；朝圣者；漫游者；（美）最初的移民；去朝圣；漫游

examples.en: pilgrims visiting a holy shrine
examples.zh: 祭拜圣庙的朝圣者

words.definition: somebody who is an important and respected member of a group, and is involved in many public activities; column, ridgepole
words.translation: 柱；栋梁；柱子，柱形物；墩

examples.en: Mr Fitzwilliam had been seen as a pillar of the community.
examples.zh: 菲茨威廉先生已被视为社区的骨干。

words.definition: a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put your head on when you are sleeping; weeping willow
words.translation: 枕头

examples.en: I’ll be asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow.
examples.zh: 我头一碰到枕头就会睡着。

words.definition: someone who operates the controls of an aircraft or spacecraft; aviator, amn; to navigate, experiment with
words.translation: 试验；飞行员；[航]飞行员；[水运]领航员；[航]驾驶；[水运]领航；试用

examples.en: an airline pilot
examples.zh: 航空公司飞行员

examples.en: a fighter pilot
examples.zh: 战斗机驾驶员

examples.en: The official report into the accident says that it was caused by pilot error (= a mistake by the pilot ) .
examples.zh: 那宗事故的官方报告称事故是由飞行员失误造成的。

words.definition: a small raised red spot on your skin, especially on your face; papule, knot
words.translation: 丘疹，脓疱；疙瘩；[医]丘疹；面疱

examples.en: Belushi imitates a giant pimple by squeezing his cheeks and spewing chewed food out of his mouth.
examples.zh: 我们在等候某个毕业生领文凭的同时，可以欣赏像《动物屋》这样与学校有关的经典电影的片断：约翰-贝鲁西模仿一个脸上长满丘疹的巨人，双手挤着脸，从嘴里喷出嚼过的东西。

words.definition: a short thin piece of metal with a sharp point at one end, used especially for fastening together pieces of cloth while making clothes; to make someone unable to move by putting a lot of pressure or weight on them; needle, plug; nail up, transfix
words.translation: 大头针；用别针别住；钉住，使不能行动；大头针，针；栓；琐碎物；钉住；压住；将……用针别住

examples.en: ...necklaces, bracelets, and pins.
examples.zh: …项链、手镯和胸针。

words.definition: to press a part of someone’s skin very tightly between your finger and thumb, especially so that it hurts; harry, shear, crop; bit, ounce; save, economize on
words.translation: 捏，拧，掐，夹痛，紧压；压力，重压；捏；勒索；使苦恼；掐掉某物，修剪；匮乏；少量；夹痛；节省

examples.en: We have to stop her pinching her baby brother.
examples.zh: 我们不能让她再掐她小弟弟了。

examples.en: He pinched her cheek.
examples.zh: 他捏了一下她的脸颊。

words.definition: a tall tree with long hard sharp leaves that do not fall off in winter; rare, aspire; ananas; regret, grieve over
words.translation: 消瘦，衰弱；松树；渴望，痛苦；憔悴；[林]松树；凤梨，菠萝；为…悲哀；哀悼

examples.en: an ancient pine forest
examples.zh: 一片古老的松树林

words.definition: a high mountain top; pole, climax
words.translation: 尖塔，尖顶，山峰；(喻)顶峰；高峰；小尖塔；尖峰；极点

examples.en: the pinnacle of academic achievement
examples.zh: 学术成就的顶峰

words.definition: assure oneself, ascertain; accurate, precise, mathematical, strict, rigid; needlepoint, fingerling
words.translation: 精确发现目标；查明；精确地找到；准确描述；精确的；详尽的；针尖；精确位置；极小之物

examples.en: They have to be able to pinpoint people in order to work, but satellite positioning does not work indoors.
examples.zh: 因为这样的技术必须精确人的位置才可以工作，而目前卫星的定位系统还不能运行到室内。

words.definition: plagiarism, cribbing
words.translation: 海上掠夺；侵犯版权；海盗行为；剽窃；著作权侵害；非法翻印

words.definition: a part of an engine consisting of a short solid piece of metal inside a tube, which moves up and down to make the other parts of the engine move; plunger, stop-cock
words.translation: 活塞；[机]活塞

examples.en: Filling the cylinder with steam pushes the piston out.
examples.zh: 填充汽缸的蒸汽将活塞推出。

examples.en: The new series also includes a piston design that makes digressive forces for added pitch and roll control. This helps with performance over rough terrains and on off-road surfaces.
examples.zh: 新系列还包括一个活塞设计，它可降低阻力，增加间距和滚转控制，这有助于军用车辆在崎岖的地形和越野路面的表现。

words.definition: a hole in the floor of a garage that lets you get under a car to repair it; mine, trap; cache; cave, sink marks
words.translation: 坑，凹部；修理部；[矿业]矿井；深坑；陷阱；（物体或人体表面上的）凹陷；（英国剧场的）正厅后排；正厅后排的观众；使竞争；窖藏；使凹下；去…之核；使留疤痕；凹陷；起凹点

examples.en: an inspection pit
examples.zh: 汽车检修坑

words.definition: objects made out of baked clay; ware, earthware
words.translation: 陶器，陶器制造厂；[陶瓷]陶器；陶器厂；陶器制造术

examples.en: Native American pottery
examples.zh: 美洲印第安人的陶器

words.definition: birds such as chickens and ducks that are kept on farms in order to produce eggs and meat; fowl
words.translation: 家禽；家禽肉；[禽]家禽

examples.en: ...a poultry farm.
examples.zh: …一个家禽饲养场。

words.definition: to suddenly move forward and attack someone or something, after waiting to attack them; the act of pouncing; a spring or swoop; sweep down, bound on; talon, unguis
words.translation: 突然袭击；抓住；突袭，猛扑；猛扑，爪

examples.en: The cat was hiding in the bushes, ready to pounce.
examples.zh: 猫躲在灌木丛中，准备扑上去。

words.definition: to make a liquid or other substance flow out of or into a container by holding it at an angle; issue, flux, dumping; shed; flow
words.translation: (液体)倒,注,灌；流入，流出"；倾泻；流出；骤雨；灌，注；倒；倾吐；涌流；斟茶

examples.en: She poured coffee for everyone.
examples.zh: 她为每个人都倒了咖啡。

words.definition: the situation or experience of being poor; difficulty, shortage, hardness, want
words.translation: 贫困，贫穷；贫困；困难；缺少；低劣

examples.en: Millions of elderly people live in poverty .
examples.zh: 数百万老年人生活在贫困之中。

examples.en: We need an effective strategy to fight poverty .
examples.zh: 我们需要制定一个有效的对策来与贫困作斗争。

examples.en: continued efforts to alleviate poverty and raise living standards
examples.zh: 缓解贫困和提高生活水平的不懈努力

words.definition: a practicable way of doing something is possible in a particular situation; feasible, usable
words.translation: 可实行的；能用的，可行的；可用的；行得通的

examples.en: The only practicable course of action is to sell the company.
examples.zh: 唯一可行的做法是把公司卖掉。

examples.en: It is their duty to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the equipment is safe.
examples.zh: 在力所能及的情况下确保设备安全是他们的职责。

words.definition: relating to real situations and events rather than ideas, emotions etc; actual, effective, real, pragmatic, positive
words.translation: 实行的；注重实际的，实用的；实际的；实用性的

examples.en: Candidates should have training and practical experience in basic electronics.
examples.zh: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

examples.en: the practical problems of old age
examples.zh: 老年的实际问题

examples.en: They provide financial and practical help for disabled students.
examples.zh: 他们为残障学生提供经济上的援助以及实际的帮助。

words.definition: almost; almost, nearly, actually, really, most
words.translation: 实践地；几乎；实际地；事实上

examples.en: I’ve read practically all of his books.
examples.zh: 我差不多读过他所有的书。

examples.en: She sees him practically every day.
examples.zh: 她几乎天天见到他。

examples.en: It’s practically impossible to predict what will happen.
examples.zh: 将会发生什么，几乎不能预料。

words.definition: someone who regularly does a particular activity
words.translation: 实践者，从事者；(医生或律师等)开业者

examples.en: one of golf’s most experienced practitioners
examples.zh: 最有经验的高尔夫球员之一

words.definition: dealing with problems in a sensible practical way instead of strictly following a set of ideas; practical, actual, effective, real, positive
words.translation: 重实效的，实际的；实际的；实用主义的；国事的

examples.en: Williams took a more pragmatic approach to management problems.
examples.zh: 威廉斯在管理问题上采用的是一种更务实的做法。

words.definition: to talk about a religious subject in a public place, especially in a church during a service; drum in; boost, sermonize; homily
words.translation: 传教；讲道；劝诫；鼓吹；说教；传道；反复灌输；宣扬

examples.en: He traveled the southern states, preaching the gospel .
examples.zh: 他游历南方各州宣讲福音。

words.definition: a precarious situation or state is one which may very easily or quickly become worse; dangerous, critical, risky, threatening
words.translation: 不稳定的，不安全的；危险的；不确定的

examples.en: Her health remained precarious, despite the treatment.
examples.zh: 她尽管接受了治疗，但健康状况还是不稳定。

examples.en: the company’s precarious financial position
examples.zh: 公司岌岌可危的财务状况

words.definition: something you do in order to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening; prevention, prophylaxis; keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled
words.translation: 预防；预防，警惕；预防措施；警惕；预先警告

examples.en: Fire precautions were neglected.
examples.zh: 防火措施被忽视了。

examples.en: Vets took precautions to prevent the spread of the disease.
examples.zh: 兽医们为防止疾病蔓延采取了预防措施。

words.definition: when someone or something is considered to be more impor-tant than someone or something else, and therefore comes first or must be dealt with first; priority, preference to sth
words.translation: 在前，优先；[计]优先；居先

examples.en: Guests were seated in order of precedence .
examples.zh: 宾客们按席次就座。

examples.en: Safety must be given precedence .
examples.zh: 安全必须放在第一位。

words.definition: an action or official decision that can be used to give support to later actions or decisions; prior, prius
words.translation: 先例，前例；在前的；在先的

examples.en: a legal precedent
examples.zh: 判例

words.definition: happening or coming before the time, place, or part mentioned; prior, prius
words.translation: 在前的，在先的；在前的；前述的

examples.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
examples.zh: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

words.definition: something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care; golden, valued
words.translation: 宝贵的，珍贵的；宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的

examples.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
examples.zh: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

examples.en: our planet’s precious resources
examples.zh: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

words.definition: a very steep side of a high rock, mountain, or cliff; escarpment, krantz
words.translation: 悬崖，峭壁；悬崖；绝壁；险境

examples.en: A loose rock tumbled over the precipice.
examples.zh: 一块松动的岩石从悬崖上滚落下来。

words.definition: to make something serious happen suddenly or more quickly than was expected; a solid substance that has been chemically separated from a liquid; deposit, sediment, sludge; immerse, catalyse; deposit, settle; rapid
words.translation: 猛然抛下；突然发生；加速；沉淀物；[化学]沉淀物；[化学]使沉淀；促成；猛抛；使陷入；[化学]沉淀；猛地落下；冷凝成为雨或雪等；突如其来的；猛地落下的；急促的

examples.en: The riot was precipitated when four black men were arrested.
examples.zh: 这场骚乱是因为四名黑人男子的被捕而突然引发的。

words.definition: precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct; accurate, strict, mathematical, rigid, decided
words.translation: 精确的；明确的；严格的

examples.en: precise sales figures
examples.zh: 准确的销售数据

examples.en: It was difficult to get precise information.
examples.zh: 很难得到确切的消息。

examples.en: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
examples.zh: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

words.definition: someone who had your job before you started doing it; father, grand old man
words.translation: 前任；前任，前辈

examples.en: Kennedy’s predecessor as President was the war hero Dwight Eisenhower.
examples.zh: 肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

words.definition: if something or someone is predictable, you know what will happen or what they will do – sometimes used to show disapproval; divinable
words.translation: 可预言的

examples.en: The snow had a predictable effect on traffic.
examples.zh: 这场雪对交通造成的影响可以预见。

examples.en: an entertaining but predictable film
examples.zh: 一部有趣但老套的电影

examples.en: Logan’s reaction was predictable.
examples.zh: 洛根的反应可想而知。

words.definition: a tendency to behave in a particular way or suffer from a particular illness; tendency, liability, trend, preference, disposition
words.translation: 倾向，趋势，偏好；倾向；素质；易染病体质

examples.en: There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
examples.zh: 教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

words.translation: 推进，推进力

examples.en: But magnetic propulsion has some drawbacks.
examples.zh: 但是磁力推进有一些缺陷。

words.definition: to charge someone with a crime and try to show that they are guilty of it in a court of law; carry out, undertake, pursue, address, have; law, take legal action
words.translation: 告发，起诉；检举；贯彻；从事；依法进行；起诉；告发；作检察官

examples.en: Shoplifters will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 在商店行窃者将被起诉。

words.definition: a particular event which will probably or definitely happen in the future – used especially when you want to talk about how you feel about it; scenery, future, picture, expectation, landscape; reconnoitre; make a survey
words.translation: 景色；前景；前途；预期；勘探，找矿；勘探，勘察

examples.en: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，几乎没有可能看到这些重大问题得到解答。

words.definition: You use prospective to describe someone who wants to be the thing mentioned or who is likely to be the thing mentioned; expected, due, future; outlook, expectation
words.translation: 预期的; 未来的；未来的；预期的；预期；展望

examples.en: The story should act as a warning to other prospective buyers.
examples.zh: 这篇报道应该可以对其他可能的购买者起到警告作用。

words.definition: a small book that advertises a school, college, new business etc; specimen page, specimen sheet
words.translation: 说明书，简介；内容说明书；样张；创办计划书

examples.en: ...a prospectus for a new issue of stock.
examples.zh: …新发行股票的招股说明书。

words.definition: one of several natural substances that exist in food such as meat, eggs, and beans, and which your body needs in order to grow and remain strong and healthy; albumose; glaireous
words.translation: 蛋白质；[生化]蛋白质；朊；[生化]蛋白质的

examples.en: Where do you get your protein?
examples.zh: 你从哪里获得蛋白质？

examples.en: I know that I get around 90g of protein from that.
examples.zh: 我知道我会从中得到90克左右的蛋白质。

words.definition: to come together to publicly express disapproval or opposition to something; something that you do to show publicly that you think that something is wrong and unfair, for example taking part in big public meetings, refusing to work, or refusing to buy a company’s products; exclaim at, take exception to; declare, aver; obtestation, remonstrance
words.translation: 抗议；申明；反对；断言

examples.en: ‘I don’t see why I should take the blame for this!’ she protested.
examples.zh: “我不明白为什么我要对此承担责任！”她抗议道。

words.definition: a system of rules about the correct way to behave on an official occasion; agreement, ceremony, understanding, treaty, accord; study out
words.translation: 礼仪，礼节；外交礼节；协议；草案；礼仪；拟定

examples.en: a breach of diplomatic protocol
examples.zh: 违反外交礼节

words.definition: the first form that a new design of a car, machine etc has, or a model of it used to test the design before it is produced; criterion, standard, level, norms, type
words.translation: 原型；[生物]原型；标准，模范

examples.en: But how do you come up with the architecture for this evolutionary prototype?
examples.zh: 但是你将如何为这个进化的原型提出系统的架构呢？

examples.en: But it may be an alternative when you have to finish a prototype in limited time.
examples.zh: 但是，当您需要在有限的时间内完成一个原型时，这也许是一种选择。

words.definition: to lengthen or extend (a speech, etc); prolong in time; string, spread, prolong
words.translation: 延长，拖延；绘制；延长；伸展

examples.en: Delay always breeds danger; and to protract a great design is often to ruin it.
examples.zh: 推迟经常孕育危险；拖延一个伟大的工程常常意味着毁灭它。

examples.en: To protract the suspense, he paused for a considerable period of time before telling us the result of the experiment.
examples.zh: 为了延长悬念，他在告诉我们实验结果之前停顿了相当一段时间。

words.definition: to stick out from somewhere; exsert, advertise; stand out, excel at
words.translation: 突出；伸出；使突出，使伸出；突出，伸出

examples.en: ...a huge round mass of smooth rock protruding from the water.
examples.zh: …从水中突出来的一块光滑的圆形巨石。

words.definition: used to say that something will only be possible if something else happens or is done; if, supposing; gave, supplied
words.translation: 假如，如果；假如；倘若；提供；给予（provide的过去式）

examples.en: He can come with us, provided he pays for his own meals.
examples.zh: 只要他付自己的饭钱，就可以跟我们一起来。

words.definition: a condition in an agreement or law; item, preparation, arrangement, preliminary, do
words.translation: 准备；供应；条款；规定；[经]供应品

examples.en: The agreement includes a provision for each side to check the other side’s weapons.
examples.zh: 协议有项规定，允许双方互查武器。

words.definition: likely or able to be changed in the future; temporary, extraordinary, interim, odd, occasional
words.translation: 临时的，暂时性的；临时的，暂时的；暂定的

examples.en: a provisional government
examples.zh: 临时政府

examples.en: We accept provisional bookings by phone.
examples.zh: 我们接受电话临时预约。

words.definition: to cause a reaction or feeling, especially a sudden one; fan, egg, anger
words.translation: 激怒；引起；驱使；煽动；惹起

examples.en: The novel has provoked fierce debate in the US.
examples.zh: 那部小说在美国引发了激烈的争论。

words.definition: nearness in distance or time; approach, neighborhood
words.translation: 最近，接近；亲近，接近；[数]邻近

examples.en: Here the rich and the poor live in close proximity (= very near to each other ) .
examples.zh: 在这里，富人和穷人比邻而居。

words.definition: if you do something by proxy, you arrange for someone else to do it for you; deputy, agent, factor, secondary, substitute
words.translation: 代理权，代表权；代理人；[法][贸易]代理人；[经]委托书；代用品

examples.en: You can vote by proxy.
examples.zh: 你可以请人代你投票。

words.definition: to try to find out details about someone else’s private life in an impolite way; prize up, jimmy; burrow into; lever, heaver
words.translation: 细查；探问；撬动，撬开；刺探，探查；窥探；[机]杠杆

examples.en: I don’t want to pry , but I need to ask you one or two questions.
examples.zh: 我不想唐突，不过我需要问你一两个问题。

words.definition: an invented name that a writer, artist etc uses instead of their real name; assumed name, nom de plume
words.translation: 假名；笔名；[法]假名

examples.en: Both plays were published under the pseudonym of Philip Dayre.
examples.zh: 两个剧本都是以菲利普·戴尔的笔名发表的。

words.definition: the study and treatment of mental illnesses
words.translation: 精神病学

examples.en: In it, he argued that psychiatry was a branch of medical science and should be investigated by observation and experimentation like the other natural sciences.
examples.zh: 在书中，他主张精神病学是医学的一个分支，应当像其他自然科学一样以观察和实验为研究手段。

words.definition: mentation, psychological science
words.translation: 心理学；[心理]心理学；心理状态

examples.en: I understood the psychology of this, but it still hurt.
examples.zh: 我理解这种心理，但这仍然让我感到伤心。

examples.en: It was not until the mid-twentieth century that psychology really came into its own.
examples.zh: 直到20世纪中叶心理学才得到应有的重视。

examples.en: His speciality was psychology -- one important branch on the great tree of knowledge.
examples.zh: 他的专业是心理学，这是知识之树上的一个重要分枝。

words.definition: Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something; advertisement, propaganda, bill, regard, dissemination
words.translation: 公开，宣传；宣传，宣扬；公开；广告；注意

examples.en: Much advance publicity was given to the talks.
examples.zh: 会谈之前做了大量的宣传。

examples.en: ...government publicity campaigns.
examples.zh: …政府的宣传活动。

words.definition: to damage something very badly; destroy, harry, do for; destruction, breaking, blasting; do for, play havoc with
words.translation: 毁坏，蹂躏；抢劫，掠夺；毁坏；破坏；掠夺；蹂躏，破坏

examples.en: a country ravaged by civil war
examples.zh: 遭受内战重创的国家

examples.en: His health was gradually ravaged by drink and drugs.
examples.zh: 酗酒和吸毒渐渐毁了他的健康。

words.definition: to talk in an angry, uncontrolled, or crazy way; enthusiastic or extravagant praise; roar, riddlemeree; gnar, full of bull; huff and puff, bark
words.translation: 胡言乱语；热衷谈论；热情赞扬；咆哮；热烈赞美；狂骂；语无伦次地说

examples.en: He was still ranting and raving the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天上午他仍在大叫大嚷。

words.definition: not cooked; crude, fresh, unripe; brush burn, abrase
words.translation: 生的；未加工的；[食品]生的；阴冷的；刺痛的；擦掉皮的；无经验的；（在艺术等方面）不成熟的；擦伤

examples.en: raw meat
examples.zh: 生肉

examples.en: grated raw carrots
examples.zh: 磨碎的生胡萝卜

examples.en: Cabbage can be eaten raw.
examples.zh: 洋白菜可以生吃。

words.definition: quickly and easily; easily, lightly
words.translation: 迅速地；容易地；乐意地；无困难地

examples.en: Boats are readily available to visitors.
examples.zh: 游客可以很方便地租到船只。

examples.en: The information is readily accessible on the Internet.
examples.zh: 这些信息在因特网上一查就能找到。

words.definition: a country ruled by a king or queen; domain, territory, kingdom, province, world, universe, extent
words.translation: 世界；王国；领域，范围

examples.en: Defence of the realm is crucial.
examples.zh: 王国的防御是至关重要的。

words.definition: to cut and collect a crop of grain; acquire, earn, buy, find, make; crop, to harvest
words.translation: 收割，收获；收获，获得；收割

examples.en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
examples.zh: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

words.definition: the back part of an object, vehicle, or building, or a position at the back of an object or area; to look after a person or animal until they are fully grown; cultivate, foster, plant, set, bed; rise, tower; fro, aback; latter, back; back, behind, ass
words.translation: 后部，后面；培植，饲养；培养；树立；栽种；暴跳；高耸；向后；在后面；[军]后方的；后面的；背面的；后面；屁股；后方部队

examples.en: He settled back in the rear of the taxi.
examples.zh: 他在出租车后座，往后靠着坐好了。

words.definition: fair and sensible; rational, logical, possible, just, legitimate
words.translation: 明智的；合理的；公平的；合理的，公道的；通情达理的

examples.en: a reasonable request
examples.zh: 合情合理的要求

examples.en: Be reasonable — you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
examples.zh: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

examples.en: I thought it was a perfectly reasonable (= completely reasonable ) question.
examples.zh: 我认为这个问题问得很有道理。

words.definition: to make someone feel calmer and less worried or frightened about a problem or situation
words.translation: 使放心，使消除疑虑

examples.en: Teachers reassured anxious parents.
examples.zh: 老师们安慰焦急的父母。

words.definition: to remember a particular fact, event, or situation from the past; think of, come back; memory, recollection
words.translation: 召回；回忆；回想起，记起；取消；撤消

examples.en: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
examples.zh: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

examples.en: As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
examples.zh: 我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

words.definition: lower, rein back; replace, return, restore, give again
words.translation: 后退；向后倾斜；减弱；归还

words.definition: a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something; income, proceeds, earning; receive from, to hand
words.translation: 收到；收据；收入

examples.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
examples.zh: 保留收据以备退货之需。

examples.en: Can you give me a receipt?
examples.zh: 你能给我一个收条吗？

words.definition: a large formal party to celebrate an event or to welcome someone; reaction, response, behavior
words.translation: 接待处；招待会；接收；接待；感受；反应

examples.en: It’s an ideal location for a wedding reception .
examples.zh: 这里是举办喜宴的理想地点。

examples.en: The occasion was marked by a civic reception .
examples.zh: 市里举行招待会庆祝这个特别的时刻。

words.definition: depression, downturn, decline, cavity
words.translation: 后退；撤回；(工商业)衷退，价格暴跌；衰退；不景气；凹处

examples.en: the economic recession of the early 1980s
examples.zh: 20世纪80年代初的经济衰退

words.definition: a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food; secret, tips
words.translation: 食谱，烹饪法；食谱；[临床]处方；秘诀

examples.en: a recipe book
examples.zh: 一本烹饪书

words.definition: someone who receives something; container, vessel, receiver, pocket, bin; acceptant, susceptive
words.translation: 接受者；[包装]容器，[通信]接受者；容纳者；容易接受的，感受性强的

examples.en: ...the largest recipient of U.S. foreign aid.
examples.zh: …最大的美国对外援助接受方。

words.definition: a reciprocal arrangement or relationship is one in which two people or groups do or give the same things to each other; mutual, au pair
words.translation: 相互的；互惠的；[贸易]互惠的；[数]倒数的，彼此相反的

examples.en: He spoke of the necessity for a reciprocal relationship that would be useful for all sides.
examples.zh: 他谈及需要建立对各方都有益的互惠关系。

examples.en: Such treaties provide reciprocal rights and obligations.
examples.zh: 此类协议规定了相互之间的权利与义务。

words.definition: oral reading, repetition
words.translation: 详述；演奏会；独奏会；朗诵，吟诵；背诵；独唱会

words.definition: to say a poem, piece of literature etc that you have learned, for people to listen to; repeat, specify, relate; say over, learn sth by memory
words.translation: 背诵，列举；背诵；叙述；列举

examples.en: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
examples.zh: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

words.definition: not caring or worrying about the possible bad or dangerous results of your actions; indiscretionary, temerarious
words.translation: 鲁莽的；鲁莽的，不顾后果的；粗心大意的

examples.en: He was accused of causing death by reckless driving .
examples.zh: 他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。

examples.en: a reckless disregard for safety
examples.zh: 不顾安全的鲁莽行为

examples.en: He ran into the burning house with reckless abandon (= without caring about the danger ) .
examples.zh: 他不顾危险冲入着火的房子里。

words.definition: to guess a number or amount, without calculating it exactly; expect, feel, find, cast, make; estimate, believe, imagine, cast
words.translation: 计算；测算，估计；认为；估计；猜想，料想

examples.en: The expression ‘full moon’ means the fourteenth day of the moon reckoned from its first appearance.
examples.zh: 所谓“满月”是指从新月初现算起的第14天。

words.definition: to feel angry or upset about a situation or about something that someone has done, especially because you think that it is not fair; hate, be down on
words.translation: 怨恨；愤恨；厌恶

examples.en: Paul resented the fact that Carol didn’t trust him.
examples.zh: 保罗非常气愤，因为卡萝尔不信任他。

words.definition: to arrange for a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc to be kept for you to use at a particular time in the future; store, repertory; stay at, save from; book for, make reservation
words.translation: 保存；预定；[贸易][金融]储备，储存；自然保护区；[军][林]预备队；储备金；[贸易][金融]储备；保留；预约；预订

examples.en: Do you have to reserve tickets in advance?
examples.zh: 你必须预先订票吗？

words.definition: a lake, especially an artificial one, where water is stored before it is supplied to people’s houses; artificial lake
words.translation: 水库；蓄水池；[水利]水库

examples.en: All these earthquakes happened when the water level in Zipingpu reservoir was low.
examples.zh: 所有这些地震都发生在紫坪铺水库水位很低的时候。

words.definition: a house, especially a large or official one; home, accommodation
words.translation: 居住；住处；住宅；住宅，住处

examples.en: the ambassador’s official residence
examples.zh: 大使官邸

words.definition: to officially announce that you have decided to leave your job or an organization; yield, desert, refer, quit; step down, quit
words.translation: 放弃；辞去；辞职；委托；使听从

examples.en: A hospital administrator has resigned over claims he lied to get the job.
examples.zh: 一位医院主管因为有人声称他的职位是骗来的而辞职了。

words.definition: when someone calmly accepts a situation that cannot be changed, even though it is bad; compliance, demission
words.translation: 辞职书；放弃；听从，顺从；辞职；顺从

examples.en: She gave a sigh of resignation.
examples.zh: 她无奈地叹了一口气。

words.definition: the ability of a substance such as rubber to return to its original shape after it has been pressed or bent; elasticity, elastic force
words.translation: 回弹，弹性；恢复力；[力]弹力；顺应力

examples.en: And I think what we're seeing in the economy now is the inherent resilience of the American economy and the American people.
examples.zh: 而且我认为，我认为，在经济方面，我们现在看到的是美国经济和美国人民一直以来所固有的弹性。

words.definition: a formal decision or statement agreed on by a group of people, especially after a vote; settlement, decision, determination, push, backbone
words.translation: 坚决，坚定；决定，决议；决心，解决；[物][电子][光]分辨率；决议；解决；决心

examples.en: a resolution calling for a ban on dumping nuclear waste
examples.zh: 要求禁止倾倒核废物的决议

examples.en: They have failed to comply with the resolution.
examples.zh: 他们没有遵守决议。

words.definition: to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty; solve, condition, conclude; settle, work out, figure out; determinateness
words.translation: 解决；决定；溶解；使…分解；决心要做…；决心；分解；坚决；决定要做的事

examples.en: Barnet was desperate for money to resolve his financial problems.
examples.zh: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

words.definition: resonant materials increase any sound produced inside them; rotund, syntonous
words.translation: 反响的；共鸣的；洪亮的，共振的；[语]共鸣的

examples.en: the violin’s smooth, resonant tone
examples.zh: 小提琴圆润悠扬的音色

words.definition: when you must use or depend on something because nothing better is available; instrument, shift, road, tool, implement; appeal, ask for help
words.translation: 求助；凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地；求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法

examples.en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
examples.zh: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

words.definition: something such as useful land, or minerals such as oil or coal, that exists in a country and can be used to increase its wealth; financial ability
words.translation: 资源；机智；[计][环境]资源，财力；办法；智谋

examples.en: Canada’s vast mineral resources
examples.zh: 加拿大丰富的矿产资源

examples.en: a country rich in natural resources
examples.zh: 自然资源丰富的国家

words.definition: the process of breathing; breath, wind
words.translation: 呼吸作用；一次呼吸；植物光合作用；[生理]呼吸

examples.en: His respiration grew fainter throughout the day.
examples.zh: 一天当中，他的呼吸越来越微弱。

words.definition: If someone or something is responsive, they react quickly and favourably; answering
words.translation: 易于做出迅速反应的；响应的；应答的；回答的

examples.en: With an election coming soon, your representative should be very responsive to your request.
examples.zh: 大选在即，你们的代表应该对你们的要求作出迅速积极的反应。

words.definition: unwilling to keep still or stay where you are, especially because you are nervous or bored; storm-tossed, twitchy
words.translation: 焦躁不安的；不安宁的；得不到满足的

examples.en: After a few weeks in Marseille, I grew restless and decided to move on.
examples.zh: 在马赛住了几星期后，我开始待不住了，决定换个地方。

words.definition: to make something return to its former state or condition; replace, return, repair; recover from, unsave
words.translation: 恢复；归还；修复；还原

examples.en: She was hoping that the Mediterranean climate would restore her to full health.
examples.zh: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

examples.en: The National Guard was called in to restore order (= make people stop fighting and breaking the law ) when riots broke out.
examples.zh: 暴乱爆发后，国民警卫队被调来恢复秩序。

examples.en: initiatives to restore peace in the Middle East
examples.zh: 恢复中东和平的倡议

words.definition: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength; possess, regulate, contain, manage, bottle
words.translation: 限制，约束；抑制，控制；约束；制止

examples.en: Wally gripped my arm, partly to restrain me and partly to reassure me.
examples.zh: 沃利抓住了我的胳膊，部分是想制止我，部分是想安慰我。

words.definition: to start doing something again after stopping or being interrupted; bio, abstract, brief, summary, record; recover, start over
words.translation: 重新开始；继续；重新占用；[管理]履历；个人简历；摘要；重新获得

examples.en: She hopes to resume work after the baby is born.
examples.zh: 她想生完孩子后继续工作。

examples.en: The rebels have resumed hostilities against government troops.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子继续与政府军发生冲突。

words.definition: the sale of goods in shops to customers, for their own use and not for selling to anyone else; sell-through, resale
words.translation: 零售，零卖；零售

examples.en: a retail price of £8.99
examples.zh: 8.99英镑的零售价

examples.en: The retail value would be around $500.
examples.zh: 零售价在500美元左右。

examples.en: Retail sales fell by 1.3% in January.
examples.zh: 1月份零售额下降了1.3%。

words.definition: to keep something or continue to have something; keep up, to keep
words.translation: 保持，保有；聘请(律师)；保持；雇；记住

examples.en: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
examples.zh: 你有权保留这些物品。

examples.en: The state wants to retain control of food imports.
examples.zh: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

words.definition: unwilling to talk about what you feel or what you know; silent, cautious, mum
words.translation: 沉默寡言的；言不如意的；沉默的；有保留的；谨慎的

examples.en: She is so reticent about her achievements.
examples.zh: 她对于自己的成就如此缄默。

words.definition: to express an idea, feeling, thought etc using words; let, point out, suppose; make a gesture, to express
words.translation: 说；讲；说明；例如；声称；假设；指明；表示；念；假定；背诵

examples.en: ‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
examples.zh: “我太累了。”她说。

examples.en: ‘Don’t cry,’ he said softly.
examples.zh: “别哭了。”他柔声说道。

examples.en: Don’t believe anything he says.
examples.zh: 他说什么都不要相信。

words.definition: the size or level of something, or the amount that something is happening; dimensions, ratio, graduation, calibration; chip, shell, climb; sound, gauge
words.translation: 鳞；尺度；等级；比例规模；天平；规模；[测][数]比例；[动]鳞；[仪]刻度；数值范围；衡量；攀登；剥落；[环境]生水垢；测量；刮鳞；依比例决定

examples.en: A structural survey revealed the full scale of the damage.
examples.zh: 结构检验揭示了实际受损程度。

examples.en: I was shocked by the sheer scale (= very big scale ) of the destruction.
examples.zh: 破坏程度之大让我大为震惊。

examples.en: Large firms benefit from economies of scale (= ways of saving money because they are big ) .
examples.zh: 大公司从规模经济中得益。

words.definition: a small, very sharp knife that is used by doctors in operations; dissecting knife
words.translation: 解剖刀，(外科用)小刀；[医]解剖刀；外科手术刀

examples.en: I pointed with my scalpel to the chest cavity, where nothing but a black lump of coal squatted in the lipstick-red center.
examples.zh: 我用解剖刀指着她的胸腔，那里只有一团黑乎乎的煤块，伏在唇膏般红色的胸腔中部。

words.definition: to examine an area carefully but quickly, often because you are looking for a particular person or thing; glance through, look through; survey, scrutiny
words.translation: 细看；浏览；扫描；详细调查；标出格律；审视

examples.en: He scanned the horizon, but there was no sign of the ship.
examples.zh: 他朝地平线处仔细眺望，但是找不到那艘船的踪影。

examples.en: She scanned his face, looking for signs of what he was thinking.
examples.zh: 她端详着他的脸，想知道他在想些什么。

examples.en: Video cameras scanned the car park.
examples.zh: 摄像机监视着停车场。

words.definition: Scandal is talk about the shocking and immoral aspects of someone's behaviour or something that has happened; tale, personalities
words.translation: 冒犯或引起反感的行动；流言，诽谤；丑闻；流言蜚语；诽谤；公愤

examples.en: He loved gossip and scandal.
examples.zh: 他喜欢闲话和流言蜚语。

words.definition: not enough; insufficient, short, deficient, lacking, scarce; block, shorten
words.translation: 不足的，不够多的，缺乏的；不足的；缺乏的；勉强够的；减少；节省；限制

examples.en: The story has received scant attention in the press.
examples.zh: 这件事没在报界引起多少注意。

examples.en: They produce goods with scant regard for quality.
examples.zh: 他们的产品不够重视质量。

words.definition: someone who is blamed for something bad that happens, even if it is not their fault; goat, stand-in
words.translation: 替罪羊；替罪羊，替人顶罪者；替身

examples.en: I don't think I deserve to be made the scapegoat for a couple of bad results.
examples.zh: 我认为我不该为出现的一些不良后果充当替罪羊。

words.definition: a permanent mark that is left on your skin after you have had a cut or wound; knife, injure; cure, heal up; wound, trauma
words.translation: 伤疤，伤痕，(喻)内心创伤；伤害；给留下伤痕；结疤；痊愈；创伤；伤痕

examples.en: He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
examples.zh: 他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。

examples.en: a deep cut that could leave a permanent scar
examples.zh: 可能会留下永久性疤痕的一道很深的伤口

words.definition: almost not or almost none at all; ill, barely
words.translation: 仅仅，几乎不；几乎不，简直不；简直没有

examples.en: The city had scarcely changed in 20 years.

examples.zh: 这套公寓实在太小，不过暂时还能凑合。

examples.en: a Vietnam veteran
examples.zh: 越战老兵

words.definition: a refusal to give official permission for something, or the right to refuse to give such permission; if someone in authority vetoes something, they refuse to allow it to happen, especially something that other people or organizations have agreed; neto; bar, inhibit; rule against, vote down
words.translation: 否决，否决权，禁止；否决，禁止；否决权；否决；禁止

examples.en: The Senate had a sufficient majority to override the presidential veto (= not accept his refusal ).
examples.zh: 参议院有足够的多数票可以推翻总统的否决。

words.definition: to make someone feel annoyed or worried; trouble, irk; trouble, worry, bother about
words.translation: 使烦恼，使苦恼；使烦恼；使困惑；使恼怒；烦恼

examples.en: It vexed me to think of others gossiping behind my back.
examples.zh: 想到别人在我背后说闲话让我很恼火。

words.definition: by way of, THRU through
words.translation: 径，由；取道，通过；经由

words.definition: able to continue to live or to develop into a living thing; feasible, working
words.translation: 能活的，能生存的；可行的；能养活的；能生育的

examples.en: viable seeds
examples.zh: 可存活的种子

words.definition: if something vibrates, or if you vibrate it, it shakes quickly and continuously with very small movements; swing, hesitate; oscillate
words.translation: 摆动；振动；颤动；摇摆；踌躇；使振动；使颤动

examples.en: The floor was vibrating to the beat of the music.
examples.zh: 地板随着音乐的节奏在颤动。

examples.en: As air passes over our vocal cords, it makes them vibrate.
examples.zh: 气流通过我们的声带，使之产生振动。

words.definition: criminal activities that involve sex or drugs; defect, deficiency, fault, disadvantage, abuse; in place of, in stead of; vise; deputy, auxiliary
words.translation: 罪恶；不道德行为；恶习；缺点；[机]老虎钳；卖淫；代替；钳住；副的；代替的

examples.en: the fight against vice on the streets
examples.zh: 打击街头犯罪

examples.en: The police have smashed a vice ring (= a group of criminals involved in vice ) in Chicago.
examples.zh: 警方捣毁了芝加哥的一个犯罪团伙。

words.definition: in the area around a particular place
words.translation: 邻近，附近

examples.en: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
examples.zh: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

examples.en: There used to be a mill in the vicinity.
examples.zh: 附近曾有一座磨坊。

words.definition: very unkind in a way that is intended to hurt someone’s feelings or make their character seem bad; severe, fallen, malicious, poisonous
words.translation: 邪恶的，堕落的；恶意的；恶毒的；堕落的；有错误的；品性不端的；剧烈的

examples.en: Sarah can be quite vicious at times.
examples.zh: 萨拉有时相当狠毒。

examples.en: a vicious personal attack on the Duchess
examples.zh: 对公爵夫人恶毒的人身攻击

examples.en: She was shocked by the vicious tone in his voice.
examples.zh: 她对他恶毒的语气感到震惊。

words.definition: giving careful attention to what is happening, so that you will notice any danger or illegal activity; alert, watchful
words.translation: 警戒的；警惕的；警醒的；注意的
