examples.en: Please remain vigilant at all times and report anything suspicious.
examples.zh: 请时刻保持警惕，有可疑情况随时报告。

words.definition: using a lot of energy and strength or determination; male, live, energetic, mighty
words.translation: 强有力的，精力充沛的；有力的；精力充沛的

examples.en: Your dog needs at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise every day.
examples.zh: 你的狗每天需要进行至少20分钟的剧烈运动。

examples.en: Environmentalists have begun a vigorous campaign to oppose nuclear dumping in the area.
examples.zh: 环保人士已经发动了一场积极的运动，反对在该地区倾倒核废物。

examples.en: a vigorous debate
examples.zh: 一场激烈的辩论

words.definition: to prove that someone or something is right or true; assert, safekeep
words.translation: 为辩白；证明正确；维护；证明…无辜；证明…正确

examples.en: The decision to advertise has been vindicated by the fact that sales have grown.
examples.zh: 销售增长的事实证明做广告宣传的决定是正确的。

words.definition: to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc; let, act against
words.translation: 违犯，侵犯；违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎

examples.en: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
examples.zh: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

examples.en: regimes that violate human rights
examples.zh: 侵犯人权的政权

words.definition: involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc; fierce, hard
words.translation: 猛烈的，凶暴的；由暴力引起的；强烈的；暴力的；猛烈的

examples.en: the increase in violent crime
examples.zh: 暴力犯罪的增多

examples.en: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
examples.zh: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

examples.en: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
examples.zh: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

words.definition: almost; actually, really, almost, nearly, most
words.translation: 实际上，事实上；事实上，几乎；实质上

examples.en: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
examples.zh: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

examples.en: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
examples.zh: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

words.definition: If something is wreathed in smoke or mist, it is surrounded by it; invest, case, roof, house, sheet; coil
words.translation: 覆盖，包围；用花环装饰；将…做成花环；包围；覆盖；缭绕；成圈状；扭曲；环绕盘旋

examples.en: The ship was wreathed in smoke.
examples.zh: 那艘船笼罩在浓烟中。

examples.en: Fog wreathes the temples.
examples.zh: 云雾缭绕着寺院。

words.definition: a ship that has sunk; destruction, breaking, blasting, remain, disruption; destroy, undermine, founder
words.translation: 破坏，船舶失事；失事船只；破坏；[水运]失事；残骸；失去健康的人；[水运]使失事；拆毁

examples.en: He was still alive when they pulled him from the wreck.
examples.zh: 他们把他从失事的车辆中拖出来时，他还活着。

words.definition: to twist and pull something roughly from the place where it is being held; violence, smart, strain, hurt; harry, worry, trouble, tear; rick
words.translation: 猛扭，猛拉；扳手，[机]扳钳；扭伤；痛苦；歪曲；猛扭；曲解；折磨；猛绞

examples.en: I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
examples.zh: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

examples.en: The door had been wrenched open.
examples.zh: 门被猛地拉开了。

words.definition: to fight someone by holding them and pulling or pushing them; war, conflict, battle, fight; fight, struggle (with); breast, muscle
words.translation: 摔跤，角斗；斗争，努力；摔跤；搏斗；斗争；斟酌；与摔跤；与…搏斗；使劲搬动

examples.en: Police officers wrestled him to the ground .
examples.zh: 警察把他扑倒在地。

words.definition: someone who is wretched is very unhappy or ill, and you feel sorry for them; poor, mean, base, dirty
words.translation: 不幸的，可怜的；令人难受的；可怜的；卑鄙的；令人苦恼或难受的

examples.en: the poor, wretched girl
examples.zh: 极其不幸的可怜姑娘

words.definition: wrinkles are lines on your face and skin that you get when you are old; rugosity, plication; crease; frounce
words.translation: 皱纹；起皱；使起皱纹

examples.en: Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
examples.zh: 她的脸上布满皱纹。

words.definition: detailed, subtle; labored
words.translation: 锤炼的；锻造的；加工的；精细的；工作（work的过去分词）

words.definition: a large boat with a sail, used for pleasure or sport, especially one that has a place where you can sleep; speed boat, mosquito craft
words.translation: 小帆船，快艇；帆船；游艇，[船]快艇；轻舟

words.definition: a unit for measuring length, equal to three feet or 0.91 metres; courtyard, garth
words.translation: 院，场地；码；院子；[计量]码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；[建]庭院；帆桁

examples.en: a hundred yards away
examples.zh: 100码外

examples.en: an area of 9,000 square yards
examples.zh: 面积为9,000平方码的一片区域

words.definition: thick thread made of cotton or wool, which is used to knit things; relation, story, tale, narrative; tell a story
words.translation: 纱线；故事，奇谈；[纺]纱线；奇谈，故事；讲故事

examples.en: The old captain would often spin (= tell ) us a yarn about life aboard ship.
examples.zh: 老船长经常会给我们讲一些船上生活的奇闻轶事。

words.definition: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored; breakage, chasm; gap, seam; splay
words.translation: 打呵欠；张开；哈欠；裂口；[生理]打呵欠；裂开；打著呵欠说

examples.en: Alan stretched and yawned.
examples.zh: 艾伦伸伸懒腰，打了个呵欠。

words.definition: to have a strong desire for something, especially something that is difficult or impossible to get; rare, aspire
words.translation: 想念，渴望；渴望，向往；思念，想念；怀念；同情，怜悯

examples.en: He yearned for freedom.
examples.zh: 他曾渴望自由。

words.definition: to produce a result, answer, or piece of information; the amount of profits, crops etc that something produces; desert, quit; succumb, to surrender; crop, output, harvest, proceeds
words.translation: 生产；让步；投降；屈服；产量；[力]屈服；出产；放弃；[力]屈服，投降；[经]产量；收益

examples.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
examples.zh: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

words.definition: a wooden bar used for keeping two animals together, especially cattle, when they are pulling heavy loads; chain, restriction; couple, become one, link; bond, couple, become one, combine
words.translation: 牛轭；枷锁；纽带；轭；束缚；结合；给…上轭；匹配

examples.en: People are still suffering under the yoke of slavery.
examples.zh: 人们仍然生活在奴隶制的枷锁之下。

words.definition: eagerness to do something, especially to achieve a particular religious or political aim; passion, flame, fire, warmth, fervor
words.translation: 热心，热情；热情；热心；热诚

examples.en: ...his zeal for teaching.
examples.zh: …他对教学的热衷。

words.definition: enthusiasm, flavor; season, sauce
words.translation: 乐趣；滋味，风味; 兴趣；风味；热心；强烈的兴趣；给…调味

examples.en: The danger of being caught added a certain zest to the affair.
examples.zh: 被捉奸的危险为这件风流韵事增添了一些刺激性。

words.definition: the scientific study of animals and their behaviour; fauna
words.translation: 动物学；[动]动物学；动物区系

examples.en: The scholarship money she won helped her attend Cornell University, where she majored in zoology.
examples.zh: 她赢得的奖学金帮助她上康奈尔大学，在那里他主修动物学。

words.definition: to provide someone with a place to stay, live, or work; adapt, contain, suit, accept, serve; adjust, adapt to something
words.translation: 提供住宿；使适应；容纳；供应；调解；适应

examples.en: The island was used to accommodate child refugees.
examples.zh: 该岛用于收容儿童难民。

words.definition: a place for someone to stay, live, or work; residence, adjustment, conditioning
words.translation: 住宿；住处，膳宿；[分子生物]调节；和解；预订铺位

examples.en: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
examples.zh: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

examples.en: living accommodations for the crews
examples.zh: 船员的起居舱

examples.en: travel and hotel accommodations
examples.zh: 旅行及酒店住宿

words.definition: to go somewhere with someone; attend, keep company
words.translation: 陪伴，伴奏；陪伴，伴随；伴奏

examples.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zh: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

examples.en: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
examples.zh: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

words.definition: an acute illness or disease quickly becomes very serious; serious, bad, keen
words.translation: 厉害的，敏锐的，(疾病等)急性的；严重的，[医][植]急性的；[数][生物]敏锐的；激烈的；尖声的

examples.en: acute arthritis
examples.zh: 急性关节炎

words.definition: to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation; condition, suit, season; adjust, accomodate to, accommodate to
words.translation: 使适应，改编；使适应；改编；适应

examples.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
examples.zh: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

words.translation: 使沉迷，使嗜好

words.definition: the details of the place where someone lives or works, which you use to send them letters etc; if you address an envelope, package etc, you write on it the name and address of the person you are sending it to; undertake, pursue, have; speech, lecture, talk
words.translation: 住址；致词；向致词；在信封上写姓名；演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；[计]地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧

examples.en: What’s your new address?
examples.zh: 你的新地址是什么？

examples.en: I can give you the address of a good attorney.
examples.zh: 我可以给你一个好律师的地址。

words.definition: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or exists; declare, to be certain; recognize, confirm on
words.translation: 断定，肯定；肯定；断言；确认

examples.en: The court affirmed that the information can be made public under the Freedom of Information Act.
examples.zh: 法院公开肯定了此信息能依据《自由信息法案》公之于众。

examples.en: ...a speech in which he affirmed a commitment to lower taxes.
examples.zh: …在其中他公开肯定了减税承诺的一次演讲。

words.definition: to fasten or stick something to something else; a group of letters added to the beginning or end of a word to change its meaning or use, such as ‘un-’, ‘mis-’, ‘-ness’, or ‘-ly’; paste on; appendix, annexment
words.translation: 附加；贴上；盖印；词缀；粘上；署名；将罪责加之于；[语]词缀；附加物

examples.en: We could reprint at a cost of X, or she had found a service that would affix stickers over the price to correct at a cost of X.
examples.zh: 我们可以按成本价格重新印刷，这将花费X，或根据她找到的一种修正服务，可以重新粘贴上正确的价格，这将花费X。

words.definition: to affect someone or something in an unpleasant way, and make them suffer; harry, worry, trouble, tear, devil
words.translation: 使痛苦，使苦恼；折磨；使痛苦；使苦恼

words.definition: to provide something or allow something to happen; allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
words.translation: 冒险；得起；供给；给予，提供；买得起

examples.en: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
examples.zh: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

examples.en: The new law will afford protection to employees.
examples.zh: 新法律将为雇员提供保障。

words.definition: a business that provides a particular service for people or organizations; procuration, intermediary agent
words.translation: 代理商(社)；[贸易]代理，[经]中介；代理处，经销处

examples.en: We had to hire maids through an agency.
examples.zh: 我们得通过代理公司雇用女佣。

words.definition: a list of problems or subjects that a government, organization etc is planning to deal with
words.translation: 议事日程

examples.en: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
examples.zh: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

words.definition: to make a bad situation, an illness, or an injury worse; anger, complicate
words.translation: 使恶化；使加剧；使气恼；加重；激怒

examples.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
examples.zh: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

examples.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
examples.zh: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

words.definition: the total after a lot of different figures or points have been added together; amount, concentrate, collect, mass, crowd; assemble, sum; collective, all told; collective, polymeric
words.translation: 共计，合计；[数]集合；[物化][无脊椎]聚集；合计；[物化][数]集合体；[会计]总计；[植][无脊椎][地质]聚合的；[数]集合的；合计的

examples.en: (=  as a group or in total  ) , women outlive men by 7 or more years.
examples.zh: 总体来看，女性比男性多活七年或以上。

words.definition: very determined to succeed or get what you want; invasive, enterprising
words.translation: 侵略的，有闯劲的；侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的

examples.en: A successful businessman has to be aggressive.
examples.zh: 成功的实业家必须得有股冲劲。

examples.en: an aggressive marketing campaign
examples.zh: 志在必得的营销活动

words.definition: when you are so anxious, nervous, or upset that you cannot think calmly; warmth, excitation
words.translation: 摇动，焦虑；激动；搅动；煽动；烦乱

examples.en: She was in a state of considerable agitation.
examples.zh: 她处于相当焦虑的状态。

words.definition: very severe pain; unhappiness, vexation
words.translation: 极度痛苦；苦恼；极大的痛苦；临死的挣扎

examples.en: the agony of arthritis
examples.zh: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

words.definition: pleasant; pleasant, adaptive, lovely, calculated, grateful
words.translation: 令人愉快的；乐于同意的；适合的；和蔼可亲的

examples.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
examples.zh: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

examples.en: an agreeable young man
examples.zh: 一个讨人喜欢的年轻人

words.definition: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc; accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping
words.translation: 同意；协议；[法]协议；同意，一致

examples.en: Please read the agreement and sign it.
examples.zh: 请阅读协议书并签字。

words.definition: to destroy something or someone completely; defeat, suppress; submerge
words.translation: 歼灭；消灭；战胜；废止；湮灭；湮没

examples.en: Just one of these bombs could annihilate a city the size of New York.
examples.zh: 这种炸弹只要一颗就能彻底毁灭纽约那么大的一座城市。

words.definition: a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year
words.translation: 周年纪念

examples.en: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
examples.zh: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

words.definition: to make someone feel slightly angry and unhappy about something; harry, ply with; brown off; worry, trouble
words.translation: 使烦恼，使生气；骚扰；惹恼；打搅；令人讨厌；烦恼（等于annoyance）

examples.en: What annoyed him most was that he had received no apology.
examples.zh: 最令他生气的是没人向他道歉。

examples.en: It really annoys me when I see people dropping litter.
examples.zh: 看到别人乱丢垃圾我非常生气。

examples.en: She annoyed him with her stupid questions.
examples.zh: 她那些愚蠢的问题令他很恼火。

words.definition: happening once a year; a plant that lives for one year or season; yearly, etesian; year book, almanac
words.translation: 每年的，一年生的；年刊；一年生植物；年度的；[统计]每年的；年刊，[图情]年鉴

examples.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
examples.zh: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

words.definition: a fixed amount of money that is paid each year to someone, usually until they die; rente, old-age pension
words.translation: 年金；[劳经]年金，养老金；年金保险；年金享受权

examples.en: He received a paltry annuity of $100.
examples.zh: 他收到了微不足道的100美元年金。

words.definition: unknown by name; faceless, innominate
words.translation: 无名的；匿名的；匿名的，无名的；无个性特征的

examples.en: the anonymous author of a collection of poems
examples.zh: 一本诗集的佚名作者

examples.en: According to one employee, who wishes to remain anonymous , the company engaged in illegal activities.
examples.zh: 根据一位不愿透露姓名的员工所述，这家公司曾从事非法活动。

words.definition: opposition to an idea, plan etc; opposition, war, confrontation
words.translation: 反对，不喜欢；[生化]对抗，敌对；对立；敌意

words.definition: an event, organization, or thing that is similar to the one you have mentioned but existed earlier; father, root; advance, prodromal
words.translation: 先行的；祖先；履历；前情；先行词；前驱的；先前的

examples.en: historical antecedents
examples.zh: 历史先例

words.definition: a formal or religious song; spiritual, chorale
words.translation: 赞美诗，圣歌；赞美诗；圣歌

words.definition: a set of stories, poems, songs etc by different people collected together in one book; selection, selected works
words.translation: 诗集；（诗、文、曲、画等的）[图情]选集

examples.en: an anthology of American literature
examples.zh: 美国文学选集

words.definition: the scientific study of people, their societies,  culture s  etc; humanics
words.translation: 人类学；[人类]人类学

examples.en: "In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
examples.zh: “在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。

examples.en: When I was a student at Cambridge I remember an anthropology professor holding up a picture of a bone with 28 incisions carved in it.
examples.zh: 当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。

examples.en: Not to be the skunk at this party, but I think it's important to ask whether neuroscience reveals anything more than we already know from, say, anthropology.
examples.zh: 我并不想成为派对上的讨厌鬼，但我认为很重要的是，要问清楚神经科学是否揭示出我们已知之外的东西，比如人类学。

words.definition: a drug that is used to kill  bacteria  and cure infections; germproof; microbiotic, bacteriophage
words.translation: 抗生素；抗菌的；[药][微]抗生的；[药]抗生素，[微]抗菌素

examples.en: Your doctor may prescribe antibiotics.
examples.zh: 你的大夫可能会开抗生素。

words.definition: to expect that something will happen and be ready for it; hope, presume upon
words.translation: 占先，预先处理；预料；预期，期望；占先，抢先；提前使用

examples.en: Sales are better than anticipated.
examples.zh: 销量比预期要好。

examples.en: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
examples.zh: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

words.definition: when you are expecting something to happen; wish, hope, pleasure, promise
words.translation: 预期；预料；希望；预感；先发制人；预支

examples.en: She waited in eager anticipation for Robert to arrive.
examples.zh: 她急切地期盼着罗伯特到来。

examples.en: Taylor was excited and full of anticipation at the prospect of the trip.
examples.zh: 泰勒很兴奋，对这次旅行满怀期待。

words.definition: a piece of furniture, jewellery etc that was made a very long time ago and is therefore valuable; ancient, old; curiosity, virtu
words.translation: 古代的；古玩；古物；古老的，年代久远的；过时的，[古]古董的；古风的，古式的；[古]古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格

examples.en: The palace is full of priceless antiques.
examples.zh: 宫殿里到处都是价值连城的古董。

examples.en: They bought the clock at an antique shop in Bath.
examples.zh: 他们在巴斯一家古玩店里买了这只钟。

examples.en: an antique dealer
examples.zh: 古玩商

words.definition: a word that means the opposite of another word; opposite
words.translation: 反义词；[语]反义词

examples.en: a dictionary of synonyms and antonyms
examples.zh: 同义词和反义词词典

words.definition: a feeling of wanting to do something very much; solicitude, aspiration
words.translation: 忧虑；渴望；[心理]焦虑；挂念；令人焦虑的事

examples.en: Her voice was full of anxiety.
examples.zh: 她的声音饱含焦虑。

words.definition: anyway, however
words.translation: 不论用何种方法；无论如何；总之；不管怎样

examples.en: The scandal could damage her reputation but the press reported it anyhow.
examples.zh: 这宗丑闻可能损害她的名声，不过报纸还是给登了出来。

words.definition: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for causing trouble for someone, for hurting them, or for disappointing them
words.translation: 表示歉意的

examples.en: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
examples.zh: 医院员工都深表歉意，但那不能真正补偿。

words.definition: the set of tools and machines that you use for a particular scientific, medical, or technical purpose; device, equipment, installation, furniture, facility, unit, organ
words.translation: 仪器；设备；装置，[机]设备；[仪]仪器；器官

examples.en: Astronauts have special breathing apparatus.
examples.zh: 航天员有专门的呼吸装装备。

words.definition: to give someone a particular job or make them responsible for a particular person or thing; portion, part, ticket
words.translation: 分配；确定时间或地点；指派；[计][数]赋值

examples.en: How much time have you assigned for the meeting?
examples.zh: 你给这个会议定了多长时间？

words.definition: to completely understand and begin to use new ideas, information etc; absorb, drink in; drink in, suck up
words.translation: 同化；吸收；使同化；把…比作；使相似

examples.en: It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
examples.zh: 充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

words.definition: someone who you work or do business with; company, travel, sort, mix; brother, partner, fellow, comrade, colleague; combine; deputy, linked, vice, joint, auxiliary
words.translation: 伙伴，同事，同伴；交往；结交；[管理]同事，伙伴；关联的事物；联想；使联合；使发生联系；副的；联合的

examples.en: one of his business associates
examples.zh: 他的一个生意伙伴

words.definition: of various different types; various, combined
words.translation: 各式各样的；组合的；各种各样的；混杂的

examples.en: paintbrushes in assorted sizes
examples.zh: 各种大小的画笔

examples.en: assorted vegetables
examples.zh: 各种各样的蔬菜

words.definition: to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof; undertake, adopt, accept, shoulder, sustain; attitudinize, put on the dog
words.translation: 假定；承担；使用；采取；呈现；装腔作势；多管闲事

examples.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
examples.zh: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

examples.en: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
examples.zh: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

words.definition: something that you think is true although you have no definite proof; conception, perhaps, if
words.translation: 假定之事；承担，担任；假定；设想；担任；采取

examples.en: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
examples.zh: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

words.definition: a feeling of calm confidence about your own abilities, or that you are right about something; certification, insurance, commitment, guarantee, safety
words.translation: 自信；承诺；保险；保证；确信；断言

examples.en: the calm assurance with which she handled the horse
examples.zh: 她对付马儿时的从容镇定

examples.en: ‘Jack will never agree to that,’ he said with assurance.
examples.zh: “杰克绝不会同意的。”他肯定地说道。

words.definition: to tell someone that something will definitely happen or is definitely true so that they are less worried; undertake, swear for
words.translation: 断言，使确信；保(人寿)险；保证；担保；使确信；弄清楚

examples.en: The document is genuine, I can assure you .
examples.zh: 我能向你保证，这文件是真的。

words.definition: shock, appall
words.translation: 使震惊；使惊骇

examples.en: If we did all the things we are capable of, we would literally astound ourselves.
examples.zh: 如果我们所做的都是我们擅长的事情，我们最终将使自己大吃一惊。

words.definition: the scientific study of the stars and  planet s; uranology
words.translation: 天文学；[天]天文学

examples.en: Do you know anything about astronomy?
examples.zh: 你懂天文学吗?

examples.en: In both cases, these insights come not from the science of astronomy but from atmospherics — and that's not really so surprising.
examples.zh: 两种情形下，这些见解并非来自于天文学，而是来自大气干扰—— 而且，那并不令人感到如此的吃惊。

words.definition: protection given to someone by a government because they have escaped from fighting or political trouble in their own country; shadow, umbrella, shelter
words.translation: 避难所；疯人院；避难；庇护；收容所，救济院

examples.en: He applied for asylum in 1987 after fleeing the police back home.
examples.zh: 他于1987年逃脱本国的警察之后申请了避难许可。

words.definition: someone who competes in sports competitions, especially running, jumping, and throwing; player, sportsman
words.translation: 运动员；体育家；运动员，体育家；身强力壮的人

examples.en: a professional athlete
examples.zh: 一位专业运动员

words.definition: a book containing maps, especially of the whole world
words.translation: 地图册；图表集

words.definition: to fasten or connect one object to another; stick on, piece on; to accompany, be with
words.translation: 系上；附上；依恋；认为；使依附；贴上；使依恋；附加；附属；伴随

examples.en: It’s easy to become attached to the children you work with.
examples.zh: 你很容易就会喜欢上工作中接触到的孩子。

words.definition: attempt, push; have at, come at; eat, have at
words.translation: 攻击；非难；疾病发作；[军]攻击；抨击；动手干；腐蚀

words.definition: to succeed in achieving something after trying for a long time; accomplish, carry out, earn, acquire, come true; go, take, land, arrive at; achievement, effort, success, accomplishment, Vostro
words.translation: 取得，得到；达到，实现；获得；到达；达到；成就

examples.en: More women are attaining positions of power.
examples.zh: 越来越多的女性获得要职。

words.definition: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult; essay, attack, push; undertake, offer, sample, purpose, essay
words.translation: 尝试，企图；企图，试图；攻击；尝试

examples.en: He made no attempt to hide his anger.
examples.zh: 他毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。

words.definition: present oneself, invite, serve, board, mind; present oneself, nurse
words.translation: 专心；照顾；出席；上（大学等）；照料；招待；陪伴；致力于

words.definition: the number of people who attend a game, concert, meeting etc; presence
words.translation: 到场；出席人数；出席

examples.en: We have an average attendance of 4,000 fans per game.
examples.zh: 每场比赛平均有4,000名球迷来观战。

examples.en: Last year’s fair saw attendance figures of 32,000.
examples.zh: 去年的交易会有3.2万人参加。

words.definition: someone whose job is to look after or help customers in a public place; accompanied; waiter, suite
words.translation: 服务员；仆人；伴随的；侍候的；服务员，侍者；随员，陪从

examples.en: a car park attendant
examples.zh: 停车场的服务员

words.definition: a lawyer; lawyer, deputy, agent, factor, secondary
words.translation: 律师；[法]代理人

examples.en: ...a prosecuting attorney.
examples.zh: …一位公诉律师。

words.definition: not formal or not for a formal situation; extraordinary, temporary, informal, odd; leisure suit, slack suit
words.translation: 偶然的，碰巧的；随便的；临时的；非正式的；偶然的；便装；临时工人；待命士兵

examples.en: Jean felt more comfortable in casual clothes .
examples.zh: 琼穿上便服感到更舒服。

examples.en: a casual jacket
examples.zh: 休闲夹克

words.definition: contretemps, fortuity
words.translation: 伤亡人员；意外事故；急诊室

examples.en: We have had our first casualty. One runner has dropped out with cramp.
examples.zh: 我们有了第一位伤员，有一位队员因腿部痉挛退出了。

examples.en: Any history of bombing must also be a history of civilian casualty, for bombing saves the lives of soldiers only at the expense of other lives.
examples.zh: 任何空袭的历史也必定是平民伤亡的历史，因为空袭救了士兵的性命只能以其他人的生命为代价。

examples.en: The first item always on that was the overnight casualty report from Iraq and Afghanistan, and I would often come and see that had been circled by the president or that he would be reflecting on that.
examples.zh: 上面的第一条永远是,这一晚在伊拉克和阿富汗,士兵的伤亡报告，我来的时候会看到那条消息,被布什总统圈了出来,他看着报告会陷入沉思。

words.definition: a complete list of things that you can look at, buy, or use, for example in a library or at an art show; directory, content, list
words.translation: 目录；编目；[图情][计]目录；（美）大学情况一览

examples.en: a mail order catalog
examples.zh: 邮购商品目录

examples.en: an online catalogue
examples.zh: 网上目录

words.definition: a substance that makes a chemical reaction happen more quickly without being changed itself; fuel, activator
words.translation: 催化剂；造成变化的人或事；[物化]催化剂；刺激因素

examples.en: I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change.
examples.zh: 我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

words.definition: a terrible event in which there is a lot of destruction, suffering, or death; fiasco, smashup
words.translation: 大灾难，大祸；大灾难；大祸；惨败

examples.en: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
examples.zh: 从各个方面来看，战争都会是一场灾难。

words.definition: to see someone doing something that they did not want you to know they were doing; realize, affect, grasp, contract, communicate; get up to, make it to; haul
words.translation: 抓；接球；逮住；赶(车)；赶上；抓住；感染；了解；捕捉；捕获物；窗钩

examples.en: He was caught red-handed (= as he was doing something wrong ) taking money from the cash register.
examples.zh: 他从现金出纳机偷钱时被当场抓住。

words.definition: an illness that is catching is easily passed to other people; attractive, infectious, epidemic; getting, seizing
words.translation: 传染性的；有魅力的；抓住（catch的ing形式）

examples.en: Julia’s enthusiasm was catching.
examples.zh: 朱莉娅的热情很有感染力。

words.definition: a group of people or things that are all of the same type; variety, classification, kind, manner, sort, nature
words.translation: 种类，类目；种类，分类；[数]范畴

examples.en: people in the over-45 age category
examples.zh: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

examples.en: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
examples.zh: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

examples.en: Williams’ style does not fit easily into the category of jazz.
examples.zh: 威廉斯的风格不能轻易归入爵士乐的范畴。

words.definition: humor, meet the demand
words.translation: 供应伙食；提供娱乐节目；投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务

examples.en: ...a full-service restaurant equipped to cater large events.
examples.zh: …一家承办大型活动及提供全方位服务的饭店。

words.definition: the main church of a particular area under the control of a  bishop; minster, duomo
words.translation: 总教堂；大教堂

examples.en: St Paul’s Cathedral
examples.zh: 圣保罗大教堂

words.definition: A Catholic is a member of the Catholic Church
words.translation: 天主教教徒

examples.en: At least nine out of ten Mexicans are baptized Catholics.
examples.zh: 至少十分之九的墨西哥人是受过洗礼的天主教徒。

words.definition: a caustic substance can burn through things by chemical action; acid, vitriolic; corrosive agent, cauterant
words.translation: 腐蚀性的；刻薄的；苛刻的；[化学]腐蚀性的；苛性的；焦散的；[助剂]腐蚀剂；[化学]苛性钠；焦散曲线

examples.en: caustic soda (= a chemical used for cleaning things )
examples.zh: 苛性钠，烧碱

words.definition: the quality of being very careful to avoid danger or risks; warning, care; alarm, alert, warn
words.translation: 小心；告诫，警告；小心，谨慎；警告，警示；警告

examples.en: The physician must exercise caution when prescribing antidepressants.
examples.zh: 医师在开抗抑郁药处方时必须谨慎。

words.definition: careful to avoid danger or risks; prudent, wary
words.translation: 谨慎的，小心的；谨慎的；十分小心的

examples.en: a cautious driver
examples.zh: 一位谨慎的司机

examples.en: a cautious approach to the crisis
examples.zh: 处理危机的谨慎态度

examples.en: The air-pollution board has reacted with cautious optimism to the announcement.
examples.zh: 空气污染委员会对这项通告表示谨慎乐观。

words.definition: a hole or space inside something; recession, hole
words.translation: 洞；[解剖]腔；洞，凹处

examples.en: Put herbs inside the body cavity of the fish.
examples.zh: 把香草放进鱼肚里。

examples.en: I have no cavities (= no holes in my teeth ) .
examples.zh: 我没有蛀牙洞。

words.definition: to stop doing something or stop happening; desist from, come to a stop; conclude, cheese, quit; stop, stay, stand, cessation, set-back
words.translation: 停止；终了；结束

examples.en: The things people will do for charity never cease to amaze me (= I am always surprised by them ) .
examples.zh: 人们的慈善义举总是让我感到惊讶。

examples.en: The rain ceased and the sky cleared.
examples.zh: 雨过天晴。

words.definition: a room under a house or other building, often used for storing things; basement, earth pit
words.translation: 地窖；酒窖；[建]地窖；地下室

examples.en: a coal cellar
examples.zh: 煤窖

words.definition: a grey powder made from  lime  and clay that becomes hard when it is mixed with water and allowed to dry, and that is used in building; If things are cemented together, they are stuck or fastened together; enhance, muscle, piece, consolidate, joint; jointing compound
words.translation: 水泥；结合剂；黏结，胶合；巩固，加强；用水泥涂；接合；[建]水泥；[胶粘]接合剂

examples.en: a bag of cement
examples.zh: 一袋水泥

examples.en: Most artificial joints are cemented into place.
examples.zh: 绝大部分人造关节是被黏结复位的。

words.definition: a piece of land, usually not belonging to a church, in which dead people are buried
words.translation: 公墓，墓地

examples.en: Her father was laid in a cemetery.
examples.zh: 她父亲安葬在一处公墓。

examples.en: The body was interred at that cemetery.
examples.zh: 尸体下葬在那个公墓。

examples.en: He rests in a cemetery in the western suburbs of Beijing.
examples.zh: 他长眠于北京西郊的一个公墓中。

words.definition: a small metal object for fastening a bag, belt, piece of jewellery etc; handshake, shake-hands; press, button; buckle, button up
words.translation: 扣子；紧握；拥抱；扣子，钩子；握手；紧抱；扣紧；紧紧缠绕；扣住

examples.en: the firm clasp of her hand
examples.zh: 她有力的握手

words.definition: of excellent quality; a book, play, or film that is important and has been admired for a long time; traditional, conventional; chefdoeuvre, scriptures
words.translation: 第一流的，最优秀的；传统的；古典作品；经典的；古典的，传统的；最优秀的；名著；经典著作；大艺术家

examples.en: Roy scored a classic goal in the 90th minute.
examples.zh: 罗伊在第90分钟时踢进了漂亮的一球。

words.definition: belonging to a traditional style or set of ideas; traditional, conventional, royal; classic music
words.translation: 一流的；古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的；古典音乐

examples.en: the classical theory of relativity
examples.zh: 经典相对论

words.definition: to decide what group something belongs to; categorize, sort through
words.translation: 把分类(归类)；分等级；分类；分等

examples.en: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
examples.zh: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

examples.en: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
examples.zh: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

words.definition: a part of a written law or legal document covering a particular subject of the whole law or document; item, provision, article
words.translation: 条款，从句；[法]条款；[计]子句

examples.en: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
examples.zh: 合同中加上了一项保密条款。

words.definition: to make somewhere emptier or tidier by removing things from it; distinct, liquid, fair, fine, crystal; track, jump; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully; removel, liquidation
words.translation: 清楚的(地)，清白的(地)；清除；清楚的；清澈的；[气象]晴朗的；无罪的；通过；[计]清除；使干净；跳过；清晰地；完全地；空隙

examples.en: Snowplows have been out clearing the roads.
examples.zh: 扫雪机已经出动，去清扫路面了。

examples.en: Dad cleared a space (= moved things so there was room ) in the garage for Jim’s tools.
examples.zh: 爸爸在车库里清理出一个地方来放吉姆的工具。

examples.en: It’s Kelly’s turn to clear the table (= remove the dirty plates, forks etc ) .
examples.zh: 轮到凯利收拾桌子了。

words.definition: the process of getting official permission or approval for something; removel, liquidation
words.translation: 清除，清理，净空；许可；清除；空隙

examples.en: She’ll race if she gets medical clearance from her doctor.
examples.zh: 如果取得了医生的许可，她就会参加比赛。

examples.en: Morris did not have a security clearance .
examples.zh: 莫里斯没有安全审查许可。

words.translation: 陈腐思想，陈词滥调

words.definition: to make a short hard sound, or make something produce this sound; ticktack, tictac
words.translation: 咔嗒一声；单击；滴答声

examples.en: The door clicked shut behind me.
examples.zh: 门在我身后咔嗒一声关上了。

examples.en: Mother clicked her tongue (= made a short sound to show disapproval ) and sighed.
examples.zh: 妈妈咂咂嘴，叹了口气。

examples.en: Edmund clicked his fingers (= made a short sound to get someone’s attention ) for John to follow him.
examples.zh: 埃德蒙弹了个响指示意约翰跟着他。

words.definition: someone who gets services or advice from a professional person, company, or organization; customer, consumer, principal, guest, correspondent
words.translation: 律师等的当事人，委托人；商店的顾客；[计][经]客户；顾客；[审计]委托人

examples.en: a meeting with an important client
examples.zh: 与一位重要客户的会面

words.definition: the most exciting or important part of a story or experience, which usually comes near the end; if a situation, process, or story climaxes, it reaches its most important or exciting part; height, summit, sky, peak, pole
words.translation: 顶点；小说等的高潮；达到高潮；高潮；层进法；极点

examples.en: The festival reaches its climax with the traditional boat-burning ceremony.
examples.zh: 传统的烧船仪式将节庆活动推向了高潮。

words.definition: If someone clings to a position or a possession they have, they do everything they can to keep it even though this may be very difficult; stay, stand on
words.translation: 抱紧，坚守；坚持，墨守；紧贴；附着

examples.en: Instead, he appears determined to cling to power.
examples.zh: 反而，他看来坚决要握紧权力不放。

examples.en: Another congressman clung on with a majority of only 18.
examples.zh: 另一位国会议员在获得仅仅18张多数票的情况下保住了位子。

words.definition: a place, often in a hospital, where medical treatment is given to people who do not need to stay in the hospital; ambulatorium
words.translation: 诊所，门诊所；[临床]临床；诊所

examples.en: an appointment at an outpatient clinic
examples.zh: 门诊预约

words.definition: to cut an article or picture from a newspaper, magazine etc; a small metal or plastic object that holds or fastens things together; shear, crop; shear, trim off; shear, cutting back
words.translation: 剪短；猛击，痛打；回形针；夹子，剪；[园艺]修剪；夹牢；痛打；夹子

examples.en: The hedges had just been clipped.
examples.zh: 树篱刚修剪过。

words.definition: in the same direction as the  hands  of a clock move; deasil
words.translation: 顺时针方向地

examples.en: Screw the lid on clockwise.
examples.zh: 按顺时针方向拧紧盖子。

words.definition: A closet is a very small room for storing things, especially one without windows; storage wall, built-in wardrobe; secret, private, underground, theoretic, chamber
words.translation: 小储藏室；壁橱；议事室，密室；小房间；秘密的，私下的；空谈的

words.definition: an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery; action, plot, scenario
words.translation: 线索；（故事等的）情节

examples.en: Police have found a vital clue .
examples.zh: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

examples.en: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
examples.zh: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

examples.en: a desperate search for clues
examples.zh: 拼命寻找线索

words.definition: if two armies, groups etc clash, they start fighting – used in news reports; interference, conflict, war, collision, warfare; tang, collide with
words.translation: 金属碰撞声；互碰；时间冲突；抵触；冲突，不协调；碰撞声，铿锵声；冲突，抵触；砰地相碰撞，发出铿锵声

examples.en: Troops clashed near the border.
examples.zh: 军队在边境附近发生了冲突。

words.definition: sudden noisy activity; combustion, turmoil
words.translation: 混乱，动乱；骚动；暴乱

examples.en: They heard a commotion downstairs.
examples.zh: 他们听见楼下一阵骚动。

examples.en: Everyone looked to see what was causing the commotion .
examples.zh: 大家都在看是什么引起了喧闹。

words.definition: the process by which people exchange information or express their thoughts and feelings; telecommunications, exchange
words.translation: 通讯，交往，交流，传达的消息；交通；通讯，[通信]通信；交流

examples.en: Good communication is vital in a large organization.
examples.zh: 在大机构里良好的沟通是极为重要的。

examples.en: Radio was the pilot’s only means of communication .
examples.zh: 无线电是飞行员唯一的通信手段。

words.definition: to change the punishment given to a criminal to one that is less severe; exchange for, give for
words.translation: 交换，兑换；减轻；经常往来；减刑；[数]交换；用……交换；使……变成

examples.en: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
examples.zh: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

words.translation: 乘公交车辆上下班者

words.definition: packed or put together firmly and closely; stipulation, covenant; close, brief
words.translation: 紧密的，紧凑的；合同，契约；小粉盒；[数]紧凑的，紧密的；简洁的

examples.en: The bushes grew in a compact mass.
examples.zh: 灌木长成茂密的一片。

words.definition: a business organization that makes or sells goods or services; corporation, establishment, firm, incorporation; travel, associate, sort, mix; attend, accompany
words.translation: 伴随；人群；同伴；公司；[贸易]公司；陪伴，同伴；连队；交往；陪伴

examples.en: Which company do you work for?
examples.zh: 你在哪家公司上班？

examples.en: I called the phone company about the bill.
examples.zh: 我就电话账单的事给电话公司打了电话。

examples.en: The company was set up just after the war.
examples.zh: 这家公司是战后不久成立的。

words.definition: similar to something else in size, number, quality etc, so that you can make a comparison
words.translation: 可比较的

examples.en: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
examples.zh: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

words.definition: to consider two or more things or people, in order to show how they are similar or different; contradistinguish, be confronted with; match; parabole
words.translation: 比较，对照；喻为；比较；对照；比喻为；相比

examples.en: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
examples.zh: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

words.definition: a smaller enclosed space inside something larger; to divide, measure off
words.translation: 分隔间；火车车厢的分隔间；分隔；划分

examples.en: The bag is divided into separate compartments .
examples.zh: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["engine compartment"]}
examples.zh: 发动机室

examples.en: She kept the money hidden in a secret compartment in her briefcase.
examples.zh: 她把钱藏在公文包的暗层里。

words.definition: an instrument that shows directions and has a needle that always points north; calliper, divider; case, invest, circumvent, encircle, ring about
words.translation: 指南针；圆规；界限；指南针，[航][水运]罗盘；包围

examples.en: a map and compass
examples.zh: 地图和指南针

words.definition: if two pieces of computer equipment are compatible, they can be used together, especially when they are made by different companies
words.translation: 可兼容的，可和谐共存的

examples.en: The new software is IBM compatible (= can be used with IBM computers ) .
examples.zh: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

words.definition: to force someone to do something; pressure, force, enforce
words.translation: 强迫，迫使；强使发生

examples.en: ...the introduction of legislation to compel cyclists to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: …强制骑车人戴头盔的法律的引入。

words.definition: to replace or balance the effect of something bad; make good, to make up for
words.translation: 赔偿，补偿；补偿，赔偿；抵消；付报酬

examples.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
examples.zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

words.definition: money paid to someone because they have suffered injury or loss, or because something they own has been damaged; payment, consideration, insurance, reward, offset
words.translation: 赔偿；[会计]补偿；报酬；[保险]赔偿金

examples.en: People who are wrongly arrested may be paid compensation .
examples.zh: 被误抓的人有可能得到补偿费。

words.definition: the ability to do something well; ability, capacity, rights, power, jurisdiction
words.translation: 能力，胜任，权限；能力，[胚]胜任；权限；作证能力；足以过舒适生活的收入

examples.en: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
examples.zh: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

words.definition: the people or groups that are competing against you, especially in business or in a sport; game, war, match, tournament, struggle
words.translation: 比赛，比赛会；[生态]竞争；比赛，竞赛

examples.en: Going to trade fairs is an ideal opportunity to size up the competition .
examples.zh: 参加商品交易会是估量竞争规模的理想机会。

words.definition: played, rival
words.translation: 比赛的；竞争的；求胜心切的

words.definition: to make a book, list, record etc, using different pieces of information, music etc; to edit, copy-edit
words.translation: 编辑，编写；编译；编制；编辑；[图情]汇编

examples.en: The document was compiled by the Department of Health.
examples.zh: 这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

words.definition: someone or something that emphasizes the good qualities of another person or thing; to make a good combination with someone or something else; make up a loss, make sth up
words.translation: 补足物，船上的定员；补语；补充，补足；补足，补助

examples.en: The green wallpaper is the perfect complement to the old pine of the dresser.
examples.zh: 绿色墙纸是旧松木梳妆台的完美衬托。

words.definition: consisting of many different parts and often difficult to understand; a large number of things which are closely related; sophisticated, involved, synthetic, detailed, intricate
words.translation: 复杂的；复合体；变态心理；合成的

examples.en: a complex system of highways
examples.zh: 复杂的公路网

examples.en: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
examples.zh: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

examples.en: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
examples.zh: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

words.definition: the natural colour or appearance of the skin on your face; situation, circumstance, thing, color, case
words.translation: 肤色；情况；局面；气质；面色

examples.en: Drinking water is good for the complexion.
examples.zh: 喝水让气色变好。

words.definition: fairly large, especially large enough to have an effect or be important; crucial, important, material, big, major
words.translation: 相当大的；重要的；重要的，值得考虑的

examples.en: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

examples.en: issues of considerable importance
examples.zh: 相当重要的问题

examples.en: The series has aroused considerable interest.
examples.zh: 这套系列节目引起了观众相当浓厚的兴趣。

words.definition: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people; thoughtful, wary
words.translation: 考虑周到的；体谅别人的；体贴的；体谅的

examples.en: I think he's the most charming, most considerate man I've ever known.
examples.zh: 我觉得他是我所认识的最有魅力、最体贴的男士。

words.definition: to send something somewhere, especially in order to sell it; park, deliver over
words.translation: 运送；交付；[交]托运；寄存；把…委托给

words.definition: Something that consists of particular things or people is formed from them; make up, be composed of
words.translation: 组成; 存在；组成；在于；符合

examples.en: My diet consisted almost exclusively of chocolate-covered cookies and glasses of milk.
examples.zh: 我的饮食几乎只包含裹上巧克力的曲奇饼和一杯杯牛奶。

words.definition: a flat board that contains the controls for a machine, piece of electrical equipment, computer etc; to make someone feel better when they are feeling sad or disappointed; Prefs, operation desk; comfort, quiet
words.translation: 控制台，仪表板；落地柜；安慰，慰问；[计]控制台；[电]操纵台；安慰；慰藉

examples.en: No one could console her when Peter died.
examples.zh: 彼得去世时没人能够安慰她。

words.definition: to strengthen the position of power or success that you have, so that it becomes more effective or continues for longer; cement, strengthen, connect, fix, link; build up, to reinforce
words.translation: 巩固;；合为一体；巩固，使固定；联合；巩固，加强

examples.en: The company has consolidated its position as the country’s leading gas supplier.
examples.zh: 这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。

examples.en: The team consolidated their lead with a third goal.
examples.zh: 球队以第三个进球巩固了领先优势。

words.definition: very easy to notice; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding
words.translation: 明显的，引人注目的；显著的；显而易见的

examples.en: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
examples.zh: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

examples.en: a bird with conspicuous white markings
examples.zh: 一种长有醒目白斑的鸟

examples.en: I felt very conspicuous in my red coat.
examples.zh: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

words.definition: a secret plan made by two or more people to do something that is harmful or illegal; designing, plot
words.translation: 阴谋，同谋；阴谋；共谋；阴谋集团

examples.en: There were many conspiracy theories (= beliefs that something is the result of a conspiracy ) surrounding Princess Diana’s death.
examples.zh: 围绕戴安娜王妃之死有许多阴谋论。

words.definition: happening regularly or all the time; permanent, steady; invariable
words.translation: 不变的；经常的；坚定的；恒定的；[数]常数；恒量

examples.en: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
examples.zh: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

examples.en: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
examples.zh: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

examples.en: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

words.definition: being one of the parts of something; element, client, component, principal; component, electoral
words.translation: 有选举权的；组成的；选民；成份；成分；委托人；构成的；选举的

examples.en: the EU and its constituent members
examples.zh: 欧盟及其成员国

words.definition: if several people or things constitute something, they are the parts that form it; install, establish, form, found, build
words.translation: 组成; 构成; 任命；组成，构成；建立；任命

examples.en: We must redefine what constitutes a family.
examples.zh: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。

words.definition: a set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by; formation, fabric, structure, build, make
words.translation: 宪法；体格；构造；体质；章程

examples.en: The right to speak freely is written into the Constitution of the United States.
examples.zh: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

words.definition: to limit something; chain, bound, force, provoke, enforce
words.translation: 强迫；限制；克制；驱使；束缚

examples.en: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
examples.zh: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

examples.en: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
examples.zh: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

words.definition: to make something narrower or tighter, or to become narrower or tighter; to compress, telescope
words.translation: 压缩，缩小；压缩；束紧

examples.en: Caffeine constricts the blood vessels in your body.
examples.zh: 咖啡因会使体内的血管收缩。

examples.en: Linda’s throat constricted and she started to cry.
examples.zh: 琳达喉咙发紧，哭了起来。

words.definition: to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something; look up, speak together; take advice, seek advice
words.translation: 请教；咨询，查阅；查阅；商量；向…请教；商议；当顾问

examples.en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
examples.zh: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

words.definition: someone who buys and uses products and services; user, customer, client, guest
words.translation: 消费者，用户；[经][生态]消费者；用户，顾客

examples.en: Consumers will soon be paying higher airfares.
examples.zh: 不久消费者就要支付更高的机票价了。

examples.en: It will offer a wider choice of goods for the consumer (= consumers in general ) .
examples.zh: 它将为消费者提供更多的商品选择。

examples.en: Consumer demand led to higher imports of manufactured goods.
examples.zh: 消费者需求促使制造商品的进口量增加了。

words.definition: the act of buying and using products; expense, depletion
words.translation: 消费；结核病；[经]消费；消耗；肺痨

examples.en: art intended for mass consumption
examples.zh: 供大众消费的艺术品

examples.en: China’s austerity program has cut domestic consumption (= when products are bought in the country where they were produced ) .
examples.zh: 中国的经济紧缩计划缩减了国内消费。

words.definition: communication with a person, organization, country etc; touch, link; meet, to link
words.translation: 接触；联络；会晤的人；(电)接点；[电][电子]接触，联系；联系，[电][电子]接触

examples.en: Does that metal pit after contact with acid?
examples.zh: 那种金属同酸接触后是否会起凹点?

examples.en: When you contact these two wires, the machine will start at once.
examples.zh: 当你使这两条导线一接触，这台机器就会立刻开始运转。

words.definition: to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it; soil, mud, spot, dirty, poison
words.translation: 弄脏；污染；污染，弄脏

examples.en: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
examples.zh: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

words.definition: to have an accident in a car, plane etc by violently hitting something else; an accident in which a vehicle violently hits something else; collision, precipitation, impact; fall of, fall to pieces; hit, impact on; quickie
words.translation: 碰撞，坠毁，冲过；突然坠落；事故；碰撞；崩溃；坠落；破碎；撞碎；[航]坠毁；闯；突然倒台；速成的

examples.en: The jet crashed after take-off.
examples.zh: 这架喷气式飞机起飞后就坠毁了。

words.definition: a round hole in the ground made by something that has fallen on it or by an explosion; volcanic vent, dead hole; destroy, damage, recall
words.translation: 火山口; 弹坑；[地质]火山口；弹坑；在…上形成坑；取消；毁坏

examples.en: craters on the moon’s surface
examples.zh: 月球表面的坑

words.definition: to move along on your hands and knees with your body close to the ground; a way of swimming in which you lie on your stomach and move one arm, and then the other, over your head; creep; creep, aquarium
words.translation: 爬行;缓慢地行进，爬满；爬行；自由泳；匍匐行进；[水产]养鱼池；匍匐而行

examples.en: We crawled into bed at 2 am.
examples.zh: 我们凌晨两点爬上了床。

words.definition: a line on a piece of cloth, paper etc where it has been folded, crushed, or pressed; to become marked with a line or lines, or to make a line appear on cloth, paper etc by folding or crushing it; fell, fold; wrinkle; crush, crumple
words.translation: 折缝，皱痕；起折痕；折痕；折缝；起皱；弄皱；使起折痕

examples.en: She smoothed the creases from her skirt.
examples.zh: 她捋平裙子上的皱褶。

examples.en: I’ll have to iron out the creases.
examples.zh: 我得把皱褶熨平。

words.definition: to make something exist that did not exist before; produce, invent
words.translation: 创造；创作；产生；造成；创造，创作

examples.en: Some people believe the universe was created by a big explosion.
examples.zh: 有些人认为宇宙是通过一次大爆炸创造出来的。

examples.en: Her behaviour is creating a lot of problems.
examples.zh: 她的行为引起了很多问题。

examples.en: The new factory is expected to create more than 400 new jobs.
examples.zh: 这家新工厂预计能创造400多个新的就业机会。

words.definition: the act of creating something; child, fruit
words.translation: 创作，创造，创造物；创造，创作；创作物，产物

examples.en: a job creation scheme
examples.zh: 创造就业机会的计划

words.definition: a letter or other document which proves your good character or your right to have a particular position; certificates, diplomata
words.translation: 信任状，证书；[管理]证书；文凭；信任状（credential的复数）

examples.en: The commissioner presented his credentials to the State Department.
examples.zh: 该委员向国务院递交了他的任职资格证书。

words.definition: deserving or able to be believed or trusted; responsible, reliable, tried, honest, safe
words.translation: 可信任的，可靠的；可靠的，可信的

examples.en: Her excuse was barely credible.
examples.zh: 她的借口无法让人信服。

examples.en: a credible alternative to nuclear power
examples.zh: 原子能的可靠替代物

words.definition: an arrangement with a shop, bank etc that allows you to buy something and pay for it later; to believe or admit that someone has a quality, or has done something good; faith, reputation, honor, loan, confidence; put faith in, believe in
words.translation: 信任，信誉；存款；信用贷款；相信；信用，信誉；[金融]贷款；学分；信任；声望；相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂

examples.en: The store agreed to let him have credit.
examples.zh: 商店同意他赊购。

examples.en: What’s the credit limit on your Visa card?
examples.zh: 你的维萨卡信用额度是多少？

words.definition: if something such as an insect, small animal, or car creeps, it moves slowly and quietly; to spread, to extend; toadeater, kiss-ass
words.translation: 爬行；缓慢移行；(时间)悄悄过去；蔓延；慢慢地移动；起鸡皮疙瘩；毛骨悚然的感觉；谄媚者

examples.en: He crept back up the stairs, trying to avoid the ones that creaked.
examples.zh: 他蹑手蹑脚地回楼上，尽量避开那些嘎吱作响的梯级。

words.definition: a narrow crack in the surface of something, especially in rock; crack, split
words.translation: (岩石、墙等)裂缝；裂缝；裂隙

examples.en: small creatures that hide in crevices in the rock
examples.zh: 藏在岩石缝里的小生物

words.definition: a game between two teams of 11 players in which players try to get points by hitting a ball and running between two sets of three sticks; Chinese Cricket, grig
words.translation: 板球；蟋蟀；板球，板球运动；[昆]蟋蟀

examples.en: The boy traded his knife for a cricket bat.
examples.zh: 那男孩用他的刀子换了一个板球棒。

examples.en: He angrily stomped his cricket after failing the fight.
examples.zh: 比赛失败后，他生气地踏死了他的蟋蟀。

examples.en: He was pressganged into playing in the charity cricket match.
examples.zh: 他是被强拉去参加这场板球义赛的。

words.definition: someone who is involved in illegal activities or has been proved guilty of a crime; relating to crime; offender, culprit; penal, peccant
words.translation: 罪犯；犯罪的，刑事上的；刑事的；犯罪的；罪恶的

examples.en: Police have described the man as a violent and dangerous criminal.
examples.zh: 警方形容那名男子是个凶暴而危险的罪犯。

examples.en: a convicted criminal
examples.zh: 一名已决罪犯

examples.en: The new law will ensure that habitual criminals (= criminals who commit crimes repeatedly ) receive tougher punishments than first-time offenders.
examples.zh: 新法律将确保惯犯比初犯受到更为严厉的惩罚。

words.definition: someone who is unable to walk properly because their legs are damaged or injured - now considered offensive; to hurt someone badly so that they cannot walk properly; break, to weaken; disablement, lameness; disabled, spavined
words.translation: 跛子；残疾人；使跛，使残疾；削弱；使跛；[医]使残废；[医]跛子；残废；跛的；[医]残废的

examples.en: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
examples.zh: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好体育运动的年轻姑娘变成了一个残疾人。

words.definition: a situation in which there are a lot of problems that must be dealt with quickly so that the situation does not get worse or more dangerous; defining moment, critical stage
words.translation: 转折点；危机；危险期；决定性时刻

examples.en: The country now faces an economic crisis .
examples.zh: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

examples.en: The Prime Minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis .
examples.zh: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

examples.en: the current debt crisis
examples.zh: 当前的债务危机

words.definition: something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it; a very thin flat round piece of potato that is cooked in oil and eaten cold; to become crisp or make something become crisp by cooking or heating it; fresh, new, fragile, delicate; crimp; curl
words.translation: 脆的；干脆的；油炸马铃薯片；(使)发脆；新鲜的；易碎的；使卷曲；使发脆；卷曲；发脆

examples.en: She kicked at the crisp leaves at her feet.
examples.zh: 她踢着脚边松脆的树叶。

examples.en: He stepped carefully through the crisp deep snow.
examples.zh: 他小心地走在松脆的、厚厚的雪地里。

words.definition: a standard that you use to judge something or make a decision about something; standard, formula, level, prototype, norm
words.translation: 判断的标准(pl-ria)；（批评判断的）[标准]标准；准则；规范；准据

examples.en: the criteria we use to select candidates
examples.zh: 我们挑选候选人的标准

words.definition: if you are critical, you criticize someone or something; dangerous, crucial, final, decisive, marginal
words.translation: 危急的；批评的；苛求的，关键的；鉴定的；[核]临界的；批评的，爱挑剔的；危险的；决定性的；评论的

examples.en: He made some highly critical remarks.
examples.zh: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

words.definition: a job or activity in which you make things with your hands, and that you usually need skill to do; technology, hand, ship, workmanship
words.translation: 工艺；手工业；船；技巧；诡计；手艺；太空船

examples.en: traditional rural crafts
examples.zh: 传统的乡村手工艺

examples.en: arts and crafts
examples.zh: 手工艺

words.definition: a priest of high rank in the Christian church who is in charge of several priests or churches
words.translation: (大学)院长，系主任，教务长

examples.en: the admissions dean
examples.zh: 招生主任

words.definition: a situation in which there are very few of something that people want or need; shortage, deficiency, short of, need, drought
words.translation: 缺乏，供应不足；缺乏；饥馑；粮食不足

examples.en: Construction had slowed because of a dearth of labourers.
examples.zh: 建筑进程缓慢是因为劳动力不足。

words.definition: the pieces of something that are left after it has been destroyed in an accident, explosion etc; remain, chip
words.translation: 碎片，瓦砾堆；碎片，残骸

examples.en: She was hit by flying debris from the blast.
examples.zh: 她被爆炸产生的飞散碎片击中。

words.definition: a period of 10 years; decennium, dix
words.translation: 十年；十年，十年期；十

examples.en: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: …19世纪的最后10年。

words.definition: to be slowly destroyed by a natural chemical process, or to make something do this; fail, flag; recession, downturn, decline, decomposition; corrupt, septicize
words.translation: 腐朽，腐烂，衰微；衰退，[核]衰减；腐烂，[木]腐朽；使腐烂，使腐败；使衰退，使衰落

examples.en: Her body was already starting to decay.
examples.zh: 她的尸体已经开始腐烂。

examples.en: Most archaeological finds are broken, damaged, or decayed.
examples.zh: 大部分考古发现物都已破裂、损坏或腐烂。

examples.en: decaying organic matter
examples.zh: 腐烂的有机物

words.definition: to make someone believe something that is not true; take in sb, give the shaft
words.translation: 欺骗，诓骗；欺骗；行骗

examples.en: He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
examples.zh: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

words.definition: following moral standards that are acceptable to society; proper, goodish
words.translation: 正当的，合适的；文雅的，尚可的；正派的；得体的；相当好的

examples.en: a decent burial
examples.zh: 得体的葬礼

examples.en: Paul visited the local bars more frequently than was decent for a senior lecturer.
examples.zh: 保罗过于频繁地光顾当地酒吧，不太合乎高级讲师的身份。

examples.en: The chairman did the decent thing (= did what people thought he ought to ) and resigned.
examples.zh: 主席体面地辞去了职务。

words.definition: a decimal system is based on the number 10; fractional; small number, haet
words.translation: 十进法的，小数的；小数的；[数]十进位的；[数]小数

examples.en: changing to a decimal system
examples.zh: 改为十进制

examples.en: calculations accurate to three decimal places
examples.zh: 精确到小数点后三位的计算

words.definition: to find the meaning of something that is difficult to read or understand
words.translation: 译解(密码等)

examples.en: She studied the envelope, trying to decipher the handwriting.
examples.zh: 她仔细地看信封，试图辨认上面的字迹。

words.definition: one of the levels on a bus, plane etc; to decorate something with flowers, flags etc; board, storage room; paint, hang, dress oneself, array
words.translation: 甲板；公共汽车一层的车厢；纸牌；装饰；[船]甲板；行李仓；露天平台；[船]装甲板；打扮

examples.en: Eddie returned to the flight deck (= the part of an aircraft where the pilot sits ) .
examples.zh: 埃迪回到了驾驶舱。

words.definition: an important official statement about a particular situation or plan, or the act of making this statement; profession, announcement
words.translation: 宣布，宣言；声明；（纳税品等的）[税收]申报；宣布；公告；[法]申诉书

examples.en: a ceasefire declaration
examples.zh: 停火声明

examples.en: Under Islamic law it was possible to divorce by simple declaration.
examples.zh: 从前按照伊斯兰法律，作简单的声明就可以离婚。

words.definition: to state officially and publicly that a particular situation exists or that something is true; bill, state; to announce, hand down
words.translation: 宣告，声明；断言；申报应纳税物品；宣布，声明；断言，宣称；声明，宣布

examples.en: A state of emergency has been declared.
examples.zh: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
examples.zh: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

examples.en: We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
examples.zh: 我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

words.definition: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength; reduction, recession, fall; go down, slump; excuse oneself from
words.translation: 下降，衰退，减弱；拒绝；下降；衰退；斜面；衰落；谢绝；婉拒

examples.en: The number of staff has declined from 217,000 to 114,000.
examples.zh: 员工人数已从217000人减少到114000人。

examples.en: Hourly output by workers declined 1.3% in the first quarter.
examples.zh: 工人每小时的产量在第1季度下降了1.3%。

words.definition: to decay or make something decay; resolve, break down; analyze, break down
words.translation: 腐败；分解，腐烂；分解；使腐烂；腐烂

examples.en: a partially decomposed body
examples.zh: 部分腐烂的尸体

words.definition: to make something look more attractive by putting something pretty on it; paint, hang, make, post; set sth out, trick out
words.translation: 装饰；油漆；授勋；布置；授勋给

examples.en: Children’s pictures decorated the walls of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室的墙上装点着儿童画。

words.definition: to become less or go down to a lower level, or to make something do this; reduction, loss; to cut down, fall off; shorten, weaken
words.translation: 减少，减少，减少量；减少，减小；减少量

examples.en: The number of people who have the disease has decreased significantly in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，这种病的患者人数明显下降。

examples.en: They want to decrease their reliance on oil.
examples.zh: 他们想减少对石油的依赖。

words.definition: an official order or decision, especially one made by the ruler of a country; sentence, award, act, ordinance; require, order, command, determine, fate; be doomed to, issue an order
words.translation: 法令，判决；[法]法令；判决；命令；颁布；注定；发布命令

examples.en: The Emperor issued the decree repealing martial law.
examples.zh: 皇帝下诏令取消了军事管制。

words.definition: old and in bad condition; shot, anile
words.translation: 老弱的，衰老的；衰老的；破旧的

examples.en: The buildings were in a decrepit state.
examples.zh: 这些建筑物破旧不堪。

examples.en: He was a rather decrepit old man.
examples.zh: 他年老体弱。

words.definition: to say at the beginning of a book or film, or before a piece of music, that it has been written, made, or performed for someone that you love or respect; give oneself, devote  to
words.translation: 奉献，供奉，题献(著作)；致力；献身；题献

examples.en: She dedicated her first album to Woody Allen, who she says understands her obsession.
examples.zh: 她把她的第一张唱片献给伍迪·艾伦，她说艾伦理解她的痴迷。

words.definition: devoted, special
words.translation: 献身的，一心一意的，热诚的；[计]专用的；专注的；献身的

examples.en: a dedicated and thoughtful teacher
examples.zh: 一位富有敬业精神、待人体贴的教师

words.definition: to use the knowledge and information you have in order to understand something or form an opinion about it; understand, reason, conclude
words.translation: 演绎，推论；推论，推断；[数][计]演绎出

examples.en: Alison cleverly deduced that I was the author of the letter.
examples.zh: 艾莉森聪明地推断出我是这封信的作者。

words.definition: a feeling that you have no hope at all; hopelessness, acedia; throw up one's hands, lose heart
words.translation: 绝望，丧失信心；绝望；令人绝望的人或事

examples.en: The noise from the neighbours used to drive him to despair .
examples.zh: 过去，邻居的噪音常常吵得他心烦意乱。

words.definition: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger; venturous, devil-may-care
words.translation: 绝望的；不顾一切的；危急的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的

examples.en: I had no money left and was desperate.
examples.zh: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

examples.en: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
examples.zh: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

examples.en: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
examples.zh: 失踪少年绝望的父母

words.definition: to dislike and have a low opinion of someone or something; slight, set light by
words.translation: 鄙视，看不起；轻视，鄙视

examples.en: She despised her neighbours.
examples.zh: 她看不起她的邻居。

words.definition: the place that someone or something is going to; goal, end-point
words.translation: 目的地；[计]目的地，终点

examples.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
examples.zh: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

words.definition: fate, engage, budget
words.translation: 命中注定；预定；注定；命定

words.definition: the things that will happen to someone in the future, especially those that cannot be changed or controlled; fate, lot, fortune, portion
words.translation: 命运；命运，定数，天命

examples.en: She always had a strong sense of destiny .
examples.zh: 她向来很相信天意。

words.definition: causing damage to people or things; harmful, evil, fell, negative, passive
words.translation: 破坏的，破坏性的；破坏的；毁灭性的；有害的，消极的

examples.en: the destructive power of modern weapons
examples.zh: 现代武器的破坏力

words.definition: if you detach something, or if it detaches, it becomes separated from the thing it was attached to; mission, keep apart
words.translation: 使分开；拆卸；派遣；分离；使超然

examples.en: Please detach and fill out the application form.
examples.zh: 请撕下申请表并填好。

words.definition: to officially prevent someone from leaving a place; hold, delay
words.translation: 留住；扣押，拘留；拘留；耽搁

examples.en: Two suspects have been detained by the police for questioning .
examples.zh: 两名嫌疑人被警方拘留审问。

examples.en: She was detained in hospital with a suspected broken leg.
examples.zh: 她因腿部疑似骨折而被留医。

words.definition: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc; explore, perceive
words.translation: 发现，发觉；侦察；察觉；发现；探测

examples.en: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
examples.zh: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

words.definition: A detective novel or story is one in which a detective tries to solve a crime; tec, hawkshaw
words.translation: 侦探的，发觉者的；侦探

examples.en: ...Arthur Conan Doyle's classic detective novel.
examples.zh: …阿瑟·柯南·道尔的经典侦探小说。

words.definition: to stop someone from doing something, by making them realize it will be difficult or have bad results; dispute, block, restrain
words.translation: 阻止，使不敢，吓住；制止，阻止；使打消念头

examples.en: The company’s financial difficulties have deterred potential investors.
examples.zh: 该公司的财务困境令潜在的投资者望而却步。

words.definition: a liquid or powder used for washing clothes, dishes etc; cleaner, cleaning media
words.translation: 去垢剂，清洁剂；清洁剂；[化工]去垢剂

examples.en: ...a brand of detergent.
examples.zh: …一种品牌的清洁剂。

words.definition: to become worse; go ill, change for the worse; go ill, exasperate
words.translation: 恶化，败坏；恶化，变坏；恶化

examples.en: Ethel’s health has deteriorated.
examples.zh: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

examples.en: America’s deteriorating economy
examples.zh: 美国日渐恶化的经济

words.definition: the quality of trying to do something even when it is difficult; decision, resolution, push, backbone
words.translation: 决心；决定；确定；果断

examples.en: his dogged determination (= very strong determination ) to succeed
examples.zh: 他想要成功的坚定决心

words.definition: to hate something or someone very much; hate, turn away from
words.translation: 痛恨, 憎恶"；厌恶；憎恨

examples.en: The two men detested each other.
examples.zh: 两个男人互相厌恶。

words.definition: harm or damage; harm, damage, lesion
words.translation: 损害，损伤；损害；伤害；损害物

examples.en: Work hard to succeed but not to the detriment of others.
examples.zh: 在不损害他人利益的前提下为成功艰苦奋斗。

examples.en: A “do what I say, not what I do” world economy will fracture, to the detriment of all.
examples.zh: 在一个“依我所言，勿仿我行”的世界里，世界经济将割裂分化，伤害所有的国家。

words.definition: causing harm or damage; harmful, adverse, against, evil, disadvantageous
words.translation: 有害的，不利的；不利的；有害的

examples.en: the detrimental effect of pollution on the environment
examples.zh: 污染对环境的不利影响

words.definition: a particular type of character which makes someone likely to behave or react in a certain way; tendency, liability, trend, preference, deployment
words.translation: 性情，气质；布置；配置；处置；[心理]性情；[军]部署；倾向

examples.en: the disposition of assets on death
examples.zh: 身后财产的处置

words.definition: a serious argument or disagreement; discuss, debate, argue, stem, block; debate, argue with; argument, debate, brush, controversy
words.translation: 争论，争执，质疑；辩论；怀疑；阻止；抗拒；争论；争吵

examples.en: It is beyond dispute that advances in medicine have enabled people to live longer.
examples.zh: 医学的发展使人们更加长寿，这是无可置疑的。

words.definition: to ignore something or treat it as unimportant; ignore, neglect; inobservancy, negligence
words.translation: 不理，漠视；忽视；不理；漠视；不顾；不尊重

examples.en: He ordered the jury to disregard the witness’s last statement.
examples.zh: 他指示陪审团忽略证人的最后一句话。

examples.en: Mark totally disregarded my advice.
examples.zh: 马克完全不听我的建议。

words.definition: destroy, tear, undermine, founder; divided, scattered
words.translation: 使分裂，瓦解；破坏；使瓦解；使分裂；使中断；使陷于混乱；分裂的，中断的；分散的

examples.en: Traffic was disrupted by a hoax bomb.
examples.zh: 有人虚报有炸弹，造成了交通混乱。

words.definition: a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree; thesis, tractate
words.translation: (博士学位)论文，学术演讲，专题论文；论文，专题；学术演讲

examples.en: He is currently writing a dissertation on the Somali civil war.
examples.zh: 他正在写一篇关于索马里内战的论文。

words.definition: to gradually become less or weaker before disappearing completely, or to make something do this; lose, spend; to break up, sow one's wild oats
words.translation: 消散，消失；浪费，挥霍；浪费；使…消散；驱散；放荡

examples.en: As he thought it over, his anger gradually dissipated.
examples.zh: 他想明白后，怒气就渐渐消了。

examples.en: Little by little, the smoke was dissipated by the breeze.
examples.zh: 在微风的吹拂下烟雾渐渐地消散了。

words.definition: if a solid dissolves, or if you dissolve it, it mixes with a liquid and becomes part of it; hemolyze, haemolyze; melt, disappear
words.translation: 使液化，融化；使解散；使溶解；使分解；使液化；溶解；解散；消失

examples.en: Stir until the sugar dissolves.
examples.zh: 一直搅拌到糖溶解掉。

words.definition: to swell or make something swell because of pressure from inside; fill, swell with
words.translation: (使)扩张；膨胀；扩张

examples.en: Through this incision, the abdominal cavity is distended with carbon dioxide gas.
examples.zh: 通过此切口，二氧化碳气体把胸腔充得肿胀起来。

words.definition: If a liquid such as whisky or water is distilled, it is heated until it changes into steam or vapour and then cooled until it becomes liquid again. This is usually done in order to make it pure.; still, try out; still, fine-still
words.translation: 蒸馏；提炼；渗出；提取…的精华；使渗出

examples.en: The whisky had been distilled in 1926 and sat quietly maturing until 1987.
examples.zh: 这瓶威士忌是1926年被蒸馏的，存放至1987年酿造成熟。

words.definition: clearly different or belonging to a different type; obvious, visible, unique, evident, individual
words.translation: 不同的，清楚的，独特的；明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的

examples.en: two entirely distinct languages
examples.zh: 两种完全不同的语言

words.definition: a clear difference or separation between two similar things; quality, identity, character, tang, discrimination
words.translation: 差别，区分；卓著，荣誉；区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章

examples.en: Eliot’s distinction as a poet
examples.zh: 艾略特作为诗人的杰出才能

words.definition: to recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people; tell apart, differentiate; differentiate, tell from
words.translation: 区别，识别；使显赫；区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出；区别，区分

examples.en: Could he distinguish right from wrong?
examples.zh: 他能辨别是非吗？

words.definition: to report something in a way that is not completely true or correct; contort, misinterpret; become deformed, to morph
words.translation: 歪曲，弄歪，曲解；扭曲；使失真；曲解；变形

examples.en: His account was badly distorted by the press.
examples.zh: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。

words.definition: to take someone’s attention away from something by making them look at or listen to something else; shift, divert from
words.translation: 分散(注意力等)；转移；分心

examples.en: Try not to distract the other students.
examples.zh: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

words.definition: a pleasant activity; entertainment, occupation, recreation, relaxation
words.translation: 消遣，娱乐，精神涣散；注意力分散；消遣；心烦意乱

words.definition: a feeling of extreme unhappiness; poverty, disaster, evil, want, grief; aggrieve
words.translation: 悲痛，忧伤；贫苦；危难；危难，不幸；贫困；悲痛；使悲痛；使贫困

examples.en: Luke’s behaviour caused his parents great distress.
examples.zh: 卢克的行为使他的父母深感忧虑。

words.definition: to share things among a group of people, especially in a planned way; portion, part, spread
words.translation: 分发，分配，散布；分配；散布；分开；把…分类

examples.en: a man distributing leaflets to passers-by
examples.zh: 一个向路人派发传单的男子

words.definition: to interrupt someone so that they cannot continue what they are doing; let, violate; intrude upon, hinder from
words.translation: 打扰，扰乱；打扰；妨碍；使不安；弄乱；使恼怒

examples.en: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
examples.zh: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

examples.en: The thieves fled when they were disturbed by a neighbour.
examples.zh: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

examples.en: (= a sign you put on a door so that people will not interrupt you ) .
examples.zh: 请勿打扰。

words.definition: a situation in which people behave violently in public; interference, care, obstacle, disorder, worries
words.translation: 打扰，骚动；[通信][电子]干扰；骚乱；忧虑

examples.en: There were disturbances in the crowd as fans left the stadium.
examples.zh: 球迷离开体育场时，人群中发生了骚乱。

examples.en: army training on controlling civil disturbance
examples.zh: 控制平民骚乱的军事训练

words.definition: a long narrow hole dug at the side of a field, road etc to hold or remove unwanted water; to stop having something because you no longer want it; reject, slough off; furrow; conduit, sike
words.translation: 排水沟，沟渠；附入沟中，抛弃；在…上掘沟；把…开入沟里；丢弃；开沟；掘沟；沟渠；壕沟

examples.en: Both vehicles ended up in a ditch.
examples.zh: 两辆车都掉进了沟里。

words.definition: very different from each other; different, unlike, varying, another, dissimilar
words.translation: 多种多样的；不同的；变化多的

examples.en: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
examples.zh: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

words.definition: a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it; entertainment, transfer, occupation, recreation, metastasis
words.translation: 转向；水遣；改道；转移；消遣；分散注意力

examples.en: A slight diversion in the road is causing major headaches for businesses along El Camino Real.
examples.zh: 马路上的一小段绕行道让国王大道沿街的商家十分头疼。

words.definition: to change the direction in which something travels; shift, distract from; transfer, metastasize
words.translation: 转向；转移；使…欢娱；使…转向

examples.en: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
examples.zh: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

words.definition: something that is edible can be eaten; touchable; diet, eating
words.translation: 可以食用的；可食用的；食品；食物

examples.en: These berries are edible, but those are poisonous.
examples.zh: 这些浆果可以吃，但那些有毒。

words.definition: to prepare a book, piece of film etc for printing or broadcasting by removing mistakes or parts that are not acceptable; copy-edit, redact
words.translation: 编辑，剪辑；[计]编辑；校订

examples.en: The newspaper edits letters before printing them.
examples.zh: 这家报社刊登读者来信前先作校订。

words.definition: the form that a book, newspaper, magazine etc is produced in; version
words.translation: 版本，版次；[图情]版本

examples.en: a paperback edition
examples.zh: 平装本

examples.en: the US edition of Marie Claire magazine
examples.zh: 《嘉人》杂志的美国版

words.definition: a piece of writing in a newspaper that gives the editor’s opinion about something, rather than reporting facts; relating to the preparation of a newspaper, book, television programme etc for printing or broadcasting; compilatory
words.translation: 社论；编辑的，编者的；编辑的；社论的

examples.en: In an editorial, The New York Times suggests the victory could turn nasty.
examples.zh: 在一篇社论中，《纽约时报》认为该胜利会转成恶梦。

words.definition: if someone or something is efficient, they work well without wasting time, money, or energy; able, competent
words.translation: 能胜任的，效率高的；有效率的；有能力的；生效的

examples.en: a very efficient secretary
examples.zh: 效率高的秘书

examples.en: an efficient use of land
examples.zh: 土地的有效使用

examples.en: Lighting is now more energy efficient.
examples.zh: 如今的照明设备更加节能。

words.definition: the opinion that you have about yourself; me, self
words.translation: 自我，自己，个人思考和感觉能力；[心理]自我；自负；自我意识

examples.en: That promotion really boosted her ego (= made her feel better about herself ).
examples.zh: 那次晋升确实增强了她的自信心。

examples.en: I need someone to massage my bruised ego (= when you feel less confident than before ).
examples.zh: 我需要有人来安抚我受挫的自信心。

examples.en: a fragile ego
examples.zh: 脆弱的自尊心

words.definition: to make someone leave a place or building by using force; to spray, spray on
words.translation: 驱逐，排出；喷射；驱逐，逐出

examples.en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters.
examples.zh: 官员们用护卫犬驱走抗议者。

words.definition: having a lot of small parts or details put together in a complicated way; to give more details or new information about something; detailed, full; tailor-make; thicken
words.translation: 复杂的；详尽的；做详细说明；精心制作的；煞费苦心的；精心制作；详细阐述；从简单成分合成（复杂有机物）；详细描述；变复杂

examples.en: pure silks embroidered with elaborate patterns
examples.zh: 绣有精美图案的真丝衣服

words.definition: if a particular period of time elapses, it passes; ebb away; passing, effluxion
words.translation: (时间)流逝；消逝；时间过去；流逝；时间的过去

examples.en: Several months elapsed before his case was brought to trial.
examples.zh: 过了几个月他的案子才开审。

examples.en: The assignment must be completed within an overall elapsed time of one week.
examples.zh: 这项任务总的时限为一周，必须按时完成。

words.definition: enhance, boost, jack, mount, gain
words.translation: 增加；放长；补充

words.definition: a material that is elastic can stretch and then go back to its usual length or size; flexible, stretchy; band, rubberband
words.translation: 弹性的，有伸缩性的；橡皮圈；[力]有弹性的；灵活的；易伸缩的；松紧带

examples.en: the horny elastic pad in a horse’s hoof
examples.zh: 马蹄上粗硬而有弹性的肉掌

words.definition: extremely happy and excited, especially because of something that has happened or is going to happen; high-blown, rapturous
words.translation: 欢欣鼓舞的；兴高采烈的；得意洋洋的

examples.en: He felt elated and mildly drunk.
examples.zh: 他感到欢欣鼓舞，而且喝得有点醉了。

words.definition: the joint where your arm bends; to push someone with your elbows, especially in order to move past them; rail, rider; thrust, push against
words.translation: 肘；衣服肘部；用肘推、挤；肘部；弯头；扶手；推挤；用手肘推开

examples.en: He slipped and fell, badly bruising an elbow.
examples.zh: 他滑倒了，严重挫伤了一只胳膊肘。

words.definition: people who are old; oldish
words.translation: 年纪相当大的；上了年纪的；过了中年的；稍老的

examples.en: a retirement village for the elderly
examples.zh: 供老人退休后居住的村子

words.definition: relating to electricity
words.translation: 电的，电气科学的

examples.en: The fire was caused by an electrical fault.
examples.zh: 大火是电力故障引起的。

examples.en: an electrical engineer
examples.zh: 电力[电气]工程师

words.definition: someone whose job is to connect or repair electrical wires or equipment; wireman, electrochemical engineering
words.translation: 电工，电学家；电工；电气技师

examples.en: I've heard an electrician got hurt when he hiked.
examples.zh: 我听说有个电工在高空检修电线时摔伤了。

words.definition: electronic equipment, such as computers and televisions, uses electricity that has passed through computer chips, transistors etc
words.translation: 电子的，用电子操纵的

examples.en: electronic games
examples.zh: 电子游戏

examples.en: an electronic organizer (= a small piece of electronic equipment that you can use to record addresses, phone numbers etc )
examples.zh: 电子记事本

words.definition: the study or industry of making equipment, such as computers and televisions, that work electronically; electronic industry
words.translation: 电子学(单数)；[电子]电子学；电子工业

examples.en: an electronics engineer
examples.zh: 电子工程师

words.definition: beautiful, attractive, or graceful; graceful, exquisite
words.translation: 优美的，雅致的；高雅的，优雅的；讲究的

examples.en: a tall, elegant young woman
examples.zh: 身材高挑、举止优雅的年轻女子

examples.en: You can dine in elegant surroundings.
examples.zh: 你可以在雅致的环境中进餐。

words.definition: simple or basic; basic, fundamental, essential, primary, first
words.translation: 基本的，初级的；基本的；初级的；[化学]元素的

examples.en: the elementary principles of justice and democracy
examples.zh: 正义和民主的基本信条

examples.en: You’ve made a very elementary mistake.
examples.zh: 你犯了一个非常基本的错误。

words.definition: to lift someone or something to a higher position; promote, upgrade, prefer
words.translation: 升高，抬起，提高；提升；举起；振奋情绪等；提升…的职位

examples.en: Gradually elevate the patient into anupright position.
examples.zh: 把病人慢慢托到直立的位置。

words.definition: existing or popular for only a short time; brief, little, transient, passing
words.translation: 短暂的；朝生暮死的

examples.en: Fashion is by nature ephemeral.
examples.zh: 从本质上说，时尚不过是一时的潮流。

words.definition: popular, fashionable, going, ruling, pop; infection, infectious disease
words.translation: (疾病)流行性的，传染的；[医]流行的；传染性的；传染病；流行病；风尚等的流行

words.definition: a television or radio programme that is one of a series of programmes in which the same story is continued each week; incident, intermezzo
words.translation: 一系列事件中的一个事件；插曲；一段情节；插话；有趣的事件

examples.en: Watch next week’s thrilling episode!
examples.zh: 请收看下周精彩的一集！

words.definition: a period of history; new age, New-Era
words.translation: 新纪元，新时代；[地质]世；新纪元；新时代；时间上的一点

examples.en: the Victorian epoch
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代

examples.en: The king’s death marked the end of an epoch.
examples.zh: 这位国王的去世标志着一个时代的结束。

examples.en: the beginning of a new epoch
examples.zh: 新纪元的开始
