examples.zh: 火车频频驶过。

examples.en: She was a frequent visitor to the house.
examples.zh: 她是家里的常客。

words.definition: when someone is a member of a club, group, or organization; qualification, capacity
words.translation: 会员身份；全体会员；资格；成员资格；会员身分

examples.en: You should carry your membership card with you at all times.
examples.zh: 你应该随身携带会员卡。

examples.en: Membership fees are being increased this year.
examples.zh: 会费今年提高了。

words.definition: relating to the Earth’s atmosphere; freeair, meteoric
words.translation: 大气的， 空气的；大气层的；大气所引起的；[地物]大气的，大气层的

examples.en: atmospheric pressure
examples.zh: 大气压力

words.definition: to try very hard; strain every nerve, attempt at
words.translation: 努力， 尽力；尝试；竭力；企图

examples.en: an outstanding example of human endeavor
examples.zh: 人类努力进取的突出例证

words.definition: to cook something in steam; the hot mist that water produces when it is boiled; shed; energy, vigor, vapor
words.translation: 发出蒸汽；行驶；用蒸汽开动；汽，汽雾；蒸，散发；用蒸汽处理；蒸汽；精力

examples.en: Steam the vegetables lightly.
examples.zh: 把蔬菜稍蒸一下。

examples.en: steamed broccoli
examples.zh: 蒸西蓝花

words.definition: a way of hiding something, especially soldiers and military equipment, by using paint, leaves etc to make it look like the things around it; blind, mask; wrap up, mask
words.translation: 掩饰， 伪装；[军]伪装，掩饰

examples.en: soldiers learning camouflage technique
examples.zh: 在学习伪装技术的士兵

examples.en: the camouflage netting over the tanks
examples.zh: 坦克上的伪装网

words.definition: if something enslaves you, it completely controls your life and your actions; chain, bound, master
words.translation: 奴役， 征服， 使受控制；束缚；征服；使某人成为奴隶

examples.en: She seemed enslaved by hatred.
examples.zh: 她似乎被仇恨所左右。

words.definition: The centennial of an event such as someone's birth is the 100th anniversary of that event
words.translation: 一百年的；百年纪念

examples.en: The centennial Olympics was in Atlanta, Georgia.
examples.zh: 奥运会百年庆典在乔治亚州的亚特兰大举行。

words.definition: to do something for someone, or give them something, in return for helping you; return, make the payments; get back on, get even with
words.translation: 归还；报答；偿还；报复；回报；付还

examples.en: I’d like to buy them something to repay all their kindness.
examples.zh: 我想给他们买点东西来报答他们的好意。

words.definition: an amount of something that can be counted or measured; lots of, wealth, ocean, volume, sea
words.translation: 数量， 数目；量；众多， 大宗；量，数量；大量；总量

examples.en: Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
examples.zh: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

words.definition: at the present time; commonly, normally, generally
words.translation: 当前， 现时， 目前；当前；一般地

examples.en: the products that are currently available
examples.zh: 目前供应的产品

examples.en: He is currently working on his first novel.
examples.zh: 他目前正在创作他的第一本小说。

words.definition: arranged or happening one after the other in the correct order; a story that is broadcast or printed in several separate parts on television, in a magazine etc; continuing, straight, endless, running, successive; TV series, periodical
words.translation: 连续的；顺序排列的；连续剧；连载的；[会计]分期偿还的；电视连续剧；[图情]期刊；连载小说

examples.en: Keep the questions in the same serial order .
examples.zh: 让这些问题保持原来的顺序。

words.definition: unclear because someone does not give enough detailed information or does not say exactly what they mean; fuzzy, dark, uncertain
words.translation: 模糊的；含糊的；不明确的；暧昧的

examples.en: The governor gave only a vague outline of his tax plan.
examples.zh: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

words.definition: something that is episodic happens from time to time and then stops for a while, rather than happening all the time
words.translation: 偶然发生的， 不定期的；由许多片段组成的， 松散的

examples.en: his episodic involvement in politics
examples.zh: 他对政治的偶尔参与

words.definition: the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake
words.translation: 准确， 精确

examples.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
examples.zh: 他传球准确无误。

words.definition: an atom which has been given a positive or negative force by adding or taking away an  electron
words.translation: 离子

examples.en: Both of these particles can produce ion pairs .
examples.zh: 这两种粒子都能产生离子对。

examples.en: The ion channel was the missing circuit element I was looking for, and it already existed in nature.
examples.zh: 这种离子通道是我正在寻找的缺失的电路元件，而且它的确在自然界中存在。

words.definition: Geological means relating to geology
words.translation: 地质的， 地质学的

examples.en: With geological maps, books, and atlases you can find out all the proven sites of precious minerals.
examples.zh: 有了地质地图、书籍和地图册，你就可以找到所有已探明的珍贵矿藏的位置。

words.definition: to repeat exactly what someone else has said or written; a sentence or phrase from a book, speech etc which you repeat in a speech or piece of writing because it is interesting or amusing; make offers, price quotation; reference, make offers; citing, citation
words.translation: 引用， 引述， 引证；提出， 提供；报价；引文，引语；估价，报价；引述；举证；引用；引证

examples.en: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
examples.zh: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

examples.en: A military spokesman was quoted as saying that the border area is now safe.
examples.zh: 报道引述军方一位发言人的话，说边境地区现在很安全。

words.definition: to obtain a degree, especially a first degree, from a college or university; someone who has completed a university degree, especially a first degree; shadow, to finish school; postgraduate, advanced student; school-leaving
words.translation: 毕业；获得学位；毕业生；研究生['grædʒʊeɪt]；渐变；研究生；毕业的；研究生的

examples.en: When the boys graduated from high school, Ann moved to a small town in Vermont.
examples.zh: 男孩们中学毕业后安迁到了佛蒙特州的一座小镇。

words.definition: not good enough or not acceptable; ungratified
words.translation: 不能令人满意的；不令人满意的；不满足的；不符合要求的

examples.en: an unsatisfactory situation
examples.zh: 让人不满意的状况

words.definition: extremely good or of very high quality; remarkable, wonderful, famous, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 极好的；杰出的；卓越的

examples.en: an excellent suggestion
examples.zh: 极好的建议

examples.en: His car is in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 他的汽车状况极佳。

examples.en: Second-hand computers can be excellent value.
examples.zh: 二手计算机买得好会非常合算。

words.definition: more than a little, but much less than very; relatively, simply, comparatively, equally, reasonably
words.translation: 相当地；公平地；简直， 完全地；简直

examples.en: The house had a fairly large garden.
examples.zh: 那幢房子有个不小的花园。

examples.en: She speaks English fairly well.
examples.zh: 她英语讲得还不错。

examples.en: The instructions seem fairly straightforward.
examples.zh: 操作指南似乎很简明。

words.definition: belonging or relating to a particular society and its way of life; nonmaterial
words.translation: 文化的， 人文的；文化的；教养的

examples.en: the very real historical and cultural differences between our two societies
examples.zh: 我们两个社会之间非常现实的历史和文化差异

examples.en: the desire to maintain a distinct cultural identity
examples.zh: 保持独特的文化特征的愿望

examples.en: It is important to look at the political and cultural context in which the novel was written.

examples.zh: 在治疗前的许多年里，克莱尔都有自杀倾向。

words.definition: nerves are parts inside your body which look like threads and carry messages between the brain and other parts of the body; courage, heart; take courage, get up the courage
words.translation: 神经；勇敢；[解剖]神经；勇气；[植]叶脉；鼓起勇气

examples.en: a condition which affects the nerves in the back
examples.zh: 影响背部神经的疾病

words.definition: to take an examination again, because you failed it or did not do well enough; reexamine; make-up examination, supplementary examination
words.translation: 重修， 补考；（英）重考；补考；重考

examples.en: Those who fail can resit the exam in 60 days.
examples.zh: 考试不及格的人可以在60天后重考。

words.definition: to lie over something
words.translation: 躺在…上面；置于…上面

examples.en: Clay overlies chalk in the southern mountains.
examples.zh: 在南部山脉，黏土层覆在白垩层之上。

words.definition: the act or process of controlling or reducing something; restriction, threshold, qualification, terminal
words.translation: 限制；局限；限度；极限；追诉时效；有效期限

examples.en: a nuclear limitation treaty
examples.zh: 核限制条约

words.definition: relating to the weather in a particular area
words.translation: 气候的

examples.en: climatic conditions
examples.zh: 气候情况

words.definition: able to produce something; productive, reproductive
words.translation: 生殖的， 生产的；有生产能力的；生殖的；生产的；有生殖力的；有生产力的

examples.en: the generative power of the life force
examples.zh: 生命力的生成能力

words.definition: a slow-moving land animal that can pull its head and legs into the hard round shell that covers its body; turtle, chelonian
words.translation: 龟， 陆龟；行动迟缓的人；[脊椎]龟，乌龟（等于testudo）；迟缓的人

words.definition: someone whose job involves managing the work of a company or organization; supervisor, conductor
words.translation: 管理者， 管理人员；行政人员；[管理]管理人；行政官

examples.en: On Friday the company's administrators sought permission from a Melbourne court to keep operating.
examples.zh: 在星期五，该公司的管理人员们从一家墨尔本法院取得了继续经营的许可。

words.definition: a room or building that is stuffy does not have enough fresh air in it; sweltering, sultry
words.translation: 不透气的， 不新鲜的， 不通风的；乏味的；闷热的；古板的；不通气的

examples.en: It’s getting stuffy in here – do you mind if I open the window?
examples.zh: 这里越来越闷了，我开开窗行吗？

words.definition: to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something; a product that has been rejected because there is something wrong with it; refuse, negative; inferior, degraded product
words.translation: 拒绝['riːdʒ3kt]；被拒货品， 不合格品；拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃；被弃之物或人；次品

examples.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
examples.zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

examples.en: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
examples.zh: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

examples.en: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
examples.zh: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

words.definition: a piece of work that is given to someone as part of their job; allocation, distribution, role, mission, task
words.translation: 任务， 工作；分配；任务；作业；功课

examples.en: a history assignment
examples.zh: 历史作业

words.definition: an experienced person who advises and helps a less experienced person; guider, instructor
words.translation: 导师；顾问， 指导者；指导者，良师益友

examples.en: Leon Sullivan was my mentor and my friend.
examples.zh: 利昂·沙利文既是我的导师，也是我的朋友。

words.definition: very interesting, exciting, and surprising; immense, lurid
words.translation: 轰动性的， 引起哗然的；耸人听闻的；极好的；绝妙的；轰动的；非常好的；使人感动的

examples.en: a sensational discovery
examples.zh: 引起轰动的发现

examples.en: The show was a sensational success.
examples.zh: 这次演出取得了轰动性的成功。

examples.en: a sensational 6-0 victory
examples.zh: 轰动性的6比0大胜

words.definition: a long light boat that is pointed at both ends and which you move along using a  paddle; pirogue, dugout
words.translation: 独木舟；轻舟

examples.en: As the bow neared shore, the canoe suddenly touched bottom .
examples.zh: 船头靠近岸边的时候，独木舟突然搁浅了。

examples.en: A stabilizer for a canoe; spars attach to a shaped log or pontoon parallel to the hull.
examples.zh: 一种轻舟的稳定器；定在成型圆木的桅杆或与船体平行的浮筒。

examples.en: Get out on the water - Rent a sailboat, rowboat, paddleboat, kayak, or canoe. Grab a pole and go fishing or don your swimsuit and jump in.
examples.zh: 水上约会活动——你可以租一艘帆船，皮划艇，划艇，皮艇，或独木舟。有了船，你可以划船和钓鱼，或是穿上泳衣潜水去。

words.definition: a British gold coin or unit of money used in the past, worth one pound and one  shilling  (£1.05). Prices are sometimes still given in guineas when buying or selling  racehorses .
words.translation: 几尼

words.definition: to experience physical or mental pain; stomach, stand, experience, tough, abide; stomach, come under
words.translation: 遭受， 忍受；忍耐；容许；患病；受损失；遭受；忍受；经历；遭受，忍受；受痛苦；经验；受损害

examples.en: At least he died suddenly and didn’t suffer.
examples.zh: 至少他死得突然，没有遭罪。

examples.en: She’s suffering a lot of pain.
examples.zh: 她遭受着巨大的痛苦。

words.definition: a place where a particular kind of food or drink is served; to prevent people from going somewhere by placing something in their way; rod, staff, obstacle, dam, let; inhibit, forbid
words.translation: 酒吧；栅栏；棒，条状物；闩；阻拦；[金融]条，棒；[建]酒吧；障碍；禁止

examples.en: ...Devil's Herd, the city's most popular country and western bar.
examples.zh: …“魔鬼群”，全城最受欢迎的西部乡村酒吧。

words.definition: a part of the sea that is partly enclosed by a curve in the land; gulf, bight; rant and rave
words.translation: 海湾；[地理]海湾；狗吠声；吠叫；大声叫嚷

examples.en: a house with a view across the bay
examples.zh: 能看到海湾全景的一幢房子

examples.en: Montego Bay
examples.zh: 蒙特哥湾

words.definition: official documents, reports etc that are used to prove that something is true or correct
words.translation: 文件证据， 文献资料， 文件

examples.en: Applicants must provide supporting documentation .
examples.zh: 申请人必须提供证明文件。

words.definition: a form of a language that ordinary people use, especially one that is not the official language; native, patrial; provincialism, patois
words.translation: 本国语的；本国话；方言；土语；民间风格；本国的；地方的；用本地语写成的；本地话，方言；动植物的俗名

examples.en: In some churches, they speak Latin, but in others they use the vernacular.
examples.zh: 在一些教堂中，人们讲拉丁语，但在其他一些教堂中，人们使用本地话。

examples.en: The common speech of a people; the vernacular.
examples.zh: 本国语，不规范语一个民族普通的语言；地方话。

words.definition: made of plastic; mouldable, malleable; restricting, true-up
words.translation: 塑料的；[塑料][力]塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的；[塑料]塑料制品；整形；[力]可塑体

examples.en: a plastic spoon
examples.zh: 塑料汤匙

examples.en: plastic bags
examples.zh: 塑料袋

words.definition: when something does not happen or start when it should do; wait, hold over; hold over, stand over; raincheck, postponement
words.translation: 耽搁， 延迟， 延期， 迟滞；延期；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间

examples.en: There can be no excuse for any further delay .
examples.zh: 没有理由继续拖延。

words.definition: a large violent attack by an army; lay on, skite
words.translation: 猛攻， 猛袭；猛攻；突击

examples.en: The press launched another vicious onslaught on the president.
examples.zh: 新闻界对这位总统进行了新一轮的恶毒抨击。

words.definition: relating to substances, the study of substances, or processes involving changes in substances; a substance used in chemistry or produced by a chemical process; chymic
words.translation: 化学的；化学制品；[化工]化学的

examples.en: the chemical composition of bleach
examples.zh: 漂白剂的化学成分

examples.en: a chemical analysis of the soil
examples.zh: 对土壤的化学分析

words.definition: continuing only for a short time; brief, little, passing; visitor, migratory bird
words.translation: 短暂的，转瞬即逝的；在某地短暂停留或工作的人；短暂的；路过的；瞬变现象；过往旅客；候鸟

examples.en: transient fashions
examples.zh: 短暂的时尚

words.definition: depending on or necessary to each other; coadjutant
words.translation: 互相依赖的， 互助的；相互依赖的；互助的

examples.en: countries with interdependent economies
examples.zh: 经济上相互依赖的国家

words.definition: extremely or very much; quite, badly, too, extremely, far, highly
words.translation: 非常；很；极大地；很，大大地

examples.en: All offers of help will be greatly appreciated .
examples.zh: 如蒙帮助，感激不尽。

examples.en: The quality of health care varies greatly .
examples.zh: 医疗保健服务质量差别很大。

words.definition: when someone hesitates; vibration, swither
words.translation: 犹豫， 踌躇；犹豫

examples.en: After some hesitation one of them began to speak.
examples.zh: 犹豫了一会儿之后，他们中有一个人开口了。

words.definition: relating to the place in an area, country etc where something or someone is
words.translation: 地理学的；地理的

examples.en: their geographical proximity to Japan (= nearness to Japan )
examples.zh: 它们和日本相邻的地理位置

words.definition: a miscellaneous set of things or people includes many different things or people that do not seem to be connected with each other; various, jumbly
words.translation: 各种各样的；混杂的；[经]混杂的，各种各样的；多方面的，多才多艺的

examples.en: a miscellaneous assortment of books
examples.zh: 各种各样的书籍

examples.en: They receive a grant of £1,094 to cover the cost of miscellaneous expenses.
examples.zh: 他们获得1,094英镑的津贴用于支付各种开支。

words.definition: a duty to be in charge of someone or something, so that you make decisions and can be blamed if something bad happens
words.translation: 责任， 责任心；职责， 任务

examples.en: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
examples.zh: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

words.definition: the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities; marks, significant, indication
words.translation: 符号的使用；象征主义， 象征手法；象征，象征主义；符号论；记号

examples.en: religious symbolism
examples.zh: 宗教象征主义

words.definition: relating to the people who live in a country; folk, polite
words.translation: 国民的；民用的；政府的；公民的；民间的；文职的；有礼貌的；根据民法的

examples.en: They were married in a civil ceremony in May.
examples.zh: 他们在五月份举行了世俗婚礼。

words.definition: to show that a particular situation exists, or that something is likely to be true; forecast, index, image, shadow, figure
words.translation: 标示， 表示， 表明；象征；暗示， 示意；表明；指出；预示

examples.zh: 研究显示贫穷和犯罪有关联。

words.definition: if something such as a bag, box, or place contains something, that thing is inside it; involve, possess, regulate, manage, accept; restrain oneself, abstain
words.translation: 包含， 容纳， 装有；控制， 阻止， 遏制；包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）；含有；自制

examples.en: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
examples.zh: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

examples.en: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

words.definition: endanger, imperil
words.translation: 危害， 使受危困；危及（等于jeopardize）；使…受危险

words.definition: a small tower on a large building, especially a  castle; casemate, barbette
words.translation: 塔楼， 角楼；炮塔；角楼；小塔；攻城用仰冲车

examples.zh: 当角楼打开的时候，扔出手榴弹，一定要注意躲避射向你的子弹。

words.definition: a book that tells what has happened in someone’s life, written by someone else; file, record
words.translation: 传记；档案；个人简介

examples.en: ...recent biographies of Stalin.
examples.zh: …近年的斯大林传记。

words.definition: a small part or amount of something that is examined in order to find out something about the whole; to taste food or drink in order to see what it is like; essay, have a try; example, pattern
words.translation: 样品，样本；从…抽样， 采样；品尝；取样；尝试；抽样检查；样品；[图情]样本；例子

examples.zh: 他们取了血样做肝炎化验。

words.definition: an official mark put on your passport that gives you permission to temporarily enter or leave a foreign country; vise
words.translation: 签证

examples.en: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
examples.zh: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

words.definition: to happen or exist before something or someone, or to come before something else in a series; take over the lead, keep ahead
words.translation: 领先， 先于；领先，在…之前；优于，高于；领先，在前面

examples.en: a type of cloud that precedes rain
examples.zh: 下雨前出现的一种云

examples.en: Lunch will be preceded by a short speech from the chairman.
examples.zh: 午餐开始之前主席会发表一段简短的讲话。

words.definition: to make someone realize that something which they thought was true or good is not really true or good; undeceive; disenchantment, evanescence
words.translation: 使醒悟；使不再抱幻想；幻灭；醒悟

examples.en: I hate to disillusion you, but I don’t think she’s coming back.
examples.zh: 我真不愿意让你失望，但我想她是不会回来了。

words.definition: to risk money on the result of a race, game, competition, or other future event; an agreement to risk money on the result of a race, game etc or on something happening, or the money that you risk; stake; make sure, be sure of; lay, stake
words.translation: 赌，打赌；打赌， 赌注；打赌，赌注；被打赌的事物；打赌；敢断定，确信

examples.zh: 你想赌多少钱？

words.translation: 缺点， 不利；缺点；不利条件；损失

examples.en: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
examples.zh: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

words.definition: to say that you are annoyed, not satisfied, or unhappy about something or someone; whine about, beef; beef about, rail against
words.translation: 抱怨；投诉；发牢骚；诉说；控诉

examples.en: Residents are complaining because traffic in the area has increased.
examples.zh: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

examples.en: ‘You never ask my opinion about anything,’ Rod complained.
examples.zh: “你什么事都不问问我的看法。”罗德抱怨道。

examples.en: Employees complained bitterly about working conditions.
examples.zh: 雇员们对工作条件十分不满。

words.translation: 凶恶的老妇；老巫婆

examples.en: She was a mean old harridan.
examples.zh: 她是个刻薄的老泼妇。

words.definition: a sum of money that a person or organization owes; liability, loan, borrowing
words.translation: 债， 债务；债务；借款；罪过

examples.en: He had enough money to pay off his outstanding debts.
examples.zh: 他有足够的钱偿还亏欠的债务。

examples.en: students who run up huge debts
examples.zh: 欠下巨额债务的学生

words.definition: anyway, at all events; whereas, while, nevertheless, but, yet
words.translation: 不管用什么方法，；无论如何；不管怎样；然而；可是

examples.zh: 你可以按自己的意思去做。

words.definition: treating people or animals in a way that is not cruel and causes them as little suffering as possible; magnificent, noble
words.translation: 善良的， 人道的， 仁慈的， 慈悲的；促进文明或教化的， 人文的；仁慈的，人道的；高尚的

examples.zh: 提倡人道地对待罪犯的运动

examples.en: a better, more humane world
examples.zh: 更美好、更人道的社会

words.definition: having the qualities or ability needed to do something; able, competent
words.translation: 有能力的；能够的；能干的，能胜任的；有才华的

examples.zh: 我认为他没有能力杀人。

examples.en: The company isn’t capable of handling an order that large.
examples.zh: 那家公司没有能力应付那么大的订单。

examples.en: I’m perfectly capable of looking after myself, thank you!
examples.zh: 我完全能够自己照顾自己，多谢了！

words.definition: causing problems and preventing something from continuing in its usual way; destructive, devastative
words.translation: 制造混乱的；分裂性的；破坏性的；破坏的

examples.en: Mike’s parents thought I was a disruptive influence (= a person who causes disruption ) .
examples.zh: 迈克的父母认为我是个捣蛋分子。

examples.en: ways to handle disruptive pupils
examples.zh: 对付捣乱学生的办法

words.definition: when you supervise someone or something; governance, administration, management, surveillance, regulation
words.translation: 监督， 管理；指导；监督，[管理]管理

examples.en: The baby needs constant supervision.
examples.zh: 宝宝时刻都要有人照看。

words.definition: to drink something slowly, taking very small mouthfuls; silp; sup; tiff
words.translation: 小口地喝；吸吮；抿；小口喝；单列直插式组件；啜饮；啜

examples.en: She was sitting at the table sipping her coffee.
examples.zh: 她坐在桌边呷着咖啡。

words.definition: a bad quality or feature of something; defect, error, deficiency, disadvantage, vice
words.translation: 过失；缺点， 短处；缺点，短处

examples.en: Demerits were given to students for late attendance at prayers.
examples.zh: 祷告会上迟到的学生被记过了。

words.definition: employment, usage, use, exploitation
words.translation: 利用；使用（等于utilization）

examples.en: The two sides have also pledged to enhance cooperation in tourism, and the protection and utilisation of cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 双方承诺在旅游、文化遗产保护和利用等领域加强交流合作。

examples.en: But this requires greater domestic competition, reallocation of resources to more productive activity and better utilisation of labour.
examples.zh: 但这要求加强国内竞争，将资源重新配置到生产率更高的经济活动，并更好地利用劳动力。

words.definition: brilliant light or colour is very bright and strong; excellent, prominent, outstanding, splendid, gorgeous
words.translation: 光辉灿烂的；卓越的， 有才华的；灿烂的，闪耀的；杰出的；有才气的

examples.en: She closed her eyes against the brilliant light .
examples.zh: 强烈的光线下，她闭起了眼睛。

examples.en: We sat outside in the brilliant sunshine .
examples.zh: 我们坐在外面，沐浴在灿烂的阳光下。

examples.en: She was dressed in brilliant white.
examples.zh: 她穿着一身耀眼的白色。

words.definition: not easily upset, annoyed, or worried; accommodating
words.translation: 脾气随和的， 心平气和的；随便的；随和的，容易相处的

examples.en: Her easy-going nature made her popular.
examples.zh: 她生性随和，人缘很好。

words.definition: controlled, liable; chain, jump, dance; region, extent, scope, spectrum, territory, range, area; to limit, be confined to
words.translation: 负有义务的；一定的， 必然的；有义务的；受约束的；装有封面的；束缚；使跳跃；范围；跳跃；限制；弹起

words.definition: if animals breed, they  mate  in order to have babies; a type of animal that is kept as a pet or on a farm; increase, result; attract, keep, school, cause, mother; category, variety, manner, nature, description

examples.zh: 鹰在一年中较凉爽的季节交配繁殖。

words.definition: to refuse to do what someone with authority tells you to do, or refuse to obey a rule or law; be in breach of, run counter to
words.translation: 不服从， 违抗；违反；不服从

examples.zh: 你违抗我的命令。

words.definition: an elusive result is difficult to achieve; complicated, abstruse
words.translation: 难懂的， 难捉摸的；易忘的；难懂的；逃避的；难捉摸的

examples.zh: 她在这个国家享有稳固的声誉，但却一直难以在国际上取得更大的成功。

words.definition: an offer to pay a particular price for something, especially at an  auction; tell, tender for; tender for; offer
words.translation: 出价；投标；[贸易]出价；表示；吩咐；[贸易]投标；叫牌；努力争取

examples.en: the person who places the highest bid
examples.zh: 出价最高的人

examples.en: We’ve made a bid of nearly £400 million for the company.
examples.zh: 我们出价近四亿英镑收购那家公司。

examples.en: A takeover bid for the airline was launched today.
examples.zh: 今天有人出价收购该航空公司。

words.definition: including all the necessary facts, details, or problems that need to be dealt with; extensive, integrated, synthetic, widespread, general
words.translation: 全面的， 广泛的；综合的；包容的；广泛的；有理解力的

examples.en: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
examples.zh: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

examples.en: a comprehensive guide to British hotels and restaurants
examples.zh: 一本介绍英国酒店和餐厅的详尽指南

examples.en: The following guidelines do not aim to be totally comprehensive.
examples.zh: 以下指导原则并非想要面面俱到。

words.definition: to surprise someone very much; emmarvel, gast
words.translation: 使惊讶， 使吃惊；使惊讶

examples.en: Her reply astonished me.
examples.zh: 她的回答让我大吃一惊。

examples.en: It astonished him that she had changed so little.
examples.zh: 他很惊讶，她几乎没怎么变。

examples.en: What astonishes me most is his complete lack of fear.
examples.zh: 最令我吃惊的是，他什么都不怕。

words.definition: a long narrow passage on a train or between rooms in a building, with doors leading off it; hall, passage, gallery, verandah, slype
words.translation: 过道， 走廊；[建]走廊

examples.en: Go down here and the bathroom’s at the end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 沿着这儿走，浴室就在走廊的尽头。

words.definition: to choose something or someone by thinking carefully about which is the best, most suitable etc; a select group of people or things is a small special group that has been chosen carefully; pack, choose from; wonderful, excellent, famous, chosen, choice; choose from, pick on
words.translation: 选择，挑选；精选的， 优等的；挑选；选拔；精选的；挑选出来的；极好的

examples.en: a group of students selected at random
examples.zh: 随机挑选出来的一组学生

words.definition: very modern; senior, aged, high, old, ancient; rose, improved
words.translation: 先进的；高级的；晚期的；年老的；前进；增加；上涨（advance的过去式和过去分词形式）

examples.en: advanced weapon systems
examples.zh: 先进的武器系统

examples.en: advanced technology
examples.zh: 先进的技术

examples.en: high levels of unemployment in the advanced industrial societies
examples.zh: 发达工业社会中的高失业率

words.definition: a large container for storing things, such as goods in a shop or substances in a factory; container, vessel, chest, pocket
words.translation: 大箱子；仓；箱子，容器；二进制

examples.en: Put your rubbish in the bin.
examples.zh: 把你的垃圾放进箱子。

examples.en: But you know how it is with us human you take something good you dissect it scrutinise it time and again not believing your good fortune and finally cast it to the "no" bin.
examples.zh: 可是你知道的，对我们人类来说，你以为某件事物很好、你仔细分析它、细看它一次又一次，不相信你的好运，最后又把它丢到「不」的箱子里（不再理它），这真是很消极又愚蠢的。

words.definition: affecting or involving a machine; wooden, automatic, dead
words.translation: 机械的， 机械制造的；呆板的；习惯性的；体力的；[机]机械的；[力]力学的；无意识的；手工操作的

examples.en: The flight has been cancelled due to mechanical failure .
examples.zh: 因机械故障航班被取消了。

examples.en: The plane had to make an emergency landing because of mechanical problems.
examples.zh: 飞机因机械故障不得不紧急降落。

words.definition: to use a law, principle, or  theory  to support your views; attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
words.translation: 恳求， 祈求；援用， 援引；使用， 应用；调用；祈求；引起；恳求

examples.en: a painting that invokes images of the Rocky Mountains
examples.zh: 使人联想到落基山脉的画

words.definition: a small piece of something; ounce, tad; possess, contain, regulate, bottle, manage; tiddly, bite-sized; rather, lot
words.translation: 少许；小片；小块；[计]比特（二进位制信息单位）；少量；马嚼子；辅币；老一套；控制；很小的；微不足道的；有点儿；相当

examples.en: He’s taken the engine to bits .
examples.zh: 他把发动机拆开了。

words.definition: not doing anything, not working, or not moving; lazy, idle
words.translation: 不活动的；懒散的；不活跃的；怠惰的；闲置的

examples.en: The brain cells are inactive during sleep.
examples.zh: 在睡觉时脑细胞不活跃。

examples.en: Young people are becoming politically inactive.
examples.zh: 年轻人变得不热衷政治了。

words.definition: dirty and likely to cause disease; unhygienic, insanitary
words.translation: 不卫生的；有碍健康的

examples.en: unsanitary conditions
examples.zh: 不卫生的环境

words.definition: a piece of electronic equipment that allows information from one computer to be sent along telephone wires to another computer; MODEM Modulator And Demodulator, modulator-demodulator
words.translation: 调制解调器；调制解调器（等于modulator-demodulator）

examples.en: He sent his work to his publishers by modem.
examples.zh: 他通过调制解调器把作品发给他的出版商。

words.definition: to make something smaller or less in size, amount, or price; shorten, weaken; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 减少， 缩小；简化；减少；降低；使处于；把…分解；缩小；归纳为

examples.en: The governor announced a new plan to reduce crime.
examples.zh: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

examples.en: The helmet law should reduce injuries in motorcycle accidents.
examples.zh: 头盔法的实施应该能减少摩托车事故的受伤率。

examples.en: Small businesses will need to reduce costs in order to survive.
examples.zh: 小企业要想生存必须削减成本。

words.definition: if someone or something surfaces, they suddenly appear somewhere, especially after being gone or hidden for a long time; the top layer of an area of water or land; face, outside, garment; external, facial, shallow, superficial; Head Above Water; tabulate
words.translation: 浮出水面；浮现， 显露；在…上加表面；表面；外表，外观；表层；外观；表面的，肤浅的；使浮出水面；使成平面

examples.en: Last year Toole surfaced again in Cuba.
examples.zh: 去年图尔再次在古巴露面。

words.definition: violence, invasion, infringement
words.translation: 侵略；争斗；攻击；攻击性；侵犯；进取精神

words.definition: someone who owns shares in a company or business; stockholder, holder of stock
words.translation: 股票持有人；股东；[金融]股东

examples.en: Shareholders have been told to expect an even lower result next year.
examples.zh: 股东们被告知明年的业绩还会更差。

words.definition: full of traffic; blocked, crowded, jammed; jampacked
words.translation: 拥挤不堪的；充塞的；堵塞的，拥挤的；挤满；超负荷（congest的过去分词）

examples.en: congested airspace
examples.zh: 拥挤的空域

examples.en: London’s roads are heavily congested (= very congested ) .
examples.zh: 伦敦的马路非常拥挤。

words.definition: if a system, process, or service operates, or if you operate it, it works; run, act; attract, keep, produce, work, handle
words.translation: 运转；动手术；起作用；操作；经营；引起；对…开刀

examples.en: The whole tax system is now operating more efficiently.
examples.zh: 现在整个税收制度运作效率更高了。

examples.en: The new law doesn’t operate in our favour.
examples.zh: 这项新法规对我们不利。

examples.en: The car parks operate a pay-as-you-leave system.
examples.zh: 这些停车场按“离开时付费”的模式运作。

words.definition: a sign at the side of a road showing directions and distances; roadmap, street sign
words.translation: 在…设置路标；路标；指示牌

examples.en: The village isn’t very well signposted.
examples.zh: 这个村子在路标上指示得不是很清楚。

words.definition: to punish someone or treat them unfairly; catch up to, catch up with
words.translation: 惩罚， 处罚；判罚；使处于不利地位；处罚；处刑；使不利

examples.en: Women feel professionally penalized for taking time off to raise children.
examples.zh: 女性认为休假带孩子在职业上对自己不利。

words.definition: the state of being unable to pay your debts; failure, insolvency, improverishment
words.translation: 破产；彻底失败；[经]破产

examples.en: In 1999 it was revealed that he was close to bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 1999年他被披露几近破产。

examples.en: When inflation rises, so do bankruptcies.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀加剧，破产个案也会增加。

words.definition: something that is abhorrent is completely unacceptable because it seems morally wrong; sick, hateworthy
words.translation: 可恶的， 可恨的；可恶的；厌恶的；格格不入的

examples.en: Racial discrimination is abhorrent to my council and our staff.
examples.zh: 我的地方政府和全体工作人员与种族歧视水火不容。

words.definition: if someone is handicapped, a part of their body or their mind has been permanently injured or damaged. Some people think that this word is offensive.; disabled, spavined; disabled people
words.translation: 残废的， 有生理缺陷的；残废的；有生理缺陷的；残疾人；缺陷者

examples.en: a special school for mentally handicapped children
examples.zh: 弱智儿童特殊学校

words.definition: the space between two straight lines or surfaces that join each other, measured in degrees; fish, figure for; hao, jiao
words.translation: 移向；使成角度移动；从报道；角；角度；观点，立场；钓鱼；谋取；角度，[数]角

examples.en: a mirror angled to reflect light from a window
examples.zh: 为反射窗外的光线而斜放的一面镜子

words.definition: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has existed for a long time, or these beliefs, customs etc in general; convention, usage, heritage, tale, prescription
words.translation: 传统；惯例；惯例，传统；传说

examples.en: the traditions of South East Asia
examples.zh: 东南亚的传统

examples.en: the tradition that the eldest son inherits the property
examples.zh: 长子继承家产的传统

examples.en: By tradition, it’s the bride’s parents who pay for the wedding.
examples.zh: 根据传统习俗，婚礼的费用由新娘的父母承担。

words.definition: very important and needing to be dealt with immediately; emergency, instant
words.translation: 紧急的， 紧迫的；催促的， 急切的；紧急的；急迫的

examples.en: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
examples.zh: 他急需治疗。

examples.en: The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
examples.zh: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

examples.en: an urgent message
examples.zh: 一封急报

words.definition: relating to the eyes; visual, ocular; eye, oculus
words.translation: 眼的，视觉的；光学的；光学仪器；[光]光学的；[生理][眼科]视觉的；眼睛的；眼睛；镜片

examples.en: the optic nerve
examples.zh: 视神经

words.definition: If one type of person or thing predominates in a group, there is more of that type of person or thing in the group than of any other; rule, hold sway; advantage over, prevail over
words.translation: 统治， 支配；占优势；支配，主宰；在…中占优势；占主导（或支配）地位

examples.en: In older age groups women predominate because men tend to die younger.
examples.zh: 在年龄较大的人群中，女性占多数，因为男性的寿命倾向于短些。

words.definition: mellifluence, volubility
words.translation: 流利， 流畅；通顺；流畅，流利

words.definition: the analysis of biological data using mathematical and statistical methods; biostatistics
words.translation: 生物测定学；[生物]生物统计学；寿命统计

words.definition: to deliberately put or keep something or someone in a place where they cannot easily be seen or found; a place from which you can watch animals or birds without being seen by them; lock, pocket, conceal; bottle up, keep in; fell, jook
words.translation: 把…藏起来，隐藏；〔可观察鸟兽行动的〕隐匿处，埋伏处；隐藏；隐瞒；鞭打；躲藏；兽皮；躲藏处

examples.en: She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
examples.zh: 她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

words.definition: an irrevocable decision, action etc cannot be changed or stopped; remediless
words.translation: 无法取消的， 不能改变的；不可改变的；不能取消的；不能挽回的

examples.en: Think about the situation carefully before you take an irrevocable step.
examples.zh: 在你踏出不能回头的一步之前要三思。

words.definition: a fact or thing that someone finds out about, when it was not known about before; detection, occurrence, find
words.translation: 发现；发现，发觉；被发现的事物

examples.en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
examples.zh: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。

words.definition: a system in which people work a particular number of hours each week or month, but can change the times at which they start and finish each day
words.translation: 弹性工作制

examples.en: Telecommuting, flexitime and job sharing were the main types of flexibility cited in the study published in the Psychologist-Manager journal.
examples.zh: 该项在《心理学家与管理人》期刊上发表的研究报告提到，远程办公、弹性工时，以及分工合作是弹性工作制的几种主要形式。

words.definition: a wall built out into the sea to protect the shore from the force of the waves; digue
words.translation: 防浪堤；[水运]防浪堤

examples.zh: 他们以乱石基巩固防波堤。

examples.en: Back of the breakwater the dredger was working.
examples.zh: 在防波堤后面挖泥船正在工作。

examples.en: The actual breakwater itself will be built on a foundation of slag—a permeable byproduct of steel which will provide a habitat for aquatic wildlife in the lake.
examples.zh: 事实上，防浪堤本身是建在矿渣（具有渗透性的钢铁的副产物）上的，这能为水中的生物营造良好的生活环境。

words.translation: 减弱， 减少

words.definition: to put flour, sugar etc through a sieve or similar container in order to remove large pieces; dust, filter; detail survey
words.translation: 细查；筛；过滤；筛选；撒；详查；撒下；细究

examples.en: Police are sifting through the evidence.
examples.zh: 警方在筛查证据。

words.definition: to move information or programs from a computer network to a small computer
words.translation: 下载

examples.en: games that can be downloaded free from the Internet
examples.zh: 可以从因特网上免费下载的游戏

words.definition: a line that curves and rises around a central line; screw, spiral
words.translation: 螺旋， 螺旋结构；[数][建]螺旋，螺旋状物；[解剖]耳轮

words.definition: to be in or move into a position where your body is resting on your knees; drop to one's knees, go down on one's knees
words.translation: 跪；跪下，跪

examples.en: Tom knelt down and patted the dog.
examples.zh: 汤姆跪下来轻轻拍了拍那只狗。

words.definition: arriving at or coming to a place; incident, proliferative; coming, proceeds, receipt, earning
words.translation: 进来的；[计]引入的，入射的；增殖的；进来；来到；收入

examples.en: incoming flights
examples.zh: 进港航班

examples.en: Incoming calls were monitored.
examples.zh: 来电受到监听。

examples.en: the incoming tide
examples.zh: 涨潮

words.definition: not as important as other things or people in a particular activity, idea, or situation; a piece of equipment that is connected to a computer and used with it, for example a  printer; secondary, supporting, minor
words.translation: 外围的；次要的，附带的；外围设备；[昆][计]外围的；次要的

examples.en: a diplomat who had a peripheral role in the negotiations
examples.zh: 在谈判中发挥辅助作用的外交官

examples.en: Her involvement in the case was peripheral.
examples.zh: 她在这宗案件中是从犯。

words.definition: the ability to deal with situations in a way that does not offend, upset, or embarrass people or tell any of their secrets; care, caution
words.translation: 判断力；谨慎， 审慎；明智；自由裁量权；谨慎；判定；考虑周到

examples.en: British newspapers no longer feel they must treat the royal family with discretion.
examples.zh: 英国报界不再觉得他们非得审慎对待王室不可了。

words.definition: a situation in which something is prevented from continuing in its usual way; destruction, breaking, blasting, demolition
words.translation: 动乱；打乱；破坏；破坏，毁坏；分裂，瓦解

examples.en: The strike caused widespread disruption .
examples.zh: 罢工造成了大规模的混乱。

words.definition: flat and not sloping in any direction; to make something flat and smooth; the amount or degree of something, compared to another amount or degree; criterion, standard, norms, prototype; horizontal, flat, even; aim for, take aim at; platten
words.translation: 平的，水平的；同高度的，同等程度的；平稳的；冷静的；变平坦；水平面，水平线；高度，水平；等级；水平；标准；水平面；水平的；平坦的；同高的；瞄准；拉平；变得平坦；使同等；对准；弄平

examples.en: The floors in the old house were not completely level.
examples.zh: 老房子的地面不是完全平整的。

examples.en: a level surface suitable for wheelchairs
examples.zh: 适合轮椅的平坦表面

words.definition: to pull material together tightly in folds; a group of things that are fastened, held, or growing together; cluster, gang, qun; fix pleats
words.translation: 集中， 挤在一起；使成一束；群，伙；束，串，捆；群；串；突出物；隆起；打褶；形成一串

examples.en: She bunched the cloth up and threw it away.
examples.zh: 她把布揉成一团扔了。

words.definition: a tense situation is one in which you feel very anxious and worried because of something bad that might happen; to make your muscles tight and stiff, or to become tight and stiff; intense, stressed; get nervous; strain, get nervous
words.translation: 拉紧的；拉紧；紧张的；变得紧张；使拉紧；拉紧，变得紧张

examples.en: Is anything wrong? You look a little tense.
examples.zh: 有什么不对劲吗？你看起来有点紧张。

words.definition: to make an animal able to work for people or live with them as a pet; introduce, to teach
words.translation: 驯养， 教化；使喜爱家居生活；驯养；教化；引进

examples.en: We domesticated the dog to help us with hunting.
examples.zh: 我们驯养狗来帮助我们打猎。

words.definition: relating to the mind and thinking, or happening only in the mind; spiritual, inner; psychopath, madman
words.translation: 心理的， 精神的；智力的；[心理]精神的；脑力的；疯的；精神病患者

examples.en: a child’s mental development
examples.zh: 儿童的智力发育

examples.en: You need to develop a positive mental attitude .
examples.zh: 你需要培养积极的心态。

words.definition: to decide how something should be shared among various people; portion, part, proportion
words.translation: 分派， 分配；分配，分派；分摊

examples.en: It’s not easy to apportion blame (=  say who deserves to be blamed  ) when a marriage breaks up.
examples.zh: 婚姻破裂很难说是谁的错。

words.definition: when someone is unfriendly and full of anger towards another person; hatred, enmity
words.translation: 敌意，敌对，对抗；抵制，反对，否决；[心理]敌意；战争行动

examples.en: The reform program was greeted with hostility by conservatives.
examples.zh: 改革方案遭到保守派人士的强烈反对。

words.definition: to bend the top part of your body forward in order to show respect for someone important, or as a way of thanking an  audience; stem, Yumi; stoop down, bend down; curve, winding, flexural, crooked
words.translation: 低下；弯腰，鞠躬[bəu]；弓；鞠躬；船首；弯腰；弯曲的

examples.en: She bowed and left the stage.
examples.zh: 她鞠了一躬，离开了舞台。

examples.en: Corbett entered the room, bowing respectfully.
examples.zh: 科比特走进房间，恭敬地鞠了一躬。

examples.en: The servant bowed low and handed his master the sealed note.
examples.zh: 仆人深深一鞠躬，把那个封好的短笺递给了主人。

words.definition: a book in which someone writes about their own life, or books of this type; memoir
words.translation: 自传；自传文学

examples.en: He published his autobiography last autumn.
examples.zh: 他去年秋天出版了他的自传。

words.definition: when the same thing keeps happening often, especially with the same amount of time between each occasion when it happens; balance, symmetry
words.translation: 规律性， 规则性；整齐， 匀称；[数]规则性；整齐；正规；匀称

examples.en: Climate change is disrupting the regularity of the seasons.
examples.zh: 气候的变化正在打乱季节的规律性。

words.definition: to change from doing or using one thing to doing or using another; a piece of equipment that starts or stops the flow of electricity to a machine, light etc when you push it
words.translation: 改变， 转变；转换；对调；开关

examples.en: The terrorists will switch tactics .
examples.zh: 恐怖分子会改变战术。

words.definition: on your face or relating to your face; external, surface; hairdressing, beauty treatment
words.translation: 面部的；面部用的；面部的，表面的；脸的，面部用的；美容，美颜；脸部按摩

examples.en: Victor’s facial expression didn’t change.
examples.zh: 维克托脸上的表情没有变化。

examples.en: facial hair
